articleTitle: An Adaptive Machine Learning model for Walmart sales prediction
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: Presently, with the quantity of data developing dramatically, the judicious utilization of large data has become the focal point of ventures to serve the future and settle on better choices. Utilizing Machine Leaning (ML) models to anticipate the sales of items and wares has become a rising area for analysts in present time. This article presents the XGBoost sales expectation model which consolidates XGBoost algorithm and careful element designing handling for anticipating Walmart's sales issue. The proposed technique can adequately mine credits of various measurements to make forecasts well. This article assesses the XGBoost sales estimation model on the sales data of Walmart stores datasets given by the Kaggle. Empirical results show our strategy accomplishes better execution over the other ML techniques.

articleTitle: Ensemble Deep Learning Framework for Classification of Skin Lesions
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: Skin cancer is one of the majority prevalent malignancies that can be diagnosed visually and then further investigated with dermoscopic analysis and other procedures. Several skin-lesion (SL) classification methods using deep learning (DL) based on convolution-neural-network (CNN) and annotated skin photos illustrate modified results because visual observation provides the opportunity to use artificial-intelligence (AI) to intercept the various skin images at an early stage. In this regard, the research proposes a trustworthy method for identifying skin cancer using dermoscopy images, with the goal of bettering the visual perception and diagnostic abilities of medical experts. SL region of interest (RoI) segmentation from dermoscopy pictures was performed using swarm intelligence (SI) algorithms, and the RoI marked as the best segmentation oucome was subjected to feature extraction using the Grasshopper Optimization Algorithm (GOA). Using CNN and the ISIC-2017, ISIC-2018, and PH-2 data sets, the SLs are divided into two categories. Classification accuracy-sensitivity,-specificity-F -measure, precision, MCC, dice coefficient, and Jaccard index are used to evaluate the results of the proposed segmentation and classification strategies, with an average of 98.42%, 977.33%, and 0.97040%, respectively. Our proposed model outperforms the state-of the-art in every metric we considered

articleTitle: Multimodal Neuroimaging Data in Early Detection of Alzheimer's Disease: Exploring the Role of Ensemble Models and GAN Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: This research aimed to evaluate numerous deep-learning models for Alzheimer's disease detection using several different neuroimaging techniques. Ten recent studies were selected for comparison based on their methodology, conclusions, and limitations. The Generative Adversarial Network (GAN) algorithm is applied fictitiously to the Alzheimer's Disease Neuroimaging Initiative (ADNI) dataset, and results are provided. A comparison was made between the results of the GAN algorithm and the selected studies. Evaluation metrics were presented in a table and a graph. The study concludes that ensemble models and multi-modal approaches improve Alzheimer's Disease detection performance. However, there is a need for further work to be done to address issues, including limited sample sizes and a lack of external validation.

articleTitle: Indian Sign Language Recognition: A Comparative Analysis Using CNN and RNN Models
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: The deaf and hard-of-hearing people in India uses a distinctive form of communication called Indian Sign Language (ISL). Effective communication and inclusion require the ability to recognise and comprehend ISL gestures. Deep learning algorithms have advanced recently, opening the door for autonomous systems that can recognise sign language. In order to recognise Indian Sign Language, this research compares and contrasts Convolutional Neural Networks (CNN) and Recurrent Neural Networks (RNN), two well-known deep learning models. The proposed study focuses on developing an accurate and efficient system capable of recognizing and interpreting ISL gestures. The experimental findings show that both CNN and RNN models are equally effective and reliable for recognising Indian Sign Language. The RNN model excelled in capturing the temporal dynamics and sequential patterns of ISL movements, while the CNN model achieved excellent accuracy in capturing the spatial aspects of ISL gestures. A comparison study was also done to assess how well these models performed in terms of accuracy, precision, recall, and F1-score. In this work, CNN and RNN models are compared for the recognition of Indian Sign Language. The findings emphasise the need of taking both geographical and temporal information into account when creating precise and effective sign language recognition systems. The results offer insightful information for academics and professionals striving to improve accessibility and communication for the deaf and hard-of-hearing people in India. In order to further enhance the performance of ISL recognition systems, future research paths may investigate hybrid CNN-RNN architectures and incorporate other modalities like depth information or hand motion tracking.

articleTitle: Subduing Crime and Threat in Real-Time by Detecting Weapons Using Yolov8
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: With the rapid development of large cities and towns, crime rate graphs are also increasing steadily. The crime rate has increased along with the urban and rural areas' rapid development. Closed Circuit Television (CCTV) has been deployed in virtually every location, including airports, shopping centers, apartments, etc., to protect public safety. In other words, it has been installed everywhere people congregate. Our study focuses on detecting firearms, knives, and other sharp objects in CCTV footage in close to real-time while assessing the threat level based on the subject's arm position. You Only Look Once(YOLO) version 8 analyses CCTV footage to discover the presence of a knife or gun or other sharp objects. The evaluation of the subject's arm posture is done if a weapon is found. The threat level is determined based on how the arm holding the weapon is held. Since there are no available standard datasets, we created our own custom dataset using information from websites and Github projects. Among the tools used for object detection, annotation, and pose detection are YOLOV8, Roboflow, and Mediapipe. When performing object detection, precision and recall matter more than accuracy, hence the full set of methods was evaluated in terms of these. Nearly 6000 images were used to train the model. The model achieved an accuracy of 93%.

articleTitle: LoRa-Enabled Smart RS485 Data Logger and MQTT Gateway for Industrial IoT Applications Using ESP32
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: Industry 4.0 has driven the need for efficient data gathering and analysis to enhance business performance. However, collecting data from assets in challenging environments with uncertain network conditions remains a major obstacle. In this paper, we propose the Smart Data Logger, a gateway designed to reliably collect data from various sensors and devices and transmit it to the cloud or a server. We address the challenge of converting data from different devices and protocols to enable Industrial Internet of Things (IIoT) readiness. Our gateway utilizes an ESP32 microcontroller with a Wi-Fi board and an RS485 to TTL add-on module for communication. It supports bidirectional communication between field devices and cloud applications and provides a Modbus RTU interface on RS485 for onsite device connectivity. The gateway incorporates a GSM A7670 4G LTE module for internet connectivity and includes a built-in SD card for data storage during connectivity loss. Furthermore, an onboard LoRa E32 868MHz module allows multiple nodes to connect and send data to the centralized gateway. The data logger gateway features a two-column data storage pattern with timestamps and data packets, ensuring accurate data recording. A realtime clock (RTC) DS3231 with SPI communication is used for timestamping. Data stored on the SD card is transmitted to the cloud via MQTT when connectivity is restored. Our gateway architecture includes a smart agent for data conversion and supports configuration through embedded web pages. It provides an easy and secure solution for IIoT applications, allowing integration with existing operational technology. Overall, our Smart Data Logger gateway enables robust data collection and analysis in challenging industrial environments.

articleTitle: Dual Authentication Voting System with Facial Recognition and Fingerprint Using CNN
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: Voting is one of the notably common and basic right of all citizens of the country. In the latest loksabha election 2019, conducted in India, only 67.1% vote was being recorded. Conducting election in a democratic country like India, have major challenges of security threads, false voting, manipulation in recording vote and authentication of voter. Our country India employs the EVM (Electronic Voting Machine) since 1982. The system also has its flaws as vote rigging is a possibility. Hence, in this paper we give a solution to the voting problem. The data for the project can be acquired from the dataset of Aadhar card that contain the photo. By using CNN (Convolutional Neural Network) the face of the voter is detected and compared to the Aadhar dataset. This will be the first step of the authentication. Then the vote is casted through fingerprint, which is sensed through sensor and is authenticated. This will allow the voter to vote only once and to only one person. The recorded vote is saved in the cloud server and is counted immediately. This makes the system more efficient and authenticated and avoids rigging of vote, than the existing system of voting.

articleTitle: Pre-Trained Deep Learning-Based Approaches for Eye Disease Detection
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: This study primarily examines how well four pretrained deep learning models perform in identifying eye disorders using four metrics we developed: recall, precision, accuracy, and F1 Score. With the help of universal custom layers, the models are adjusted, and the outcomes are examined. The study then suggests an ensemble method that uses majority voting to combine the probabilistic outputs of the top-performing models. The suggested methodology outperforms state-of-the-art algorithms in experiments using a publicly available dataset, with average values for Recall, Precision, Accuracy, and F1 Score of 81.25%, 83.68%, 95.17%, and 79.12%, respectively. The work shows how well-trained deep learning models can identify eye illnesses and have the potential to improve public health, especially in mass screening programs.

articleTitle: Automatic Mocktail Maker
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: Mocktails are non-alcoholic beverages that are made to resemble cocktails. They can help you pace yourself during a protracted social event, among other things. Mocktails are non-addictive and safe. They can hydrate your body. In crowded restaurants, bartending procedures are ineffective. In today's hectic environment, waiting times are a significant factor. Customers get annoyed and unhappy with the service at busy restaurants, due to ineffective ordering and distribution. The main goal of this project is to set up an Automated Mocktail Maker system that would receive an order to make a drink from the customer using a touch screen interface. This lets the user select a type of mocktail and mix the drink by shaking the container using a reciprocating actuator controlled using a microcontroller. The device will pour the necessary amounts of ingredients into a container through tubing that feeds into the container when the user chooses the option to make a drink. The container has an internal stirrer to mix the components together and then empty into a cup. A few personalizable recipes are configured in the system. The user has the ability to choose from predefined drinks. Containers having the components needed to prepare the mocktail are put inside the machine. After the mocktail type is selected, a glass or cup is placed below the machine to collect it, and then it's ready to serve. The system is intended for residential use, and the ultimate result is a finished mocktail. The proposed system is simple and fast. Being cost-effective, it also helps to maintain quality. Although there are various drink-mixing devices on the market, the concept of introducing an application is relatively fresh and provides the user with a technical experience. A beverage can be made using such a device utilising various combinations of freshly blended ingredients.

articleTitle: Fruit Freshness Detection Using IoT and Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: This project aims to enhance the precision and efficiency of detecting fruits rot. It achieves this by utilizing sensors to detect the gases emitted by the fruits and analyzing images with machine learning models such as VGG 16 to obtain a more comprehensive evaluation of their freshness level. The models have trained on extensive images and sensor data datasets, which allows for precise identification of varying degrees of fruit freshness. Real-time data analysis and reporting to a connected technological ecosystem enables prompt monitoring of the fruits' freshness. If implemented, this project could decrease wastage and guarantee that top-quality fruits are delivered to their intended destinations, benefiting the fruit transportation sector.

articleTitle: XGBoost Based Machine Learning Techniques for Water Quality Prediction
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: Water is important to all living beings and is essential to our daily lives. It is used for drinking, irrigation, and manufacturing. But, as globalisation increased, water lost its purity, and scientific procedures are now employed to test water for its quality. In this study, a prediction model was developed to quantify quality and state of the water using machine learning techniques. XGBoost, Naive Bayes, and Support Vector Machine (SVM) are water quality prediction methods. The dataset was initially obtained from Kaggle, and it was pre-processed to eliminate null values and outliers. The Water Quality Index (WQI) value was calculated using an arithmetic approach that employs index weights of parameters, and the water was labelled based on its WQI value. Before feeding the imbalanced dataset into the machine learning model for training and testing, the Synthetic Minority Over-sampling Technique (SMOTE) will be used to balance it with a WQI value and its class. The prediction will be conducted by feeding the most accurate parameters into the model, and the model's output will be the water quality classification and consumption.

articleTitle: Facial Emotion Detection Using Haar Cascade and CNN Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: Due to its wide applications in psychology, healthcare, and safety, facial emotion recognition is a crucial machine vision issue that has to be studied. Emotion detection from facial expressions is considered a challenging task because it involves numerous sophisticated processes, including the detection, analysis, and recognition of facial characteristics. In this research, the Haar Cascade algorithm and the Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) are combined to create an innovative approach for identifying facial expressions of emotion. The Haar Cascade algorithm is used to detect facial characteristics, like eyes, nose, and mouth, from an input image. These detected features are then fed into the CNN algorithm, which is responsible for recognising the person's state of mind. The suggested strategy is tested on a publicly available dataset, and the findings reveal that it achieves 98.42% accuracy. This indicates that the approach is highly effective in accurately detecting facial emotions.

articleTitle: Analysis and Identification of Sleep Apnea by availing Random Forest and SVM
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: Sleep problems have been the subject of extensive research throughout history. One of the significant sleep disorders that endanger human life is sleep apnea, which we commonly encounter today. This incident, which happens while the person is sleeping, also has an impact on their daily lives. The obstructive sleep apnea syndrome (Disease) is a respiratory tract state that enacts roughly 2% of women and almost 4% of males. The ability to learn well, maintain well-being, and even carry out daily tasks depend on getting enough sleep. Sleep-related conditions like drowsiness sleep disruption and troubled legs are becoming more common. Obstructive respiratory condition called sleep apnea reduces the quality of sleep by triggering breathing stoppage. The apnea syndrome is characterized by an inconsistent respiratory delay or decrease in airflow when the patient is sleeping. A significant portion of the population is impacted by the sleep disorder sleep apnea. In proposed work, we suggest a machine learning model and web application on Django framework to forecast the systemic sleep apnea disorder. Here, the system model is built using the machine learning algorithms such as Random Forest and SVM Classifiers. Next, we use the web application component of the Django Framework to anticipate the patient's ailment, such as whether sleep apnea is present or absent. If apnea is present, the result is shown to the system's doctor for consultation. The results of experiments demonstrated the system's improved performance.

articleTitle: Garbage Classification Using Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: In recent years, the amount of garbage produced by humans has increased significantly, which has led to environmental problems such as pollution and health hazards. Proper garbage management and recycling are crucial for a sustainable future. The task of separating garbage manually is a process that is prone to errors and consumes a significant amount of time. In this paper, we propose a garbage classification system using computer vision, which can classify garbage into different categories such as organic, recyclable, and nonrecyclable, with high accuracy. The proposed system uses Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) for future extraction and classification. After conducting training and testing using a dataset of garbage, the results indicate that the system proposed has attained an accuracy rate of 95%.

articleTitle: The use of Image Processing for the Classification of Diabetic Retinopathy
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: Retinopathy represents one of the primary causes of blurred vision worldwide. To stop eyesight deterioration, prompt detection and therapy are essential. Deep learning as well as Artificial Intelligence have demonstrated significant promise in Diabetic Retinopathy detection and categorization. The existing research that has used Intelligence and machine learning based approaches for Diabetic Retinopathy detection are summarized in this publication. For the extraction and sorting of Diabetic Retinopathy pictures, a variety of deep learning algorithms, including convolutional neural nets and recurrent neural networks have been used. Researchers have demonstrated that this method performs better than conventional method of machine learning. Moreover, Automation solutions have already been created to help medical practitioners identify and diagnose Diabetic Retinopathy. Such techniques help identify individuals who really need immediate medical attention by analyzing retina photos and offering a classification scale for Retinopathy severity. The reliability, effectiveness, and affordability of Diabetic Retinopathy screening and diagnosis have such a tremendous deal of opportunity to be improved by Intelligence and Deep Learning techniques, which might also greatly enhance the results for patients. The promise of Intelligence Diabetic Retinopathy detection methods must be progressively explored and validated in actual areas of medicine The results from the DiarteDB0 information set were 97.6% accuracy in categorization, 97.96% compassion, 99.5% exactness, alongside 99.1% F1 score; the results from the Kaggle information set were 97.84% categorization accuracy, 98.45% compassion, 99.68% accurateness

articleTitle: Fake News Detection Using Deep Learning Based Approach
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: In this era of digital world, peoples are interacting through various online applications like Facebook, Instagram, WhatsApp, Twitter etc. these applications are the medium of online communication but also used as the source of information which generally known as news. There are various users who use these platforms as news platforms to get some news from them. From this, it can be analysed that these platforms are playing major role in creating content on regular basis for the society. to ensure that this content is verified and not contain any fake information which leads to conflicts in the society at different levels. In this paper, the deep learning models have implemented on the ISOT dataset which contains 137176 tweets data collected from twitter and some news data collected from different various sources including the news platforms. To extract features, both TD-IDF and bag of words are used. For generating vectors for words, glove embedding is applied. The deep learning models that have implemented are CNN, LSTM, BiLSTM and hybrid approach of CNN-BiLSTM. The highest accuracy that has achieved in this paper is 83% in both the classifiers i.e., CNN and LSTM.

articleTitle: A Hybrid Approach for Leaf Classification Using Machine Learning and Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: Leaf classification is a crucial task for plant identification and disease diagnosis. This study suggests a unique method that combines deep learning and machine learning algorithms for leaf classification. The proposed method involves a novel combination that employs Residual Network (ResNet50) for extraction of features, Principal Component Analysis (PCA) for reducing the dimensions of feature vector and Light gradient boosting machine (LightGBM) to perform classification. The proposed method is evaluated on a 40-class dataset of leaves from the UCI repository and achieve an impressive accuracy of 95.70%. Furthermore, we compare the time complexity of this method with other boosting models such as XGBoost and CatBoost and investigated the role of component selection in the classification task. The proposed approach has the capability to address various classification problems within the domains of computer - vision and machine learning. Moreover, it holds promise for enhancing the precision of leaf identification in plant recognition tasks.

articleTitle: Modular Multilevel Converter for Renewable System Towards THD Mitigation
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: Reconfigurable property, flexibility and simplicity in operation of Modular Multilevel Converter (MMC) have attained great importance in the research field. Since, it functions at Low frequency, the performance of the converter gets enhanced. Moreover, many techniques has been implemented for reducing the harmonic contents in MMC. In proposed work, a novel technique is introduced for mitigating the harmonic issues in MMC. The output from the photovoltaic system (PV) is given to the voltage stabilizer, which balances the voltage and gives it to the High Frequency Converter (HFC) of the MMC. Low frequency DC is converted by the HFC converter into high frequency DC, which is then fed to the Low Frequency Converter (LFC), which changes the high frequency DC into low frequency AC before being delivered to the grid. The P&O greatest Power Point Tracking (MPPT) algorithm is implemented to monitor PV panel's greatest power output. PI controller based closed loop technique is used to regulate MMC and achieve grid synchronisation. To evaluate the proposed work's effectiveness, MATLAB/Simulink is employed to implement it. Using the defined work, better reduction of THD is achieved.

articleTitle: Sensorless Field Oriented Control of Induction Motor Drive using Extended Kalman Filter (EKF)
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: Electric machine operation depends heavily on control techniques, which have a direct impact on the performance of the entire system. Electric machines, which have significant effects on industrial development and human civilization, have been subject to a variety of control systems that have been tested and investigated. A diverse array of control techniques are employed, including Field Oriented Control (FOC), Direct Torque Control (DTC), and Fault Tolerant Control (FTC). In this scheme, the FOC technique is employed to regulate the speed of an Induction Motor (IM) drive and minimize fluctuations in torque. Field Oriented Control system for IM drive decouples flux and torque, resulting in shorter response times and, occasionally, simpler control actions. The model is validated using simulation studies in MATLAB/SIMULINK.

articleTitle: Power Factor Correction by ANN Based Bridgeless Modified Landsman Converter
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: An increased power factor (PF) frontend battery is used to design a new Electric Vehicle (EV) charger in this paper. In general, Diode Bridge Rectifier (DBR) is used for generating current with low harmonics, but due to its excessive conduction loss, a Modified Landsman converter is established. Power Factor Correction (PFC) is recommended using a Landsman converter with a Bridgeless (BL) architecture for low power applications. The proposed converter solves various Power Quality (PQ) issues like, fluctuations, harmonics, device stress and current ripples. In the proposed work, EV battery which is a non-linear load causes PQ troubles on the input side resulting in input supply deterioration. To make the supply stable, the suggested converter adopts an Artificial Neural Network (ANN) controller. The minimized error from the ANN controller is fed to the PWM generator through which the distortions gets eliminated and a stabilized supply with unity PF operation is obtained. The entire work for enhancing PQ through Bridgeless Modified Landsman Converter (BLML) is carried out in MATLAB and simulation responses are obtained.

articleTitle: Loss Analysis of High Speed Homopolar Inductor Alternator
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: High-Speed Homopolar Inductor Alternator (HSHIA) is a special machine that finds its application in aerospace power systems. Identifying and analysing losses is essential for the design of electrical machines as the insulation, as well as the ventilation and cooling, are decided based on the heat produced due to losses. The major share of the losses in an HSHIA is iron loss due to its high-frequency operation and solid iron rotor. In this paper, the study of different losses and their contribution to the total loss of a 2.5kVA 4kHz, 30000RPM homopolar Inductor Alternator has been carried out and segregation of different losses is done with the help of MAXWELL 3D software.

articleTitle: CSGO: A Game-Inspired Metaheuristic Algorithm for Global Optimization
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: This paper presents a video game-inspired meta-heuristic algorithm and its performance evaluation. This optimizer algorithm is developed by assembling impressive features of previous well-known optimizer algorithms such as stochastic fractal search (SFS), artificial gorilla troops optimizer (GTO) and marine predators algorithm (MPA) with addition of chaotic operators. The main inspiration of this proposed chaotic SFS-GTO optimizer (CSGO) algorithm is the survival-of-the-fittest agent within a virtual map environment between two competitive groups in order to accomplish a mission using diverse strategies and information gathering-sharing activities. Then, the proposed CSGO's performance has been evaluated using thirteen standard benchmark test functions. The performance of CSGO is compared with its predecessors and latest improved grey wolf optimizer (MELGWO) algorithms. Based on the statistical and convergence curve analysis carried out, the proposed CSGO algorithm outperformed other competitor algorithms in terms of results accuracy and convergence speed with the exception of high computational time taken due to high number of function evaluations involved.

articleTitle: Optimization Enhancement of Output Voltage for PV System with 9 Level Inverter
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: Nowadays the need for electricity is increasing. To full fill the need for electricity by using two ways either non-conventional energy sources or renewable energy sources. Based on the cost and availability renewable energy source is the most possible energy source. The most available as well as cheap renewable energy source is solar. So, recently more research going on solar energy sources to utilize their maximum energy for different applications. The latest research trends in the field of solar are “Solar energy Conversion system”. The LUO converter is employed to increase the performance of the PV system by increasing the voltage that is output. The LUO converter is used to increase the oscillating PV voltage. For an AC load application convert DC-DC Converter voltage to 9 level Inverter Circuit. Analyze the Single phase, three-phase, and induction-based conditions in the proposed model.

articleTitle: Alzheimer's Disease Prediction Using Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: The most challenging diseases to treat are those that have to do with the brain because of the sensitive nature of the conditions, the difficulty of executing procedures, and the high costs. One of the conditions that harms the brain most frequently is the disease called Alzheimer. The procedure, instead, does not have to succeed because the effects might be disastrous. Adults are affected by this condition. This disorder causes varied degrees of forgetfulness and even memory loss, depending on the health of every sufferer. These factors make it crucial to use brain CT scans to diagnose Alzheimer's disease in the patient, classify memory loss, and define the patient's dementia stage. The most frequent neurodegenerative disease is Alzheimer's disease. For patient care, especially in the early stages of the disease, an accurate Alzheimer's disease (AD) diagnosis is essential. Though several recent studies have used computers to detect Alzheimer's disease, the majority of machine detection methods are constrained by congenital findings. Patients can avoid irreversible brain damage from happening by taking preventive measures because of the severity, awareness, and progression issues. Alzheimer's disease's early phases can be recognised, but they cannot be predicted because prediction is only feasible before the sickness manifests itself. Diabetes, Alzheimer's disease, and cancer have all shown considerable promise in the treatment of deep learning (DL). An increasingly common technique for early Alzheimer's disease detection is deep learning (DL). To categorise patients into AD, MCI, and controls, we apply deep learning (DL) to assess clinical test data and imaging (magnetic resonance imaging (MRI)) (CN). We examine methods and strategies for classifying Alzheimer's disease using deep learning classification. The suggested technique was developed to enhance patient care, lower expenses, and allow for quick and accurate analysis in big trials.

articleTitle: A Modified Three-Port DC-DC Converter with Improved Voltage Regulation for Electric Vehicles
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: Electric Vehicles are booming nowadays because of their excellent performance compared to Fuel based Vehicles. A Modified three port DC-DC Converter has been presented for Electric Vehicles. The Proposed converter comprises Boost and SEPIC Converter which can be operated either by Photovoltaic Cell or Battery. The converter is simulated in an open loop and the ripple content is compared with the many other converter. The proposed converter outperforms the existing converter and is taken for further analysis in closed loop with source disturbance. Also, the time domain parameters have been compared in closed loop analysis. The Simulation analysis is given and it is validated with Hardware Implementation.

articleTitle: Optimized Routing and Security in Maritime Safety Applications
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: In recent years, globalization has made shipping is a vital part of the world economy. Additionally, hackers are now aware of the flaws in these maritime vessel systems. Users frequently struggle to find the necessary comprehensive navigational information. As a result, managing and protecting maritime vessel networks from cyber-attacks is crucial. The purpose of this work is to monitor the ship and gives operational performance of speed log, thrust, rudder angle, position, and direction, which are sensed with the aid of sensors mounted to the ship. The data, which is obtained by the sensor are collected and sent to the Internet of things (IoT). After receiving the data, IoT transfer the information to the cloud. Genetic algorithm-based ANN classifier (GA-ANN) is used in this work to identify the shortest path of data transmission. A 64-bit Two Fish Algorithm based on key management is adopted for safety concerns, providing better data protection during transfer. As a result, the information is effectively transported to the cloud, with benefits including increased throughput, the best route, reduced energy use, and latency is achieved by using the proposed GA-ANN classifier.

articleTitle: Cardiac Affliction Detection Using Improved Grasshopper Optimized CNN
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: The most significant cause of death globally is cardiovascular disease. Whenever an accurate diagnosis is obtained at the earliest possible stage, cardiovascular problems are avoided. Electrocardiogram (ECG) tests are typically used to screen cardiac conditions, and facilitates healthcare process. Due to the dependence and direction of trained medical professionals, traditional methods of evaluating ECG images require more work and time. As a result, automated methods become necessary and image processing is then used to the medical industry. In this research, a neural network-based, effective computational method for determining heart disease is developed. In general, the input ECG images are first pre-processed using Wiener filter, which calculates the mean and variance and then conducts enhanced smoothing in low-variation circumstances. The K-means clustering method is adopted to perform segmentation on pre-processed image in precise manner. The Grey Level Co-occurrence Matrix (GLCM), which chooses the predominant features is utilized to enable accurate diagnosis of conditions in ECG images, then extracts the pertinent features. Finally, for accurate classification, an Improved Grasshopper Optimized Convolutional Neural Network (IGO- CNN) is used. The obtained outcomes demonstrate that the suggested work assists in the establishment of exact outputs and successfully recognizes the presence of heart disease in ECG images.

articleTitle: MPPT Controller For Grid Tied PV System Based On Improved Sepic Converter
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: Solar Photovoltaic (PV) systems are becoming more and more popular because they convert solar radiation directly into clean, renewable electricity. Partial shading situations are when a PV module may be partially shadowed, which might result in a reduction in the solar panel's power production. It significantly lowers the system's power output. To address this, continuous duty cycle variation methods that track MPP under partial shade have been proposed. An innovative Type-2 Fuzzy Maximum Power Point Tracking (MPPT) algorithm that can monitor a Supreme Power Point in the presence of numerous local maxima has been incorporated into the proposed system. In these schemes, the proposed Improved Single Ended Primary Inductance Converter (SEPIC) is coupled to PV module to enable the maximum output voltage under any given circumstance. This makes the device more compact. The converter's objective is to deliver input currents with an acceptable harmonic content in a grid interface while maintaining a constant power supply. Finally, several numerical simulated testing of the proposed control utilizing the MATLAB is carried out.

articleTitle: Hand Gesture Recognition and an App for Deaf and Dumb People
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: In this paper, a system for enhancing communication between sign language users and non-users is presented. The system recognizes and converts sign language into text and voice using picture data collected by a computer webcam. A masking approach is used to preprocess the picture data, then a Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) algorithm is used for feature extraction and classification. The system was trained using a dataset of masked images representing the 26 letters of the English alphabet, totaling 45500 images for training and 6500 images for testing. The system's goal is to make it simpler for those who use sign language and those who do not to communicate with one another. Keywords: Hand Gesture Recognition, Feature Extraction, Pre-Processing, Classification, CNN.

articleTitle: Design And Development of APM 2.8 Controller Based Drone System for Healthcare Application
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: In this article presents, APM (ArduPilot Mega) 2.8 controller-based drone system for healthcare applications, which deals with fast and efficient delivery of lightweight's healthcare products to remote or difficult-to-reach areas without any person contact and the unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) are used for package delivery gained significant attention in recent years due to their ability to reduce delivery times and costs. The demand for a delivery person had multiplied due to the significant growth in the utility of online orders. Drone-based technology is utilized to meet their requirement. Drones will shorten the delivery time, and reduces both the human and financial costs of the manufacturers. The delivery drone is assisted using the telemetry for live forecast and routed by the use of Global Positioning System (GPS) for delivering the medicinal products at the mentioned location after the verification. After the drone has reached the location, the person assigned to receiving the product is verified using One Time Password (OTP) and then the image of delivery is captured and stored for security purposes. The Proposed system is used for the implementation of various healthcare applications.

articleTitle: Assessing Lifespan of Lithium-Ion Rechargeable Batteries through Hybrid CNN-LSTM-DNN Method
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: Lithiumion batteries are crucial to the functioning of contemporary society, since they are used in a wide variety of applications from powering electric cars to storing renewable energy. Yet, there is still a significant problem in making these batteries safe and long-lasting. Using an unique CNN-LSTM-DNN architecture, we offer a new approach for predicting the RUL of lithium-ion batteries in this research. Our method combines the strengths of CNNs for image analysis, LSTMs for sequence data, and DNNs for feature learning. By combining these models, we are able to outperform existing state-of-the-art approaches to estimating battery RUL. An extensive lithium-ion battery dataset from the Center for Innovative Product Lifecycle Management is used to assess the efficacy of our approach; the findings show a considerable decrease in identification mistakes and an increase in RUL identification performance. This research provides the path for a more accurate and efficient early warning system to be created, which will be crucial in preventing dangerous and short-lived lithium-ion battery failures in the future.

articleTitle: Contour-Based Identification of Multicystic Ovary Morphology Using us Images of Ovaries
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: Poly/multi-cystic ovary syndrome (PCOS) is a common endocrine disorder affecting women of reproductive age. Early and accurate diagnosis of PCOS is important to prevent its long-term health effects. PCOM is the structure of Polycystic are visually viewed by use of various medical imaging tools such as ultrasound images and MRI scans. which are helps to visualize the morphology features of follicles in the either sides of ovaris. In this paper, study about the segmentation of follicles present in the ovary and mark it as contours. Contour segmentation is a well-established technique in image processing and computer vision for segmenting objects with clear boundaries in an image. The proposed approach involves preprocessing the input image using edge-preserving filters such as a median filter, a Gaussian filter, and a bilateral filter used to preserve edges. In this study, enhance the various sized cysts present in the ovaries. Based on the Rotterdam criteria, size and count of cysts place significant diagnose process. By the use contour segmentation to highlight the boundaries of the ovary and segment the each and every regions inside the ovary. This paper investigates the accuracy of distinct edge preservation filters which are used for pre-processing the images. After preprocessed, contours are drawn to specify the follicles regions with the threshold >0.2.The US images of ovaries are used to examine the multiple cysts in the ovaries, These images used in this paper to examine contours segmentation with distinct filters such as Bilateral filter, Gaussian filter and Median filter. The results show that contour segmentation using a Gaussian filter achieved high segmentation accuracy with an similarity coefficient of 0.94.

articleTitle: Makaton Sign Language Recognition
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: Makaton is a widely used sign language system that is primarily used by individuals with communication difficulties, such as those with Autism, Down syndrome, and other developmental disorders. However, despite its widespread usage, there is a lack of technology for accurately recognizing and understanding Makaton signs. This paper proposes a model that combines MediaPipe Holistic with a neural network, such as SimpleRNN, LSTM, or GRU, to recognize Makaton sign language (MSL). The model is trained on a custom dataset of Makaton sign language videos using backpropagation and the Adam optimizer. The proposed network achieved a high accuracy on the test set, demonstrating its effectiveness in recognizing Makaton sign language. This study introduces an innovative method for advancing the development of systems that recognize sign language by utilizing MediaPipe Holistic in conjunction with a neural network. This can improve the way technology interacts with people who have hearing impairments.

articleTitle: Online Hand Gesture Recognition and Classification for Deaf and Dumb
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: Humans may engage with computers in a natural way by using hand gestures to carry out a variety of tasks. However, elements like the hand's complexity. Gesture structures, differences in hand size, posture, and ambient illumination can all have an impact on how well hand gesture recognition systems perform. Due to recent advancements in deep learning, picture recognition algorithms now perform significantly better. The Deep Convolutional Neural Network has shown improved performance in visual representation and classification, especially when compared to traditional machine learning methods. In this study, a Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) for hand gesture detection is proposed. In order to quantitatively increase the size of the dataset and provide the resilience required for a deep learning approach, data augmentation is initially utilized, which randomly moves photos both horizontally and vertically to an extent of 20% of the original dimensions. A gesture can be used to convey both an activity or an emotion. Also included are sign language and body language. The static and the dynamic are the two different categories of gestures. The former use nonverbal cues like a raised hand or body language to communicate. The latter can communicate certain ideas through body language and hand gestures. In order to determine the user's intent, the gesture or movement of the body or body components is recognised.

articleTitle: A Novel Quantum States Based AI Learning on MRI Brain Slices for the Intracranial Tumor Detection
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: A tumor in the intra-cranial structure can initiate from various parts of the body thereby proliferating into the cranium. Otherwise, it can originate from the brain cells causing several neurological disorders. Early detection of the tumor promotes effective healing on treatment towards the cyst. The radiotherapist may misinterpret recordings due to various reasons including incorrect segmentation of the MRI image. This proposal works uniquely in brain tumor detection more precisely by the quantum principle implementation on to the pre-processed anisotropically diffused slice. The qubits of the resultant image primarily undergoes image segmentation by an unsupervised learning through Artificial Intelligence (AI) by the implementation of K - Means Clustering (KMC) algorithm. This scales the image qubits and segregates accurate qubits in differentiated quantum states or clusters. One of the state guarantees the extraction of qubits in the Region Of Interest (ROI) accurately by the secondary segmentation through Global Thresholding Methodology (GTM). Thus, by pairing the primary and secondary segmentation (KMC-GTM) promotes AI learning though automated quantitative qubit feature analysis with respect to manually delineated ground truth image. The statistical determination validates the efficacy of the proposal with regard to several segmentation scores along with accuracy of the ROI extraction being 98.93%.

articleTitle: Comparative Analysis of Power, Temperature and Hardware Utilization on Implementation of Half Adder
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: Several developing countries have been faced with serious energy deficits. Environmentally conscious communication has been advanced by the creation of an economical half adder using the Vivado software framework and several FPGA families. To determine the most energy-efficient FPGA series, three distinct FPGA families with seven series each were developed: Airtex, Virtex, and Kintex. The Airtex, Virtex, and Kintex families each consume 0.795 watts of power, but the Kintex family consumes 1.013 watts. Temperatures of Airtex, Virtex, and Kintex are 58.5 degrees Celsius, 73.6 degrees Celsius, and 74 degrees Celsius, respectively. Using components from the Airtex-7 series instead of those from the other two families reduces power dissipation, as specified. Airtex's power efficiency is comparable to that of rival FPGA architectures. Using this strategy, it is possible to meet future energy demands. Moreover, Airtex board is more affordable than competing brands. Airtex FPGAs have a unique set of characteristics that make them suitable for specific applications when compared to other FPGA families. Using this strategy, future energy demands can be met. Additionally, Airtex board is less expensive than competing brands. Compared to other FPGA families, Airtex FPGAs have a unique set of characteristics that make them suitable for specific applications.

articleTitle: High Gain SEPIC-Zeta Converter for Energy Management of Wind-PMSG Based Water Pumping System
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: Recent studies have shown that researchers are very fascinated with variable speed Permanent Magnet Synchronous Generator (PMSG) based Wind Energy Conversion Systems (WECS). This study addresses a number of PMSG related topics, including topologies using adaptive network based fuzzy inference system maximum power point tracking (ANFIS MPPT) controlled methods. According to the simulation findings, both an artificial neural network (ANN) and ANFIS approaches work well for determining wind rapidity and for monitoring the supreme power point and related rotor speed. The suggested single ended primary inductance converter (SEPIC) zeta converter with ANN controller enhances an energy from battery to be applied to the motor at times of power shortage from WECS. The simulation and experimental findings demonstrate the steady state performance under a range of wind speeds and prove an efficiency of the developed controllers utilizing the parameters that were measured.

articleTitle: Simulation and Analysis of Accelerometer Bias Estimation in Inertial Navigation System
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: The Inertial Navigation System (INS) is a navigation system that determines the position, velocity, and orientation of a moving object without the aid of outside references. It does this by using gyroscopes and accelerometers. The most severe errors of INS are Direct Current (DC) offset or bias drift and scale factor variation. The estimate and correction of these limitations are necessary for accurate navigation. While measuring these errors measurement noise and process noise are the error sources that affect the measurement. The proposed method for measuring the bias from the accelerometer uses a Kalman filter. Estimation is done by using the Kalman filter, which has the predict and update stages, a recursive filter that uses state space techniques. Three accelerometer output is used for analyzing the bias factors of all three axes of INS. Accelerometer output is filtered using a Kalman filter to get the noisy free output. The proposed method effectively filters out the noises which present in the measurement and can estimate the accelerometer bias without the help of a turntable.

articleTitle: Mathematical Modelling and Cell Balancing of Lithium-ion Battery
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: The paper presents a range of energy storage devices, such as batteries and super/ultracapacitors, and demonstrate how they can be integrated with a voltage balancing circuit that utilizes a single inductor-capacitor energy converter. The circuit's primary function is to effectively transfer surplus energy from the upper cell to the lower cell in the chain, using a bidirectional MOSFET switch and an LC tank. This active balancing circuit is designed to provide fast balancing speed, compact size, low cost, and superior performance in terms of maximum energy recovery. The control of MOSFET switches is managed by synchronous trigger patterns with complementary pulse-width modulated signals, operating in a near-zero current system. This feature enables the maintenance of a zero-voltage gap between non-adjacent cells within a series battery or supercapacitor string during cyclic charging and discharging. Additionally, the resonant frequency of the circuit is the same as the switching frequency, which results in a lower resonant frequency.

articleTitle: Optimal Scheduling of Electric Vehicles in Residential Distribution Systems
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: Electric vehicles provide an effective and tangible solution to reducing pollution, combating environmental modification and thus improving energy security. However, the potential for widespread EV adoption poses significant difficulties to the functioning of residential distribution systems, depending on how and when EVs are charged. This new mode of transport and infrastructure necessitates reliable and safe energy management solutions. It must be guaranteed that the electric vehicles and their charging infrastructure are safe, convenient, energy-efficient and cost-effective for everyone involved. In addition, grid operators must guarantee that they can conveniently control the charging of electric vehicles in the distribution grid. This paper deals with control strategies for electric vehicle charging schedules in residential distribution systems. Charging planning for electric vehicles can be controlled both on the part of the distribution network operator (DSO) and on the consumer side. This paper focuses on planning EV charging in residential distribution systems from a utility perspective.

articleTitle: Real Time Fake Logo Detection
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: Detection of counterfeit logos of a company or brand helps the user not to get cheated out of their hand earned money as they end up selling out a huge amount of money for a duplicate product and also it reduces the buying counterfeit products releasing in market for sales. Logo Detection aims to help consumers distinguish forgeries from the original product. Using this system, a consumer can verify whether a product is in fact an original. On considering logo detection viewpoint variation, deformation, occlusion, illumination conditions, cluttered or textured background, intra-class variation these are some of the problems faced. To overcome this problem. This paper explains deeply about the SSD and how it is used in real time fake logo detection.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Robust Controller for BLDC Motor Drive in Electric Vehicle
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: Brushless DC (BLDC) motors have become a viable alternative in response to the rising demand for energy-efficient motors in Electric Vehicles (EVs). BLDC motors face challenges related to unsteady operation when disturbances occur in the hall sensors. These disturbances lead to uncertain and nonlinear characteristics in the motor systems, which can negatively impact controller performance. Sliding Mode Control (SMC) is a popular control strategy for dealing with nonlinearities. So, this paper proposes the design and implementation of an SMC scheme for BLDC motor drive specifically tailored for three-wheeler EV applications. SMC can overcome the unstable behavior of the motor drive under parametric variations. A comparative analysis of SMC with PI controller was also presented to prove the effectiveness of the robust controller.

articleTitle: Crop Price Prediction for Coconut in Tamil Nadu Using Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: Agriculture is one of the most important sectors of the Indian economy, with a major contribution towards the country's GDP. The agricultural sector in India is still predominantly based on traditional farming methods, which makes it challenging for farmers to keep up with the ever-changing market prices of crops. In recent years, data-driven models have emerged as a powerful tool for crop price prediction. This paper aims to predict the prices of coconuts in India using Decision tree regression, gradient Boost regressor, random forest regressor and Extreme gradient boosting (XGBOOST) models. The study utilizes monthly coconut price data from 2010 to 2022. The results show that the xgboost model has the best performance, followed by the Gradient boosting and regression models. The findings of this study can help policymakers, farmers, and traders make informed decisions regarding coconut farming and trading.

articleTitle: Plant Disease Prediction Using Efficientnet
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: As population increases the demand for the food and the raw materials for it also increases linearly. And also agriculture and related sectors contribute more to the GDP of a country. But due to disease the cultivation of plants is affected worstly. Which leads to a huge loss in both the GDP food production. It also leads to an increase in the price of food and raw materials. To solve this problem, in this paper we suggested a solution of creating an application which will predict the disease of the plant from the image of the affected plant leaf. The application uses the Machine Learning algorithm EfficientN et B3 model to predict the disease. The Idea is to collect the disease images as a dataset of multiple diseases of different plants, Pre-process the data, Select the ML algorithm, Train and test it, Application development using Streamlit and deploy it in the Streamlit cloud. This system processes the images of different classes, trimming the images numbers and size of those to optimize it to provide to the EfficientN et B3 model. Then Evaluate the model using a test dataset. Save the model with weights of the model to use it in the application. In application load the model and weights to it. The application is created with future scope, as users can select the disease prediction for several plants within a single application. Every plant data is trained with the same data model to simplify the model loading process in application. Changing the weights is enough to predict the disease in different plants.

articleTitle: An Efficient BLDC Motor Drive for Electric Boat
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: Nowadays peoples are more attracted to tourism, among them rural tourism in backwaters and navigable canals are popular. Due to rising temperatures and with the exhaustion of fossil fuels, a new market for Electric Vehicles (EVs) in marine applications has emerged. Because of its great efficiency, high power density, and nearly no maintenance requirements, Brushless DC (BLDC) motors and their drives are gaining popularity every day. In this paper, BLDC drive with Maximum Torque per Ampere (MTPA) controller for marine application are modeled and analysed. MTPA approach is used to determine the minimum operating current that can produce maximum torque.

articleTitle: Artificial Intelligence to the Assessment, Monitoring, and Forecasting of Drought in Developing Countries
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: In order for plants to respond to specific degrees of moisture stress that affect both vegetative development and crop production, circumstances called “drought” must exist. It happens when the amount of moisture that can be held in the soil to suit a specific crop's needs is insufficient. India's drought has two main causes: climate change and a lack of surface water supplies. In some cases, it may be able to pinpoint the direct cause of a drought in a specific area, but this is not always the case. Consequently, it is imperative to establish an effective method for communicating the Standardized Precipitation Index SPI data revealing drought indices to farmers and strengthen drought and climate resilience in order to improve all these services in favour of improving agricultural productivity and decreasing food insecurity in India. Understanding past drought experiences with precise indicators is essential to developing future plans and policies in India's agriculture industry. Since this study would aid in India's agricultural development, it is obvious that a standardised drought index must be used to comprehend how frequently droughts are occurring across the country. The major goal of this study is to establish a suitable baseline for drought index forecasting using Standardized Precipitation Index SPI data. As a result, the project's ultimate result would be a knowledge base from which appropriate forecasting tools and distribution networks for farmers might be updated or established. Also, experiment with the logistic regression algorithm to get the best prediction.

articleTitle: Image Based Surveillance System
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: The Image Based Surveillance System is a contemporary security solution for homeowners that offers increased safety and convenience. This system allows homeowners to receive notifications when someone is at their door, view the visitor's identity, and communicate with them through a smart device. This innovative technology has transformed home security by providing an efficient and effective way to monitor and interact with visitors from anywhere. Image based surveillance systems are an important component of smart homes as it helps to protect against unwanted access such as burglaries and invasions. Conventional doorbell systems found in modern buildings usually rely on radio waves and advanced technology to establish a connection between the doorbell and the answering device. However, these systems come with their own set of limitations. For instance, the answering machines are often stationed in a fixed location, typically close to the door. This means that residents must be physically present near the answering device to respond to the doorbell, which could pose an inconvenience. Additionally, if an occupant wants to see who is outside, they need to approach the door. This type of doorbell system poses a challenge for residents who are unable to answer or grant access to guests when they are away from home. Additionally, the lack of remote access also means that occupants are unable to keep a record of who has visited their property, which can be a cause for concern in terms of security. Image Based Surveillance System improves upon these limitations by providing remote access and control of the doorbell system through a smart device, allowing homeowners to answer and communicate with visitors from anywhere, as well as keeping a record of guests..

articleTitle: Soil Nutrient Prediction and Crop Recommendation System
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: Food is the necessity of humans which is in great demand. Agriculture is the major domain and primary source of food. Soil is the main resource for agriculture where the essential nutrients required for plant growth is available. Agriculture has progressed over time with modern technologies and more equipment's have replaced ancient farming methods. There is a great need to manage the amount of fertilizer to be added for every crop. Without soil testing, it is very difficult to ensure the right application of fertilizers for the crop and get the optimum yield. Analyzing soil samples in a laboratory is a time-consuming process that entails numerous steps, such as gathering soil samples, preparing them for analysis, conducting chemical or physical analysis, interpreting the analysis results, and ultimately providing fertilizer recommendations for crops. In this work, soil nutrient prediction system is developed which predicts the Nitrogen, Phosphorus, Potassium (NPK) values and recommends the crop to be cultivated. In this system, BORUTA regression model gives highest accuracy of 91%. Python is used to develop this prediction and recommendation system.

Index Terms: Least Absolute Shrinkage And Selection Operator

articleTitle: Fake News Detection Using ML and DL Approaches
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: Advances in industry and technology have created numerous new work opportunities for job seekers and the unemployed. The number of job openings advertised on the internet has also increased. It takes time and effort to apply for a job online. It may also cause concern because they have access to our personal, professional, and academic data. As a result, it is critical to determine whether the job we are looking for is legitimate or not. This model is being developed to detect bogus job postings. We employed Deep Neural Network in this project. For comparison, Machine learning algorithms like K Nearest Neighbour, NB classifier, decision tree, SVM, and RF classifiers were also used in this work.

articleTitle: Sentimental Analysis from Social Media Post for Disaster Management
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: In this modern era, the use of social media is very important for raising consciousness and for amusement. Posts that are related to disasters are collected from social media like Twitter and Facebook and the writer's attitude is analyzed using sentimental analysis. Social media in times of calamities and natural disasters look into whether first responders may use this information to enhance crisis management and situational awareness. For disaster management, social media posts are a useful source of information. They can be used to detect sentiment and pinpoint the needs of disaster victims. Experimental results reveal that Bidirectional long short-term memory performs relatively better when compared to other models.

articleTitle: High Switched Reluctance Generator for PSO Optimized WECS
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: In order to implement switching reluctance generators (SRG) for wind energy conversion into the power distribution system (PDS), fundamental particle swarm optimization (PSO) is presented in this research. SRGs are an excellent alternative even if they are not frequently utilized in wind energy applications due to their high levels of resilience, efficacy and speed range. Controlling the electricity sent to the load is a never ending task. In order to keep the produced power as consistent as feasible given that the wind speed is changing, the voltage of excitation needs to be adjusted. In this section we offer a PSO method for enhancing a SRG efficiency in a distributed wind power system. The output power profile may be calculated by continuous simulations of generator model using a variety of control parameters due to Switched Reluctance Generator's extremely nonlinear characteristics. It is a multidimensional search space, therefore there are a lot of cycles. In order to shorten modelling duration and widen the search space, we have employed evolutionary methods. An elementary PSO approach is being developed to find the optimal firing angles and DC bus voltage levels under different operating conditions. With outstanding energy efficiency and minimal torque ripple, performance is guaranteed. Using this method, SRGs will operate at a slower speed than base speed in the currently under control area. The simulation results show that it is possible to achieve a level of performance that balances less torque ripple with improved economy.

articleTitle: Asynchronous Circular Buffers based on FIFO for Network on Chips
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: In multicore System-on-Chips (SoCs), Network on Chip (NoC) is utilized to facilitate on chip communication due to its benefits over bus-based topologies, specifically as chip sizes go smaller. Asynchronous, synchronous, or Globally Asynchronous and Locally Synchronous (GALS) NoC implementations are all possible. Although, efficiency of synchronous designs is confined by relies on slowest critical path and clock rates, it is essential to optimize every aspect of design. In this paper, an efficient asynchronous design is proposed for efficiently control FIFO buffers based on the time-consuming features of the system by preventing clock distribution issues and clock skew on chip. It also aids in improving efficiency of circular buffer by managing memory circularly and enables optimization solutions for infrequently utilized parts in system. Operation in terms of delays, offering effective performance as compared to low performance produced by synchronous counterpart, in addition to benefit of lower power consumption. In NoC routers, buffers are essential elements. In this paper, TSMC 180nm platform, Linear Technology Simulation program with integrated circuit emphasis (LT Spice) is employed to simulate a four-stage First in First out (FIFO) buffer depending on domino logic in asynchronous mode. The proposed asynchronous architecture maintains an operation in terms of throughput and latency while using 50% less power and minimal chip area than synchronous design, according to results.

Author Keywords: Linear Technology Simulation program with integrated circuit emphasis

articleTitle: Fault Analysis in Wind Energy Conversion System Using Doubly Fed Induction Generator with Probabilistic Neural Network Classifier
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: Renewable energy sources like solar, wind, geothermal, biomass, etc., which are widely available and inexpensive, produce the cleanest and fastest acting energy. In consideration with the advantage of using renewable energy sources, researchers are implementing such systems in real life. In this paper, Hybrid Renewable Energy resource is used which includes PV system and Wind Energy Conversion System (WECS) followed by the utilization of Adaptive Network Fuzzy Interference System (ANFIS) based MPPT controller. The WECS accompanied with Doubly Fed Induction Generator (DFIG) along with the PWM rectifier is also used. Along with these sources, a bidirectional battery converter is used to balance the power in the battery. The major issues is fault detection which is detected by Probabilistic Neural Network (PNN). The converter output is provided to the grid with 3Φ VSI in which DC voltage is converted to AC voltage. An enhancement in output is obtained using LC filter and Direct Quadrature (DQ) theory provides grid synchronization with low Total Harmonic Distortion (THD). The entire work is carried out in MATLAB and the system responses are verified with the generation of satisfying results.

articleTitle: Assessment of Student Attentiveness in Classroom Environment Using Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: In this study, we explore methodologies for automatically identifying student engagement from their facial expressions. The system works on face recognition in which every student inside the class is photographed and their information is saved on a server. The faces of each student are detected using the Haar cascade algorithm, Later Convolutional Neural Networks(CNN) extract input image features and the emotions are classified. Students' current state of attention towards the lecture is calculated and the live reports are displayed on a small digital board in the classroom which is connected to the server. The field of interest of each student is calculated from the reports. The reports of all the students can be viewed by the management and Parents have the access to view the reports of their wards.

articleTitle: Design and Analysis of the Electrical Properties of Different Dielectric Oxide Materials for Electrostatic Doping Through Nanowire Multichannel FET
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: This project focuses on identifying a suitable dielectric oxide material for electrostatic doping through charge plasma and heterojunction. The oxides selected for this study are HfO2, GeO2, Si3N4, and SiO2, which are common dielectric oxides with various applications in different fields. To compare the electrical properties of these oxides, Sentaurus TCAD software has been used to run simulations and analyze their dielectric constants, breakdown strengths, and bandgaps. The results indicate that HfO2 has the highest dielectric constant and a relatively large bandgap, making it a strong candidate for electrostatic doping applications. Si3N4 also has a high dielectric constant and strong breakdown strength, while SiO2 has the highest bandgap. The study highlights the importance of considering the specific requirements of an application when choosing a dielectric oxide material. Factors such as threshold voltage, subthreshold slope, Ion/Ioff ratio, transfer characteristics should be taken into account. Overall, this project provides valuable insights into the electrical properties of different dielectric oxides and how they can be used in electrostatic doping applications. The findings can help researchers and engineers in the field of semiconductor technology to make informed decisions about which dielectric oxide material is best suited for their specific applications.

articleTitle: GWO-PI Controlled Re-Lift LUO Converter for Standalone Load System
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: When renewable energy resources started, it opened a new horizon to transmission and distribution of electrical energy. Several distributed energy resources are linked to the utility network or microgrid with the aid of a power electronic interface. However, the power quality is deteriorated by different factors such as varying load demands, changing weather condition and nonlinear loads. Hence, the proposed system aims to achieve improved power quality under balanced and unbalanced conditions with high control capability. To raise the quality of power at Distribution side of utility grid, three-phase four-leg VSI is used. In this proposed system, Photovoltaic system is used to supply power to load. Therefore, a DC-DC Relift Luo converter is used, which efficiently boosts the voltage gain while reducing the effects of parasitic elements over a large duty ratio range. Output of DC-DC converter is stabilized using a Grey Wolf Optimization (GWO) tuned PI controller and the effective grid voltage synchronization is achieved by the technique of feedback line controller. To ascertain the working of the proposed design in terms of its efficiency and dynamic compensation capability, a MATLAB based simulation model along with a laboratory prototype are developed and analyzed.

Author Keywords: Grey Wolf Optimization based PI controller
three phase four-leg Voltage Source Inverter (VSI)

articleTitle: AI Based ANN Control of Double Fed Induction Generator Based Wind Power System
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: A Doubly Fed Induction Generator (DFIG) or wind energy conversion, is a most popular generator in industry which relies on wind farms. The DFIG's variable structure properties and nonlinearities enable a controller design for this type of system to a difficult task. Required dynamic behavior is constructed by, verifying effectiveness of suggested system and enhancing closed loop system's functionality, a unique method is proposed in this paper. To maintain DC connection at constant, a proportional integral PI controller is used. For grid synchronization Artificial Neural Network (ANN) controller is employed. By the deployment of D-Q model, the reference current is generated for of <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$3\ \phi$</tex> grid. The constant state power of the device at different wind speeds are considered to contribute to the ANN controllers' reliability. The <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$3\phi$</tex> Voltage Source Inverter (VSI) intended for regulate the control flow of grid voltage. Obtained results are verified using MATLAB platform. Trial results clearly demonstrated that the suggested strategy surpassed the conventional methods in terms of effectiveness, dependability and minimal ripples with a minimized THD value of 1.1%.

articleTitle: Optimal Charging Process for Electric Vehicle Using Renewable Energy Source
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: This article proposes an new two-way parking concept for electric vehicles (EV) in distributive systems using renewable energy sources. The model incorporates an upper level that deals with the collaboration between the parking lots and the power network and a lower level that controls the charging system of the EVs.
