The proposed model considers the accessibility of environmentally friendly power sources, like solar and wind power, and enhances the charging system to boost the utilization of renewable power while guaranteeing that the EVs are charged in a convenient manner. It can successfully lessen the dependence on petroleum derivatives and decline the carbon impression of the transportation area. The proposed method gives experiences into the capability of utilizing renewable power hot-spots for EV charging and features the significance of incorporating EV accusing framework of distributive environmentally friendly power frameworks.

articleTitle: Speed Control of BLDC Motor Using Modified Zeta Converter
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: In recent days, the increased growth of electricity consumption with conventional and also advanced appliance cause environmental issues and affects the community. By improving energy efficient techniques helps to deal with the challenging environmental issues. More than two-thirds of industrial consumption is utilized by electric motors. Brushless DC (BLDC) motors are the most suitable for household appliances because of their low horsepower controlling features such as noiseless operation, wide speed range, and gives high efficiency with low maintenance. It is because the brushes are used for commutation in conventional DC motors are getting replaced with electronic commutation. This has to be maintained properly because of its high cost. So there are so many control methods are implemented. In existing system, a zeta converter with PI control method is used. In this proposed system, a new topology of ZETA converter with switched inductor is used to improve the power quality of system than the previous system and the system is monitored and controlled using closed loop feedback system to improve the efficiency of the motor using PIC controller.

articleTitle: Blood Cancer Detection Using Improved Machine Learning Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: The occurrence of blood cancer has been on rise over the last decade, and treatment of this disease begins as soon as possible following a correct diagnosis. There are a variety of tests and medical experts involved in the diagnostic process, which is time-consuming and expensive. In order to make an accurate prediction of its outcome, an automatic diagnosis system is necessary. This paper suggests a method for blood cancer detection using Improved Machine Learning Algorithm like Ensemble Method with the combination of Effective Fuzzy C Means (EFCM) and Iterative Morphological Process (IMP). The use of EFCM and IMP techniques helps to segment and analyse the blood image data, allowing for the identification of specific characteristics associated with blood cancers. This segmentation process enables the algorithm to focus on the relevant regions of interest, facilitating more accurate and targeted detection of cancerous cells. Moreover, a pre-processing and enhancement methods have been used to the image of blood. By utilizing Machine Learning to process images of blood cancers, accurate diagnosis is achieved, diagnosis times is reduced, and diagnostic testing is provided faster, cheaper, and with greater safety.

articleTitle: Meta-Analysis of Spread of Disease: COVID-19*
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: It has become clear that statistical analysis of COVID-19 is an essential strategy for comprehending and containing the ongoing global pandemic. The purpose of this study is to examine the value of static analysis methods in examining the spread of the COVID-19 virus, its effects on human health, and the efficacy of containment measures. Static analytic approaches provide a thorough and quantitative evaluation of the COVID-19 pandemic by utilising data from numerous sources, including epidemiological reports, medical records, and social media platforms. With the help of this method, scientists and decision-makers can better understand the behaviour of the virus, locate possible hotspots, and create evidence-based mitigation strategies. In the context of COVID-19, static analysis is applied across a wide range of fields, including but not limited to data mining, machine learning, and statistical modelling. These methods make it possible to find hidden trends, forecast illness progression, and assess the success of public health initiatives. Furthermore, the efficiency and precision of decision-making processes are improved by the incorporation of static analysis with real-time data streams. Stakeholders can quickly adapt to new difficulties by keeping an eye on crucial indicators like infection rates, hospitalisations, and vaccine coverage. They can then tailor their activities to address these challenges.

articleTitle: Deep Learning-Based Image Retrieval: Addressing the Semantic Gap for Accurate Content-Based Image Retrieval
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: The paper proposes a deep learning-based Content-Based Image Retrieval (CBIR) system that retrieves images based on feature sets and displays the resultant images with minimum vector distance. The proposed model utilizes convolutional neural networks (CNNs) for the extraction of high-level and abstract visual data, which can learn hierarchical representations that encapsulate complicated semantics and increase retrieval accuracy by utilizing deep neural networks. The paper highlights the advantages of content-based image retrieval over textual indexation and its less time-consuming nature. The proposed model is compared with other models, and the efficiency and correctness of the suggested process for extracting visually related photos from a huge database are established through rigorous experimentation and review. The paper also discusses the use of multimodal techniques that mix textual information with visual characteristics to further enhance semantic understanding. Overall, the paper provides a comprehensive discussion on the use of deep learning-based techniques for content-based image retrieval and is informative for individuals interested in the field of image processing and computer science.

articleTitle: ANFIS-Based MPPT Control Algorithm for DCDC Converter with Flower Pollination Optimization Using IoT
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: Solar energy is considered to be a clean energy source which is growing in popularity in today's distribution networks. The output power of photovoltaic modules is not linearly correlated with ambient variables and it is unable to give maximum power to grid due to its inconsistent surroundings. Therefore, using Maximum Power Point Tracking (MPPT) for systems using Photovoltaic (PV) cell becomes crucial. The suggested work designs and implements a unique MPPT optimized algorithm with IoT features. In order to optimize solar photovoltaic system (SPVS), this work proposes an Adaptive Neuro Fuzzy Inference System (ANFIS) based MPPT, in which the parameters of ANFIS is optimized using Flower Pollination Algorithm (FPA). Modified Luo (M-Luo) converter is employed in this work that has a superior output waveform, high power density and improved voltage gain transfer, also tracks maximum ideal power from PV modules. For the purposes of remote monitoring and control, the proposed network system uses the Internet of Things ( IoT) to send vital data to the cloud. It is possible to remotely monitor the system to IoT platforms. Both simulation and hardware implementation are performed in MATLAB/SIMULINK environment and laboratory setup, respectively, for evaluating the proposed system.

articleTitle: Transmission Binary Mapping Algorithm with Deep Learning for Underwater Scene Restoration
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: Deep learning based image resolution reconstruction has gained popularity recently. Using sensors, underwater pictures are captured. Due to the water's exponential attenuation of the transmitted light, underwater photographs have poor visibility, including low contrast and color blurring. The identification of targets and further evaluation are made more difficult by the underwater images' degradation. This paper offers a hybrid underwater image processing method called deep learning based transmission binary mapping algorithm that combines a color balance algorithm with an underwater picture restoration technique to solve these issues. This research work proposes an enhanced picture super-resolution reconstruction approach. It is based on transmission based binary mapping algorithm for enhancement in the efficiency of machine learning concepts. To calculate transmission maps, RGB attenuation for each channels are decomposed. These suggested approach can efficiently determine light at the background and combined transmission binary mapping at underwater images, which can then be used to recover these image. In addition, color attenuation balancing technique helps to provide upgraded scenes that seems realistic. Finally, thorough testing are put into place to evaluate how well our method works. The suggested method surpasses a number of popular underwater image enhancement and restoration techniques, according to tests on photographs taken in various underwater situations.

Author Keywords: Deep learning based transmission binary mapping

articleTitle: A Proficient Framework for Coronary Artery Disease Prediction using Logistic Regression
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: The healthcare industry is actively researching heart disease prediction to identify people who have a higher likelihood of developing this condition. Due to the increasing prevalence of heart disease, it is vital to accurately identify and treat people at risk for it. Machine learning-based techniques offer potential benefits in the early detection and prevention of heart disease, but developing such methods is a complex task. Many countries lack the necessary cardiovascular expertise, and there is a significant number of misdiagnosed cases. Accurate and efficient prediction of heart disease at an early stage is essential for managing and treating the condition effectively, and digital patient records can support clinical decision-making. The ultimate goal is to reduce the incidence and mortality rates associated with heart disease. In this research, several supervised machine-learning algorithms have been developed and compared for their effectiveness in predicting heart disease, including Logistic Regression, Decision Tree, Naïve Bayes, KNN, and Xtreme Gradient Boosting (XGB). Among these models, Logistic Regression has demonstrated an accuracy of 0.86 and precision of 0.90, making it a promising approach for heart disease prediction.

articleTitle: GAN-Based Facial Feature Reconstruction for Improved Masked Face Recognition During Covid
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: The use of face masks during is a major obstacle has been faced during the COVID-19 epidemic. Face recognition technologies, which rely on unobstructed facial features for accurate identification. In this paper, we make use of Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) for face reconstruction from masked faces. We propose a GAN-based approach to learn the underlying relationships between masked and unmasked facial features and generate plausible reconstructions of the missing facial features. Our primary goal is to evaluate the effectiveness of GAN-based face reconstruction for masked faces using various metrics, including visual quality, accuracy, and robustness. The findings of this investigation show that the suggested strategy can produce high-quality and precise reconstructions of the missing facial features, and it can be used for face recognition tasks. Our findings suggest that GAN-based face reconstruction has the potential to overcome the limitations posed by face masks, providing a solution that preserves individual privacy and security while ensuring accurate face recognition. This research project has significant implications for the development of new face recognition technologies that can operate effectively in the presence of masks, contributing to the ongoing efforts to combat the COVID-19 pandemic.

articleTitle: Stroke Prediction Using XGB Classifier, Logistic Regression, GaussianNB and BernaulliNB Classifier
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: Stroke is one of major reason for human mortality as well as morbidity worldwide, making early prediction and intervention significant for effective treatment. In latest years, machine learning algorithms have emerged as important tools for stroke prediction. This abstract presents an investigation on Predicting stroke using machine learning algorithms. The study aims to evolve a model that can accurately identify human at risk of stroke based upon their demographic, clinical, and lifestyle factors. The dataset which is used for this study consists of a large cohort of patients, including both stroke and non-stroke cases, with detailed information on various risk factors. ML algorithms, including logistic regression, XGBoost, BernoulliNB, and GaussianNB, are trained and evaluated on the dataset. Feature selection techniques are employed to identify the most significant risk factors contributing to stroke prediction. The investigation's findings show how effective different machine learning algorithms are at forecasting strokes. . The XGBoost models achieve high accuracy, sensitivity, and specificity in identifying individuals at risk of stroke as compared to LR Classifier, GaussianNB and BernoulliNB Classifier Model.

articleTitle: Comparative Analysis of Adiabatic Logic Circuits: Power Dissipation and Performance in FPGA and ASIC Implementations of ECRL and PFAL
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: This paper presents an investigation into the performance of adiabatic logic circuits, specifically PFAL and ECRL NAND and NOR gates, on FPGA and ASIC platforms. We evaluated power dissipation, area utilization, and reliability of analog, FPGA, and ASIC implementations. The power efficiency of PFAL circuits was significantly higher than that of ECRL circuits, particularly when MOSFET transistors were installed in NAND gates. The power dissipation of ECRL and PFAL circuits was significantly reduced for ASIC implementations compared to FPGA implementations. According to the results, adiabatic logic circuits such as ECRL and PFAL can be effectively incorporated into ASICs or optimized FPGA environments for energy-efficient computing. The development of alternative implementation techniques and circuit design refinements will be crucial to fully exploit the benefits of adiabatic logic across a variety of applications and technologies in the future. Our results show that our ASIC implementation of the adiabatic logic circuits outperforms traditional implementations in terms of the proposed design and achieves a performance of 0.16 ns with a <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$0.8917\mu W$</tex> on-chip power consumption at <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$29.569\mu 2$</tex> chip area.

articleTitle: Relevance of Queueing Theory in a Supermarket: A Case Study
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: This paper presents an analysis of a study that uses queueing theory to investigate the rate at which customers arrive and receive service in a supermarket over the course of one week during predetermined time intervals. The data collected over a one-week period includes the number of customers arriving at specific intervals, along with their corresponding service and arrival rates. To examine several performance variables and determine how frequently consumers waited in queue, the M/M/1 model is utilised and cost analyses are conducted to determine the waiting cost, the utilisation factor, and other relevant metrics. The study focused on peak days that were observed in the one-week data, such as Monday, Wednesday, Friday, and Saturday. The M/M/2 model is used as an assumptions model to determine which model was more suitable for the supermarket during the peak days. The result of this paper will provide insights into the effectiveness of the M/M/1 and M/M/2 models for predicting customer waiting times and resource utilisation at the supermarket. Based on the findings of this study, the supermarket will be able to make informed decisions about staffing and resource allocation during peak hours. This study provides insights for supermarket managers on how to optimise their queueing systems to improve t he customer experience and increase revenue.

articleTitle: Modified Cuk Converter With Bird Swarm Optimized PI Controller For Microgrid System
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: In this research, a Hybrid Renewable Energy System (HRES), specifically intended for a microgrid, is presented to lessen the substantial reliance of RE supplies on changes in atmospheric conditions. The entire globe is currently facing one of its most serious problems due to the effects of global warming and environmental degradation. Switching to RES, such as solar and wind, reduces emissions of carbon and helps to preventing the weather changing condition. As a way to provide stability over the intermittent and unreliable nature of both Wind Energy Conversion System (WECS) and PV, a Battery Energy Storage System (BESS) is integrated into the microgrid to ensure a steady and continuous supply of power. The Modified Cuk converter is designed to convert the PV output voltage to the desired level and it offers the outstanding effectiveness and high gain voltage. Further improvement of the converter working operation is achieved by using Bird Swarm Algorithm Proportional Integral (BSA-PI). Using a PWM rectifier operated by a PI controller, the AC output from a WECS constructed with a Doubly Fed Induction Generator (DFIG) is converted to DC output. A battery converter with bidirectional power flow capabilities is successfully used to charge and discharge the battery. A PI controller is used to operate the battery converter and manage the battery's State of Charge (SOC). The 3ϕ Voltage Source Inverter (VSI) is used to convert steady DC to AC voltage, and the LC filter is used to reduce harmonics. PI controller is also used to effectively synchronize the grid voltage. MATLAB platform is employed to validate the efficacy of proposed system.

articleTitle: A Text-Based Approach for Diagnosing Depression Using Social Media Texts
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: Depression is a mood health issue that can result in persistent feelings of melancholy, a lack of interest in once-enjoyable activities, and physical changes. While many other approaches, like watching facial expressions on video, listening to spoken emotions, reading written responses from the text, and measuring physiology with wearable technology have all been used in past times, multi-modal approaches have also produced encouraging results. This proposed research presents a unique approach for diagnosing depression using social media text data that combines the GloVe word embedding technology with a Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) neural network model. The method takes advantage of both methodologies strengths to represent social media text data as high-dimensional vectors and capture the temporal connections between words in the text. The work trained a GloVe model on a huge data-set of depression-related social site messages to develop high dimensional numerical vectors to the words. These embedding were then fed into an LSTM model, which classified the text as either depressive or non-depressive. The proposed method was tested on a data-set collected from reddit platform and achieved a classification accuracy of 95%. The findings show that the proposed approach for early diagnosis of depression using social media data is successful, and that it has real-world implications in mental health monitoring and intervention.

articleTitle: Prevention of Sand Theft Based on RSSI Based Relative Positioning and Tracking Approach
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: There are numerous areas that require an absolute solution to their technical issues. Sand theft prevention is the subject of this study. The world is filled with technology that can be explored, directed towards our field, and result in a fully developed process flow. This paper presents a better approach of using a hardware kit to monitor inside activities which is taking place in the sand mining area located nearby to bank-shore area [10]. Using RSSI Technology, this application is used to stop impending sand theft attacks. Insider SAND theft attacks cannot be stopped by standard security measures such as encrypting - decrypting. This paper outlines a strategy for thwarting insider data theft attacks using a specific tracking technology. The technology in this case is carried out by building a prototype based on a web pattern, validating the efficacy of the technology. This application senses unauthorised access, thereby raising various alerts and thwarts on suspects, aimed at ceasing any attempt of theft. Thus, insider theft is prevented.

articleTitle: Power Management of Hybrid Microgrid with Energy Storage System
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: This paper introduces an enhanced power flow strategy for a Hybrid AC-DC Microgrid using Energy Storage when the grid is subject to a pulse load. This study examines the management of renewable like solar, wind system with battery storage. This proposed Microgrid operates autonomously, i.e. in islanding mode. A bidirectional AC-DC-AC inverter links the AC and DC sides of the grid. The hybrid system operates normally under normal conditions, yet the system fails completely when under load disturbance. A Li-ion battery bank is linked to the DC grid as an alternative power source to deal with load disruptions. In order to keep the whole system running smoothly regardless of the load, we propose using coordinate control algorithms to regulate the flow of power between the AC and DC grids. Matlab/Simulink is used to model the complete system. Using a pulse load influence & intermittent weather condition, the simulation results reveal that the suggested system provides stable operation.

articleTitle: IoT based PV Monitoring System Using Modified KY Converter with Cascaded ANFIS -MPPT Controller
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: In this work, a novel, highly efficient Modified KY converter for renewable applications such as solar system is proposed. The modified KY converter accomplish a maximum power conversion ratio in the recommended topology without utilize of coupled inductors. The suggested converter has a larger gain voltage that is attained with a sufficient duty factor as compared to the traditional converters like boost, Single Ended Primary Inductance Converter (SEPIC), Zeta, buck-boost and Cuk. To enhance the converter working functionality, the Cascaded Adaptive Neuro Fuzzy System (ANFIS) Maximum Power Point Tracking (MPPT) is established in this work. With the help of Cascaded ANFIS-MPPT, the maximal power tracked from the Photovoltaic (PV) system. The Voltage Source Inverter (VSI), which is managed by employing dq theory and PI controller, also it is effectively synchronizes the PV power produced to the grid. Furthermore, continuous monitoring of variables affecting the reliability and performance of grid-tied PV systems is done through the Internet of Things (IoT). After the conversion of DC voltage into AC voltage, it is passed through a 1 Φ VSI. Finally, the acquired AC power is fed to the 1Φ grid for further applications. Utilizing MATLAB Simulink for developing the suggested system, an efficiency of 96% with lower THD is achieved.

articleTitle: Empowering Special Education Through Information Technology
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: Integrating Information Technology into special education has become increasingly important in supporting students with disabilities. Assistive technology tools and devices have the potential to enhance the learning experience, improve academic achievement, and increase independence for students with special needs. This paper examines the importance of IT in special education to support disabled students, focusing on the benefits and challenges of technology use. For students with disabilities, assistive technology can offer a variety of advantages, including assisting them in overcoming communication, mobility, or sensory challenges and enhancing their access to knowledge and educational resources. For instance, students with visual impairments can use assistive technology tools like text-to-speech software and screen readers to access course materials and complete assignments. In contrast, students with communication challenges can benefit from speech recognition software.

articleTitle: Mobile Application Enabling Citizen Report Street Problems
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: The lethargicness among the corporation in solving the issues and problems in the local residential areas have resulted in a drastic rise in the street problems like faulty street lights, electricity problem, bad conditioned roads, stagnant water and many in which most of the issues are not being addressed properly and some issues are not even being reported. Since the complaints registered by the residents regarding the problems faced in their street are not addressed properly, people feel unmotivated to make complaints and give voice for their peaceful living. The impact of the current state of issue in local residential areas might result in irritation and conflicts among local residents. The project aims at achieving an ideal state where residents do not feel irritated in reporting any issues faced and are assured of the rectification of their complaints in a timely manner.

articleTitle: IoT Based Real Time Energy Billing and Monitoring
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: Our aim of the project is to create an automatic energy monitoring and billing system through a cayenne application. Our point is to lessen month to month bill by remote innovation and from distant area straightforwardly to power charging office. By doing these human hours and endeavors are diminished which are expected to visit each home in our current framework. To enable a client and server relationship through IOT and EB office can screen the energy meter of all purchase homes on continuous premise. By doing these human hours and endeavors are diminished which are expected to visit each home in our current framework. Our flow framework for charge installment is postpaid framework and disadvantage of the flow bill installment framework is there is no control on clients connected with utilization of power. We realize that the stockpile of force is restricted and as a capable resident it's our obligation to involve it in proficient manner. This paper “IoT BASED REAL TIME ENERGY BILLING AND MONITORING” intend to plan a framework for charge installment to diminish mistakes and IOT based energy meter. This remote meter could be used in businesses, household, and so on.

articleTitle: Design of a 7 Element Yagi Uda Antenna for tracking LoRA based Satellites operating at 433MHz
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: A 7 Element Yagi Uda Antenna for tracking of LoRA based satellites operating at 433 MHz is proposed. A Ground station that uses Internet of things to track the satellite was also built along with the Antenna. The 7 element Yagi was designed and simulated using 4NEC2 software and the basic parameters such as gain, reflection coefficient and SWR was obtained. Later the Antenna was Built physically and interfaced with the Open source platform that tracks all the LoRA based satellite was implemented. The Satellites that pass through VJIT Ground station were tracked and beacon signals were obtained successfully.

articleTitle: Comparative Analysis of Operational Transconductance Amplifiers (OTA) for Biomedical Applications
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: A common analogue processing unit is the operational transconductance amplifier (OTA). Most recently, applications in biology have benefited from the producing of OTA with exceptionally low power, low voltage, low connectivity and high accuracy. The present investigation reviews the interaction amongst the use of energy and the reliability of CMOS OTA practices for medical or low frequency purposes, as indicated in a number of literature publications. Considerations for OTA comparison includes a linear manner, technological advances, supply voltage, power consumption, frequency, and how they are utilized in the processing of biomedical signals. Future researchers will benefit from this text as they work to improve OTA for low frequency, linearity, and biological applications.

articleTitle: Design of Green Indoor Light-Fidelity System Using Spatial LED-Based Wavelength Division Multiplexing
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: This paper presents the design and performance analysis of green Light-Fidelity (Li-Fi) transmitter using spatial light-emitting diode (LED)-based wavelength division multiplexing (WDM) system. By using the WDM technique, white light illumination and high-capacity data transmissions have been enabled in the Li-Fi transmission system. The proposed system is capable of transmitting the data with a very minimal hardware modification at the aggregate rate of 300 Mbps for the link length of 10 m. The analysis has been carried out in terms of the spectral power distribution (SPD), Quality factor (Q-factor), bit error rate (BER) and eye diagrams. The Q factor of the received data streams is above 6 and BER is below 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">−10</sup>. These high-quality data transmissions are carried out at the transmission power of 265 m W, and therefore the normalized energy efficiency of 1.132 Mbps/mW is attained with the carbon footprint (CFP) reduction of 12.25 kg CO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>/kWh. These results have proven that the proposed system is a promising green alternative for wireless-fidelity (Wi-Fi) in the indoor environment.

articleTitle: SkySentinel: Harnessing AI for Cloudburst Forecasting and Warning
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: The location and timing of cloudbursts in and around the hilly regions are difficult to predict. The majority of reported cloudbursts are hazardous and destructive, making it difficult to observe them. The majority of these incidents are documented after they have had an impact on the habitats downstream in terms of human and property loss. Additionally, they frequently result from flash floods as a result of heavy precipitation. The primary notion of a cloudburst is related to an abrupt intense downpour of precipitation across a relatively small region in a very short period of time. Nothing else is known about these events outside this knowledge and the Indian Meteorology Department's (IMD) description of N100 mm/h precipitation across an area of about 20 to 30 sq.km. There haven't been many studies done on how to comprehend these events. It is discovered that orographically locked systems follow convectively induced cloudburst events. Cloudburst occurrences are produced by these interconnected systems. The cloudburst mechanism won't form if any one of these mechanisms is absent. This study introduces an intelligent system that can forecast cloud bursts and warn residents of at-risk areas. With the aid of data science and artificial intelligence, various factors such as pressure, humidity, rainfall intensity, temperature, etc. are tracked and analysed. By analysing the events that took place in the village of Koottickal, we were inspired to design a system that could predict cloudbursts so that people could move to safer locations.

articleTitle: Investigating the Realm of Big Data Analytics within Social Networking Platforms
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: The widespread usage of social networking sites has resulted in an immense volume of data being generated and shared by users worldwide. This vast amount of data, known as big data, presents significant opportunities for extracting valuable insights and knowledge. Big data analytics techniques have emerged as powerful tools to explore and derive meaningful information from social networking data. The research emphasizes the importance of efficient data processing techniques, scalable algorithms, and advanced analytics methods to handle the massive volumes of data generated by social networking sites. It outlines the key components involved in big data analytics, such as data collection, data storage, data preprocessing, data analysis, and data visualization. Additionally, the abstract touches upon the ethical and privacy concerns associated with big data analytics in social networking sites. It emphasizes the need for responsible data handling practices and the protection of user privacy rights. Through this exploration of big data analytics in social networking sites, this paper aims to provide a comprehensive overview of the field, highlight the potential benefits and challenges, and serve as a guide for researchers and practitioners interested in leveraging big data analytics to gain insights from social networking data.

articleTitle: T1-Weighted Magnetic Resonance Imaging for Automatic Stroke Lesion Segmentation
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: Stroke is a major cerebrovascular disease, and as such, segmentation of lesions associated with stroke on MR images is of great interest to the medical imaging sector. Stroke lesion segmentation using magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) is a crucial step in determining the cause and severity of stroke symptoms. Our research proposes a deep learning architecture called 3D-Unet, which utilizes T1-weighted MRI images to differentiate stroke lesions. The 3D-Unet framework is developed as a 3D-compatible variation of the well-known U-Net structure. Using a skip-connected encoder-decoder network, high-resolution segmentation of volumetric data may be achieved. We used an ATLAS dataset annotated by radiologists to train our model on W1 MRI images with ground truth segmentation masks. Results demonstrate that the suggested 3D-Unet model provides state-of-the-art effectiveness in segmenting stroke lesions with a mean Dice coefficient of 0.81. Stroke lesion locations and sizes were successfully identified by the model, providing important information for medical practitioners. Promising results have been achieved by the suggested model in medical imaging segmentation tasks.

articleTitle: Effectual Sun Tracking Solar Panel System
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: The main aim of this project is to produce efficient energy from the solar panel. Sun moves continuously from its position so the sunlight fall on the panel is changing. It causes solar panel produce low energy. In this project solar panel tracks the sun position. Solar panel moves frequently towards the position of the sun. This technology helps for producing maximum energy. And also, this technology is cost efficient and require less hardware. This is great advantage of implementing this system. Construction of this system is not complex. In this system use two sensor and one microcontroller. So, the power consumption is less.

articleTitle: A Novel Fast Mask Recurrent Convolutional Neural Network Developed to Detect the Accurate Location of PCG Murmur
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: Early detection of Valvular Heart Disorders (VHD) enables the best possible treatment & delays the onset of cardio illnesses. In this regard, the research made here examines the effectiveness of deep learning methods in Phonocardiography (PCG) data for the detection of VHD. An open-access collection of information containing 4 main VHDs such as first beat, systole, second cardiac murmur & diastolic pressure was used to generate PCG cardiac murmur. The cardiac murmur & sound collection of heart categorization cardiac murmur acoustic challenge by Pattern Classification, Statistic Modeling, & Computation Training have been the two cardiac murmur collections researchers analyzed. To understand the optical & time-dependent aspects of the murmur in PCG waveforms, develop a novel Fast Mask Recurrent Convolutional Neural Network (FMRCNN) based Bidirectional Long Short Term Memory (BiLSTM). The proposed system was given a set of sound features to distinguish between the regular & sound classes. The proposed approach was validated through 5-fold cross-validation on a sizable sample, yielding an F1 Score of 98% with sensitivity and precision of 96% & 100%, correspondingly.

Author Keywords: Fast Mask Recurrent Convolutional Neural Network

articleTitle: Design and Analyze of Coordinated Control of Hybrid PV-Wind Power Generation System
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: The energy which is produced using conventional sources has done an irreparable damage to the environment. So, to ameliorate the existing conditions, it is very much needed to come up with methodologies which are environmentally friendly and which reduce our dependence on these conventional sources of energy. The proposed project is an attempt in this direction. It combines solar and wind energy systems, which is currently called as Hybrid System, to produce electricity for meeting the existing energy demand and to supply electric power to the needful areas, it can also interface with the utility power grid if surplus power is produced. This approach is yet to acquire commercial dimension in India. In the project, independently a load will be met by photovoltaic and wind energy system. Project proposes an algorithm for tracking maximum power output and simulation will be accepted for analyze the results. The project also aims to integrate the solar photovoltaic (SPV) with wind energy conversion schemes to meet consumer load and also design a supervisory control method for wind energy system to regulate both active power and reactive power towards the load, and further analyze the system steadiness in grid-connected mode.

articleTitle: Cardiovascular Disease Prediction Using Randelistic Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: Diagnosis of heart diseases pose a major problem due to human error and faulty interpretation of data. Existing medical tools are costly and has a higher percentage of true negatives, and do not fare well in the areas of prediction., putting people at danger due to carelessness. Timely prediction plays an important role in saving patient's lives. Prediction models like these which use Machine Learning can be used in Hospitals and as well as for personal use to reduce the number of cases of True Negative due to diagnostic negligence and to keep track of various symptoms over a period of time that acts as a detailed history to improve accuracy of the learning model designed using various mathematically intensive algorithms. The solution proposed is to use multiple algorithms namely Logistic Regression[1], Random Forest Algorithm[1] and Decision trees[1] in the Boosting process, so as to reduce the number true negatives and false positives and get the best result during the majority voting.

articleTitle: The Optimist: An User Choice-Aware Mobile Application Featuring Entrepreneur Support, Entrepreneur Selection, and Investor Assistance
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: The entrepreneur plays a crucial role in a country's socio-economic growth by creating new jobs, businesses, wealth, services, and products. However, the current works on entrepreneur selection for funding, entrepreneur support, and best investor selection are mainly focused on offline-based selection, rather than user demand-aware online-based selection. The offline-based entrepreneur support system suffers from huge delays and cost-consuming problems. To surpass the existing challenges, this work develops a user choice-aware mobile application with entrepreneur support, suitable entrepreneur selection, and investor selection feature for funding facilities for the Bangladeshi people. The user experience analysis revealed that more than 70% users rated the proposed application features as better than the existing works.

articleTitle: Intelligent Malware Detection System Based on Behavior Analysis in Cloud Computing Environment
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: IBMD(Intelligent Behavior-Based Malware Detection) aims to detect and mitigate malicious activities in cloud computing environments by analyzing the behavior of cloud resources, such as virtual machines, containers, and applications. The system uses different machine learning methods like deep learning and artificial neural networks, to analyze the behavior of cloud resources and detect anomalies that may indicate malicious activity. The IBMD system can also monitor and accumulate the data from various resources, such as network traffic and system logs, to provide a comprehensive view of the behavior of cloud resources. IBMD is designed to operate in a cloud computing environment, taking advantage of the scalability and flexibility of the cloud to detect malware and respond to security incidents. The system can also be integrated with existing security tools and services, such as firewalls and intrusion detection systems, to provide a comprehensive security solution for cloud computing environments.

articleTitle: Secured Health Monitoring System Using Optimized Block Chain Framework
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: The development and execution of a health monitoring system utilizing an Internet of Things (IoT) are presented in this research. Nowadays, with an explosion of innovations, experts are constantly searching for advanced technology to make it simpler to identify body abnormalities. Technologies that support the IoT make it possible to build revolutionary, non-invasive clinical assistance systems. A mechanism for monitoring health care is presented in this study. It is crucial for sick people to have IoT-driven remote health monitoring systems that is act as careers in an emergency. The amount of data that needs to be gathered, handled, and transferred limits these applications. IoT applications are made possible by aspects including robustness, privacy, security, and dependability. This paper proposes an IoT-based health monitoring system that stores patients' health data in a block chain module. In the medical field, the block chain is used to transmit data securely between highly disparate medical facilities by allowing patient authorization. A Modified Particle Swam Optimization algorithm (MPSO) is utilized to select the shortest path for data transmission. Datasets of patients are protected against security threats by ANN-based Intrusion Detection Systems (ANN-IDS). The recommended ANN-IDS efficiently detect the attacks including Probe attack, DoS attack and U2R attack. By the implementation of MPSO, the shortest path determined efficiently. ANN based IDS is capable of accurately classifying possible threats in the dataset.

articleTitle: Breast Cancer Prediction Using Deep Learning Models
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: Breast cancer is a serious health issue affecting millions of women worldwide, and early detection is essential for successful treatment. In this study, we propose a breast cancer prediction model that utilizes machine learning algorithms to accurately predict the likelihood of breast cancer in patients. Our dataset includes clinical and demographic information of patients, such as age, family history, and mammography results. We preprocess the data and use feature engineering techniques to extract relevant information. We apply various machine learning algorithms, such as logistic regression, decision trees, random forest, and support vector machines, to develop the breast cancer prediction model. We evaluate the performance of the model using metrics such as accuracy, sensitivity, and specificity. Our results show that the proposed breast cancer prediction model achieved high accuracy and sensitivity in identifying patients at high risk of breast cancer. The model can be used by healthcare professionals to identify patients who require further screening and follow-up. Our breast cancer prediction model offers a valuable tool for early detection and diagnosis of breast cancer, potentially leading to improved outcomes and survival rates.

articleTitle: Crop Recommendation System Using Fusion Model in Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: In this paper efficient, highly accurate and low error rate a crop recommendation system developed using a fusion model. farmers choose crops based on their previous experience. Due to the changes in climatic condition they cannot have enough production from their farm. So here commendation system is developed for farmers to predict suitable crops based on climatic and soil conditions. The proposed system work with the help of a fusion model with a weighted average and voting classifier. By analyzing the accuracy of the 2 methods weighted average has the highest accuracy of 99.9%.

articleTitle: Prepaid Energy Billing System using Global System for Mobile Communication
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: Thisarticle spotlights the implementation of prepaid billing systemsfor energy consumption. Prepaid billing is used in this method, making users aware of their energy consumption patterns and assisting them in making plans for more economical consumption. The ATMEGA 328P Microcontroller, a GSM Modem and RS485 are employed by this device for calculation, data transfer and firmware upgrades. This device is simple to use, encourages users to be aware of how much energy they use and aids with the preservation of the earth's finite electrical energy supplies. When all of the pre-paid billing units have been used, this system will immediately disconnect the load. As a result, it reduces the need for labor resources, making the system more dependable and precise.

articleTitle: Design and Development of an Efficient Electrolyser for Low-Cost Hydrogen Production
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: One of the most popular processes for creating hydrogen gas with a high degree of purity is water electrolysis, but its use is restricted because of its poor energy efficiency. The efficiency of producing hydrogen from water electrolysis while using less energy has been demonstrated to be enhanced by an external magnetic field. A perpendicular magnetic field can be applied to electrodes of various magnetism for use in the electrolysis of water to produce hydrogen. The electrode is placed in a vertical orientation inside the generator to enhance the hydrogen production. Inorder to avoid the deposition of salts in the electrode plates, a signal generator is used which will produce a high frequency impulse and is passed to the plates which will eliminate the salts present in the electrode plates.

articleTitle: Review of Maximum Power Point Tracking Based Novel Converters Used in EV Application
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: The usage of renewable energy plays a significant part to make a pollution-free environment. The best solution for regulating DC voltage and maximising the performance of RES is to employ DC-DC converters. A Maximum Power Point Tracking (MPPT) controller is used to monitor Photovoltaic (PV) panel's maximum output power. Here, an evaluation is done to identify the most effective controller acting as MPPT with Converter is discussed. An evaluation of several dc-dc converter models took into account a number of factors, including price, the materials utilised, current ripple, and efficiency. Lastly, we demonstrate comparative analysis to find out the most effective conversion for PV-fed applications. From the comparison result, the Artificial Neural Network (ANN) technique obtained better tracking accuracy for MPPT method.

articleTitle: Hyperledger Blockchain and Lightweight Bcrypt Symmetric Key Encryption to Boost Cloud Computing Security Effectiveness
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: One of the key business models of contemporary information technology is cloud computing. It offers users a range of services (hardware, software) with little user engagement and at a reasonable price. Utilising a cloud environment raises several challenges, chief among them being security and privacy. This study explores the issues and proposes a Lightweight Bcrypt Symmetric Key (LBSK) data encryption and decryption technique with key rotation. A variety of algorithms and Blockchain technologies are used to protect the information. Encryption is one of the most fascinating features of data security technology. An Aggregated Authority Certificate Provider (AACP) is recommended with blockchain authentication for secured cloud data audit, which lessens the burden on the data owner. The suggested AACP continuously runs on a cloud server and tracks user requests. For the non-trusted provider, the Hyperledger blockchain proxy re-encrypts data to increase protection and privacy. The Blockchain algorithm was used to encrypt the data from beginning to end, and it was then saved in the cloud. Without storing the data locally, a security degree, public verification, and performance factors must be taken into consideration. Compared to current methods, the proposed strategy is intended to deliver a better result. The Blockchain technique was used to encrypt the data from beginning to end, and it was then saved on the cloud. Public verification and performance considerations raise the security level for remote data verification without storing the data locally. In comparison to current methods, the proposed method offers a better result.

articleTitle: Investigation of Integrated Bidirectional Converter with Eight Switch Inverter for Electric Vehicle Application
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: An efficient EV can be made as an impressive eco-friendly option. In order to achieve this highly reliable bi-directional converters are required. The aim of this work is to investigate integrated Bidirectional Interleaved Converter along with an eight-switch inverter. The eight-switch inverter allows bidirectional flow of power. The interleaved converter connects the low voltage battery pack and the inverter. These have some of the advantages like cancellation of ripples due to current splitting, higher efficiency of system, high power density. The eight-switch inverter facilitates an additional single- phase output.

articleTitle: Detection and Classification of DDoS Attacks in Cloud Data Using Hybrid LSTM and RNN for Feature Selection
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: Cyber threats are the main source of concern in the sector it is deployed. DDoS attacks are at the very top of the list. The rapid growth of cloud migration also expands the attack surface. Different forms of DDoS attacks exist, such as DoS and DDoS etc., There are several existing machine learning algorithms to detect DDoS attacks. There are also many hybrids of machine learning algorithms which are introduced for detecting DDoS attacks to increase the accurateness of detection. Here we use hybrid Long Short-Term Memory Network (LSTM) and Recurrent Neural Network (RNN) for feature selection and deliver an improved detection system. The proposed exploratory model of Multi-layer Perceptron (MLP) classifiers uses deep neural network algorithms. The final outcome shows higher accuracy and precision by dealing with a huge dataset that was gathered. The accuracy and precision of 98.85% and 92 % respectively for grouping in structure.

articleTitle: Deep Learning-Based Diabetic Retinopathy Detection Using ResNet34 Model
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: Using the APTOS 2019 dataset and ResNet-34 architecture, this study presents an approach utilizing deep learning for classification of retinal images. Diabetes-related retinopathy and age-related macular degeneration are among the leading causes of blindness, and early detection is crucial for effective treatment. Convolutional neural networks (CNNs) have been shown to extract meaningful features from retinal images and accurately classify them by severity. In this study, the model was trained and validated using high-quality retinal images with varying disease severity from the APTOS 2019 dataset. ResNet-34, a 34-layer deep learning model renowned for image recognition, was used in the experiment. The model was trained on Google Colab using the PyTorch deep learning framework, with a batch size of 32 and 20 epochs. The introduced method demonstrated robust performance across various evaluation metrics, such as exactitude, recall, harmonized metric, Area Under the Receiver Operating Characteristic Curve (AUC ROC), and correct classification ability. Results showed that the proposed method accurately predicted the target variable. The study also presents loss and accuracy plots, confusion matrices, and AUC ROC plots, which provide a comprehensive analysis of the performance of the model which can be taken as a suggestion for improvement.

articleTitle: Recurrent Neural Network Based Harmonic Reduction and AI Based Voltage Stability Compensation in Distribution Feeder System
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: The Flexible AC transmission system devices are used to address power quality problems for distributed generating systems in hopes of reducing the problem. This article has a detailed overview of the problems with electricity quality. The power quality challenges are covered first in this paper, then the fundamental criteria are covered. This paper proposes an effective Distribution Static Synchronous Compensator of control approaches for reducing power quality. Techniques for monitoring power superiority and potential fixes for problems with power quality for power structures are thoroughly investigated. In this proposed the control approaches contains 2 Voltage source converter (VSC) circuits. The DC link voltage across the proposed DSTSTCOM is maintained constant with the help of ANN controller. The output of simulated MATLAB and the corresponding waveform are attained. The suggested converters is generating to reduce the settling value of 0.15s.

articleTitle: A Novel Single Phase Sinewave Inverter for a Solar Powered Home
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: Clean energy sources have grown in popularity in recent years due to their widespread availability and low environmental impact. The most popular method of energy gathering is solar energy. Solar energy is pollution free as well as maintenance-free. As a part of solar insulation PV module is mounted on roofs etc., which produce DC. A solar converter transforms DC supply to AC power. This can be used for domestic and commercial applications. The solar inverter has dual use ie, it can operate in grid-tied mode and standalone mode. When the Maximum Power Point Tracking (MPPT) is incorporated with an inverter the charging time of a battery takes 30% less time. The paper describes the standalone mode solar inverter using MPPT and charges control techniques. In MATLAB/Simulink, the simulation is run, and the outcomes are checked.

articleTitle: Ensemble Model for Seven-class Categorization of Skin Disease using Dermoscopy Images
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: The skin is the largest organ and has an essential defensive role in the body. Skin diseases can be either genetic or environmental, and can affect people of all ages, ethnicities, and sexes. A dermatologist is the best medical professional to see for skin problems since they can examine the whole person and take their medical history into account. When abnormalities in the skin are discovered early, especially in the case of skin cancer, the prognosis drastically improves. Because of this, this research proposes an ensemble model consisting of ResN et50 and Convolution Neural Network (CNN) for the multi-class categorization of skin illness using dermoscopy images. The HAM10000 dataset is used, which consists of 10015, dermoscopy images of skin classified into 7 -groups. Accuracy is measured at 0.972, while precision averages 0.911.

articleTitle: Metaheuristic Optimization Based PI Controlled Interleaved Cuk Converter in PV System
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: Photovoltaic installation is consistently increasing around the world due to the leading access to the electrical grid. An enormous amount of work is put into process to operate Photovoltaic (PV) at its best. Power electronic interfaces are used to link the distributed sources to the load. However, the power quality is deteriorating due to the intermittent nature of PV. Hence, this paper aims to attain stable DC-link voltage of Interleaved Cuk Converter (ICC) with optimal control strategy. Interleaved Cuk converter is employed in this proposed approach which produces improved voltage gain due to the output voltage and current having less of a ripple content and the source current ripple being eliminated. To maintain the converter's output voltage, two optimal tuning techniques such as whale optimization and cuckoo search algorithm are used to tune the parameters of PI controller which assist to gain maintained DC-link voltage without any distortions and ripples from the converter. Using simulation data from the MATLAB, the performance of this system is validated.

Author Keywords: Cuckoo Search (CS) optimization based PI controller

articleTitle: Artificial Intelligence Based Reduced Switch Multilevel Inverter For Grid Connected PV Applications
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: Due to the rise in computer power, tools, and data collection, artificial intelligence (AI) is becoming more and more prevalent in diverse photovoltaic (PV) system applications. The basics of grid-connected multilevel inverters for PV systems is provided, together with information on the drivers, characteristics, evaluation criteria, topologies, modulation schemes, and selection criteria for various applications. The results of a thorough reliability investigation of basic 15L multilevel inverter (MLI) are examined in this study. The inverter is the most crucial component of a grid-connected PV system. This study provides a survey of the system topologies and grid-connected PV inverters utilized for PV systems linked to the grid.

articleTitle: Optimizing Monthly Tilt and Azimuth Angles of Photovoltaic Panels in Brunei Darussalam
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: This article investigates the bimonthly optimization strategy for determining the azimuthal and inclination angles of solar panels in Brunei Darussalam using the Particle Swarm Optimization (PSO) Strategy. The optimal monthly tilt angles are compared to those obtained from other methods, yielding positive results. To verify the optimal monthly tilt angles generated using the PSO algorithm, an experiment is performed to compare the output of a solar panel inclined at an angle of zero degrees. A wireless data acquisition system was designed and constructed and employed in the experiment to collect data from the solar panel. The experiment was performed during July and August of 2022, and the optimal monthly tilt angles were 24.57°and 14.31°respectively, both North facing. Comparisons are made for the output of the solar panel in the optimal monthly tilt angle at 0°, and the results are found satisfactory as the solar panel generated more power when tilted at the optimal monthly inclination angle.

articleTitle: Suicidal Ideation Prediction Using Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: Suicide has become a leading factor in death globally. The rate of suicides is sharply increasing with every passing year. It is important to note that suicidal ideation is a complex issue that cannot be solely attributed to a single factor or mental disorder. According to reports, the primary components that go into suicide ideation are depression, anxiety, high levels of stress, unsatisfactory relationships, sleep disturbances, and physical or mental impairments. Therefore, it is essential to consider a holistic approach that considers multiple factors when predicting suicidal ideation. Our proposed work uses machine learning techniques to foresee suicide ideation utilizing a sizable example of review information. After collecting the data using a labelled dataset, we preprocessed and trained it on various machine learning models such as Random Forest (RF), Logistic Regression (LR), Support Vector Machines (SVM), and Decision Tree (DT). The results showed that among the calculated models LR gives the best result with 76% accuracy, followed by SVM (75%), MLP (74%), RF (74%), DT (74%). The proposed framework is vital to the clinical business and thus the well-being of our society.

articleTitle: Time-Series Cryptocurrency Forecasting Using Ensemble Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: Cryptocurrency is now widely accepted as a payment and exchange method, permeating nearly every aspect of the financial sector. Similar to the non-stationary and very erratic price movements of traditional stocks, cryptocurrency price swings are highly unpredictable. The rising popularity of cryptocurrencies has prompted an increase in the number of studies conducted to predict their future prices. The importance of cryptocurrency forecasting has grown significantly with the advent of deep learning. portfolio optimisation and decision making cannot be achieved without the creation of a smart forecasting model. The primary contribution of this study is the utilize of traditional deep learning (DL) models in combination with the three most popular ensemble learning algorithms (ensemble-averaging, bagging, and stacking) to predict the hourly values of major cryptocurrencies. Traditional DL strategies consisting of combinations of long short-term memory (LSTM), Bi-directional (BiLSTM), and convolutional layers were utilized to assess the suggested ensemble methods. The ensemble techniques were tested on their capacity to forecast the price of a cryptocurrency an hour basis (regression) and to determine whether the price will rise or fall relative to the present (classification). Our in-depth experimental research shows that combining ensemble learning with deep learning can produce robust, stable, and trustworthy forecasting strategies.

articleTitle: Architecture for AI-Based Validation of Wastewater Management Using Open Data Exchange Technique
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: To processing plant-wide data, it is not uncommon for there to be issues with sensors. Some examples of these issues include sensor failures, sensor calibration difficulties, sensor fouling and blockage, and connection problems between sensors, actuators, and the data management system. These problems may have an effect on the quality of the data, which will make it more difficult to implement sophisticated data-driven monitoring and control of (crucial) water operations. A method for the intelligent validation of data is provided in this article. The sensor data coming from a wastewater treatment plant are validated and verified by this process. The application for data validation has been integrated, tested, and put into production at the water utility known as Water Net. The method of validation is predicated on an anomaly detector that, in the event that an anomaly is found, combines (statistical) threshold-based procedures, (AI-based) autoencoder model predictions, and a component for data reconciliation. This occurrence repeats itself whenever an anomaly of some kind is found. In spite of the signal's volatility, the autoencoder models displayed outstanding levels of accuracy and great reconciliation performance. In addition, signals for both verified and raw data are provided in a way that is extremely near to real time to a dashboard. This keeps the dashboard up to date with the most recent information. Validated data may also be utilized as a screening tool for data that is being ingested by another AI-based model in order to monitor and intelligently manage the wastewater treatment plant, as well as to minimize greenhouse gas emissions and energy consumption while maintaining effluent water quality requirements. These goals may be accomplished while still meeting all applicable criteria. If this were done, it would be in compliance with the regulations for maintaining the effluent water's quality.

articleTitle: Artificial Intelligence based Models to Support Water Quality Prediction using Machine Learning Approach
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: The purpose of this study is to simulate the propagation of bio-contamination risk in Water Distribution System (WDS). This will be accomplished by putting an emphasis on source identification and response modelling. This will be accomplished in the WDS via the process of simulating the bio-contamination risk propagation under real environmental circumstances. This will be done in order to accomplish this goal. Due to the failure to take into consideration the ability for the bulk of the pollutants to undergo chemical degradation and the neglecting of dynamic responses, an overestimation of the population that is exposed has resulted. The study presented here takes into account the connected change in a variety of water quality indicators that are caused by the mixing of the pollutants. These measurements include the total organic carbon content, pH, and alkalinity. In practise, the baseline requirements for each of the aforementioned metrics are set at the beginning of the regular WDS monitoring. Contamination is then indicated by considerable deviations from the base line. The study's goal was to determine whether it is feasible to develop a smart monitoring system powered by artificial intelligence (AI) that would successfully enable water operators to ensure near real-time quality control for the early detection of chemical and/or biological pollution and risk management. The study's goal was to see whether it was possible to develop an artificial intelligence (AI)-based smart monitoring system. The study's purpose was to investigate the viability of building a sophisticated monitoring system that would allow water operators to perform quality control in near real time. Artificial Neural Networks (ANN) and other sophisticated pattern recognizers like Support Vector Machines (SVMs) are examples of cutting-edge sensor technologies that have been implemented as solutions to identify anomalies and estimate the severity of such irregularities.

articleTitle: Sustainable Global Democratic e-Governance System Using Vedic Scripture, Artificial Intelligence, Cloud Computing and Augmented Reality
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: The proposed system incorporates Vedic text, artificial intelligence, cloud computing, and augmented reality to build a sustainable and global democratic e-governance paradigm. Ethical standards are based on the teachings of the Vedas, and the effectiveness of governance procedures is increased through the use of cloud computing and AI technologies. In order to give citizens a more immersive and participatory experience when using government services, augmented reality is used. By allowing citizens to participate in decision-making via online forums and social media platforms, the approach also strives to promote openness and accountability. The system aims to build a more effective and moral form of governance that empowers citizens and encourages sustainable development by integrating these technology and ideas.

articleTitle: Agriculture Breakthrough: Federated ConvNets for Unprecedented Maize Disease Detection and Severity Estimation
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: Maize is an important crop all over the globe, producing food, animal feed, and raw materials for various businesses. However, maize production is jeopardized by many diseases that may reduce output and decrease grain quality. Traditional disease detection and control procedures have had slight effectiveness, prompting the development of new tactics to assure long-term maize production. Machine learning and artificial intelligence (AI) developments, notably convolutional neural networks (CNNs), have shown promise in crop disease identification and diagnosis. Nonetheless, the decentralized structure of agriculture poses difficulties for traditional CNNs, which need centralized data for training. Federated learning (FL), a distributed learning paradigm, overcomes these issues by allowing model training on decentralized, private data. In this work, to explore the efficacy of an FL CNN model in recognizing and diagnosing maize illnesses using a dataset of 9,586 maize leaf pictures from diverse farms and locations with varied disease categories and severity levels. The suggested FL CNN model outperformed traditional CNNs and other machine learning approaches typically used in agriculture regarding accuracy, precision, recall, and F1-score in identifying and categorizing maize illnesses and their severity levels. The FL method can increase disease diagnosis, adjust to geographical changes, and protect data privacy, making it a viable option for real-world maize disease detection and management.

articleTitle: Revolutionizing Cassava Leaf Disease Detection with Federated Learning CNN and Multi-Level Severity Assessment
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: Cassava is an indispensable commodity for millions of people around the globe, serving as a significant source of calories and nutrients. However, cassava leaf diseases pose a significant risk to the yield and productivity of the crop. In this study, To proposed a privacy-protecting federated learning CNN model for classifying cassava leaf disease severity levels. The model was trained on 9,675 images representing four severity levels: normal, mild, moderate, and severe. Using federated learning, the model enabled multiple farms or organizations to train the model collaboratively using their respective datasets without sharing raw images, thereby addressing data privacy concerns and enhancing the model's generalizability. The federated learning CNN model obtained an overall accuracy of 0.95 and an F1-score of 0.91875, indicating a lively performance in classifying cassava leaf diseases with varying degrees of severity. The model demonstrated exceptionally high precision and recall rates for the healthy and severe classes while revealing room for development in differentiating between the mild and moderate severity levels. Compared to traditional CNN models and other machine learning methods, the federated learning CNN model demonstrated competitive performance, addressing data privacy concerns and benefiting from diverse data sources. These results indicate that the privacy-protecting federated learning CNN model has the potential to be an effective solution for cassava leaf disease classification in real-world agricultural scenarios, ultimately leading to enhanced disease management and crop yields.

articleTitle: Apple Leaf Disease Recognition: A Robust Federated Learning CNN Methodology
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: Apple leaf diseases threaten apple orchard sustain ability and production worldwide. Accurate and early identification is essential for the successful care and control of many disorders. This article suggests a convolutional neural network (CNN) model for classifying apple leaf diseases based on federated learning. Using a dataset of 7,832 photos with a resolution of 224×224 pixels and five distinct classes of apple leaf disease, the model is intended to identify these diseases. Assuring data confidentiality and privacy, the federated learning architecture enables decentralized model training across several clients. The suggested model was tested on four customers, and the results showed that the model's precision, recall, and accuracy ranged from 93.51% to 94.92%, 93.22% to 94.72%, 93.33% to 94.81%, and 0.97 to 0.98, respectively. These findings show how the federated learning CNN model outperforms alternative deep learning architectures and conventional machine learning techniques in identifying apple leaf diseases. The model generalizes well to different data distributions based on consistent client performance, which qualifies it for use in practical applications. Future research should address federated learning's drawbacks and restrictions, such as heterogeneous data distribution, model convergence, and resource limits. Additionally, investigating future uses in agriculture and plant disease control may result in a better judgment and more environmentally friendly agricultural methods.

articleTitle: Liquid Biopsy for Non-Invasive Monitoring of Tumour Evolution and Response to Therapy
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: Liquid biopsy, a non-invasive method for analyzing circulating tumor DNA (ctDNA), offers a promising approach for monitoring tumor evolution and therapy response in cancer patients. The study cohort consisted of 50 metastatic cancer patients with diverse tumor types, including breast, lung, colorectal, and pancreatic cancer. We collected plasma samples at baseline and at regular intervals during treatment, and isolated ctDNA using a commercial kit. We performed targeted sequencing of a cancer-associated gene panel using next-generation sequencing (NGS) technology. We compared ctDNA profiles before and after treatment, and analyzed changes in tumor allele frequencies using a computational algorithm. We observed significant changes in ctDNA levels and profiles after treatment in the majority of patients (n = 38, 76%). In some cases, we detected the emergence of new mutations and alterations in tumor clonality, indicating the development of treatment resistance. We also identified several genetic alterations that were associated with therapy response, including mutations in TP53 and PIK3CA genes. Furthermore, we found that changes in ctDNA levels and profiles were correlated with radiological response and overall survival. Our research shows that liquid biopsy has the ability to monitor the progression of tumors and evaluating the effectiveness of treatment in individuals suffering from metastatic cancer, without the need for invasive procedures. Liquid biopsy can identify new mutations and changes in the makeup of tumor cells, providing valuable insights for treatment planning and personalized therapy. Liquid biopsy shows promise as a non-invasive method for guiding treatment decisions and creating personalized treatment strategies. Furthermore, the identification of genetic alterations associated with therapy response can help to optimize treatment regimens and improve patient outcomes. In conclusion, liquid biopsy presents a hopeful option for non-invasive monitoring of tumor evolution and therapy response in metastatic cancer patients. However, additional investigations are required to enhance the effectiveness of liquid biopsy in real-world medical settings and to establish consistent guidelines for ctDNA evaluation.

articleTitle: Decentralized Detection of Cassava Leaf Diseases: A Federated Convolutional Neural Network Solution
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: Cassava is a vital sustenance crop for millions of individuals around the globe, especially in developing nations.
