ML assist in treatment planning as well as therapy, which increases the likelihood of patient's survival. Deep Learning (DL) algorithms have been developed for investigating significant characteristics of disease treatment and diagnosis. Breast cancer are usually identified with the help of mammograms and histopathological images. Histopathological images have been widely utilized technique for detecting breast cancer because genetic study is prohibitively expensive. This study provides a detailed analysis on deep learning and machine learning approaches to perform identification and treatment of breast cancer using histopathological imaging.

articleTitle: Reinforcement Learning Technique Based Automated Feature Analysis of Gene Expression Data
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: Immunohistochemistry and reverse transcription polymerase chain reaction, it is feasible to find molecular markers that are specific to cancer; nevertheless, there are no pathognomonic molecular markers available for the vast majority of solid tumors at this time. In this paper, we develop a Reinforcement learning Technique based automated feature analysis of gene expression data. This provides support for the idea that, on average, all the validation findings and training data from each epoch were utilized. This proposed method helps to acquiring knowledge at a more leisurely pace is, in the end, what makes episodic deep RL possible as a potential choice for students to pursue. To put it another way, the slow but steady accumulation of knowledge paves the path for the rapid extension of one existing body of information. The proposed methods provide 98 percent of the accuracy result than existing ANN and DNN. The proposed framework outperformed existing methods in terms of increase accuracy rate and reduced execution time than other methods

articleTitle: Smart Meter Based on FPGA for Battery Monitoring
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: Battery management system analysis and design for mobile device battery monitoring is a revolutionary approach that incorporates the capability the battery which contains the battery management system into the mobile devices and this paper mainly focused on monitoring the BMS using smart meter based FPGA in cellphone and it contains four components. (i) smart charging (ii) balancing the battery (iii) discharging (iv) performing the operation in safe manner. A charging algorithm is given that the features is combined the pulse charging and multistage charging for charging the lithium ion battery pack Charging circuit of current control to be achieved with high loop near stability the proportional integral control technique is provided. The simulation result is demonstrated for smart charging and the capacity of battery is determined. The performance is based on the evaluation of monitoring in various temperature and its characteristics, pulse performance, peukert equation and the cells expected operating life span is measured.

articleTitle: Design of Automated Control and Monitoring System for Intravenous Infusion Based on IoT
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: The creation of new health units in medical centre is made extremely difficult by gadget development in biomedical engineering. Hospitals still require an automated system due to a large number of patients they see and the availability of nursing facilities. In hospitals' ICU and CCU departments, monitoring and indicating healthcare operations is an exceptionally crucial responsibility. Everyone must take cautious steps to maintain their health because as the population grows, so does the demand for healthcare supplies and maintenance. Many automatic health monitoring gadgets are being created today to assure patient safety and relieve doctor stress. Many sophisticated treatments have emerged because of technical development to guarantee speedy recuperation. Many cutting-edge procedures have been developed because of technological advancement to ensure that hospital patients recover quickly. A treatment known as intravenous therapy involves injecting intravenous fluids, medications, blood, and direct blood products into a vein. On the whole, the amount of saline administered to the patient should be considered while measuring and controlling the flow of saline or intravenous fluids. Here, employing a single window system and fluid warming principles, an IoT-based fully automated system for controlling the fluid flow and continuous monitoring, and a saline containerization replacement method are provided. Heartbeat, blood pressure, and body temperature are monitored while intravenous (IV) fluids are administered and sent to the doctor using SMS technology. IoT gateway and Arduino-based flow control. The next generation of nurses and caregivers will be able to monitor the fully automated IV fluid feeding system with the aid of this device.

articleTitle: Deep Reinforcement Base Multi Context Routing in Social IoT
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: This study established a novel routing technique that is dubbed reinforcement learning for SIoT (MCTAR-SIoT). Its purpose is to ensure that data interchange in IoT networks is both energy-efficient and safe. At the subsequent hop node selection, this technique used three measures: Communication Trust (CT), Energy Trust (ET), and Hop Count (HC). The CT assures that nodes can be trusted, the ET ensures that nodes have adequate energy, and the HC provides a route with reduced time. By integrating all of these indicators and giving each characteristic its own weight, we are able to develop a new CRM metric. The first feature ensures that communications are kept private, the second extends the device's operational lifespan, and the third shortens the response time. Each node that is picked is the next-hop node, and it is responsible for transmitting the data to the destination node via it. The CRM uses deep reinforcement learning to choose which values to use. Extensive simulations were run for experimental validation, and the performance of the network was evaluated using MDR. These simulations included altering the proportion of members of the network who were malevolent. They saw an increase in throughput of 3% from CNN and 7% from SVM, respectively. Next, they saw an improvement in their MDR of roughly 2.6341% from CNN and 7.8112% from SVM, respectively. In conclusion, the NL is enhanced by 8% from OCNN and 10% from SVM, respectively, resulting in an improved score.

articleTitle: Malayalam Sign Language Character Recognition System
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: Sign language plays a critical role in facilitating communication among individuals with hearing or speaking disabilities. Until September 2021, signers from Kerala had to rely on Indian Sign Language (ISL), American Sign Language (ASL), or other regional sign languages to communicate. The introduction of Malayalam Sign Language (MSL) by National Institute of Speech Hearing, Thiruvananthapuram in September 2021 was a significant step towards addressing this issue. This paper presents a character recognition system specifically designed for MSL. The system focuses on recognizing nine Malayalam characters used in MSL communication. The proposed system utilises a deep learning approach, employing a modified Inception V4 model, for accurate image classification and character identification. The recognition system aims to address the communication barriers faced by individuals with hearing or speaking disabilities who rely on MSL for effective communication. The model utilises a modified Inception V4 model for image classification and letter identification, ensuring accurate recognition of Malayalam Sign Language symbols. This advancement significantly improves the communication experience for individuals who rely on sign language. Compared to other state-of-the-art methods, the proposed Inception V4 model performs better, achieving a Top-1 error rate of 17.7% and a Top-5 error rate of 3.8%.

articleTitle: Machine Learning for Analysis and Prediction of Wind Energy
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: A key and expanding field in the renewable energy sector is wind energy prediction. Determining the quantity of energy that will be provided is essential to reducing the cost of the wind farm's output and guaranteeing the security of grid access since biofuels are included into already-existing programs and integrated with conventional sources. In this research, we'll apply several cutting-edge Deep Learning techniques to a number of machine learning issues, such as the development of a prediction model for wind energy output. This paper delves into the application of machine learning techniques especially CNN for wind energy forecasting, with a focus on addressing key challenges and improving prediction accuracy. The study highlights the vanishing gradient issue and weight initialization as critical factors influencing the success of wind energy predictions. A detailed analysis of predicted values and forecasts for power generation, wind speed, wind pressure, and air temperature has been provided. These results showcase the efficacy of the machine learning model in estimating wind energy output and offer insights into the temporal variations observed throughout the year. Accurate wind energy forecasting is essential for effective integration and management of renewable energy sources, contributing to overall energy sustainability. The findings contribute to the optimization of wind energy resource utilization and advancements in the renewable energy domain. This research underscores the potential of machine learning to enhance forecasting models, enabling informed decision-making and fostering the growth of renewable energy technologies.

articleTitle: Stochastic Based Clustering and Improved Whale Optimization Algorithm to Predict Sickle Cell Anemia in Tribes of Nilgris
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: Genetic disease which is known as sickle cell anaemia (SCA) affects red blood cells (RBCs). A change in HBB gene causes aberrant haemoglobin to be produced. Red blood cells (RBC) with this defective haemoglobin have a sickle shape, which can result in a range of health problems. In this research, a classification-based prediction model is suggested by implementing the data mining technique for predicting the SCA disease. For features selection, the Improved Whale Optimization (IWO) is used and for classification, a stochastic based Clustering algorithm is used. The data set used in this work is a collection of sickle cell anemia test results of the tribe peoples who lives in the different areas of Nilgiris region. This dataset contains the data of 300 patients with 14 features related to SCA which are acquired from NAWA-Nilgiri Adivasi Welfare Association in Nilgris. 60% of a dataset is used for testing, while 40% is used for training. Based on testing dataset, the suggested model is assessed in terms of specificity, accuracy, PPV, sensitivity, MCC and NPV. The suggested model has overtaken the other entire compared model in expressions of all the parameters.

articleTitle: Utilizing the Innovative Block Quantum Computing Approach of BQSAT for Secure Satellite Communication
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: In order to extend long-distance communication, which has been necessary to connect telecommunications networks between the countries. Satellite communication is the second most widely used technology for global communication networks after terrestrial communication networks. A variety of communication services have been provided by satellite communication to mankind, such as the prediction of weather, storm warning, relaying television programs, digital data for a wide variety of business applications and most recently mobile and telephony communications. But with satellite communication, link security continues to be a big worry. Due to restrictions like a high bit error rate, power control, wide distances among the end nodes, high link as well as link availability. To overcome this issues, this paper proposed Block quantum for secure the satellite communication. Through registration, authentication and revocation, the communication is conducted. As part of this system, the satellite transmits a collected data to a ground base station, which records key parameters on the blockchain as well as clears malicious nodes from the block chain. High security is provided by the proposed satellite-based Blockchain and Quantum Key Distribution system for the upcoming 6G and beyond networks, Internet of Things, self-driving cars as well as other rapidly evolving applications. As a result, this study demonstrate that the suggested approach has an ability to enhance security as well as protection for satellite communications.

articleTitle: A Survey on Diabetes Detection Based on Machine Learning Classifiers
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: Computer-assisted sickness diagnosis is less costly, time-saving, accurate and it eliminates the need for extra employees in medical decision-making. According to many nutrition studies, nearly a quarter of the world's population suffers from chronic illnesses such as diabetes. As a result, an effective machine learning regressor capable of correctly diagnosing diabetes is urgently needed. The aim is to determine whether individual classifiers or a set of classifier combinations provide the best diabetes detection accuracy. The concentration of glucose in human blood is known as the blood glucose level. Diabetes is a long-term condition marked by a lack of glucose. To maintain blood sugar levels within the suggested target range, insulin therapy is necessary. As per the statistic from the WHO, diabetes affects almost 400 million individuals worldwide. The need for regular blood glucose monitoring in the therapy phase cannot be overstated. Diabetes can be detected in a variety of ways. ML models are utilized to determine whether or not the patient has diabetes to confirm the sickness. This paper attempts to survey various recently published literature that have proposed different approaches to detecting Diabetes Mellitus using machine learning techniques. Some of the surveyed techniques utilise comparative analysis of ML as well as DL classifiers, while others techniques use medical records to identify the risk predictor.

articleTitle: Hybrid Renewable Energy Systems with Smart Power Management – A Comparative Study
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: About 1.5 million publics in the world do not have access to electricity and getting them access to it, has become the most pressing issue. Due to power shortages, the electrical supply faces instability and the households integrated with the grids, encounters frequent power outages. This is because of the insufficient power generation, which is brought on by fluctuating voltage levels and antiquated transmission cables. Therefore, it is mandatory to identify a decentralized source of energy, for providing uninterruptable power supply. In developing countries, there is a great demand towards Renewable Energy Sources (RES) like wind, solar, biogas, etc. The formation of Hybrid renewable energy systems (HRES) develops a realistic, as well as appealing approach for resolving the energy demands. These cost effective resources have only a minor impact on non-conventional energies. Therefore, the utilization of RES, provides better economic growth and efficient power management. Besides, Microgrid (MG) is an embedded network, which incorporates RES along with different loads and it assists in energy management. The MGs, to achieve optimum functionality, necessitates energy efficient storage units. The RES utilized in MGs, aids in providing energy stability and in case of excess energy production, it is stored in the storage units. The HRES incorporates a variety of EMS (Energy Management Systems) to maintain stability and energy management. In this paper, the techniques and algorithms that assists in energy management are evidently discussed. The goal of this paper is to examine the manner in which model interpretability is increased by reviewing prior studies that used interpretable machine learning approaches for energy management. Moreover, a comparative analysis is carried out between the different techniques, in order to observe the best optimal energy managing technique.

Author Keywords: SCs (Super capacitors) and HESS (Hybrid energy storage systems)

articleTitle: Deep Learning Model for Lung Cancer Detection On CT Scan Image
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: The lung cancer disease is the disease of lung which can affect human health. The interstitial lung disease is diagnosed in different phases such to pre-process the image, segment it, extract the features and classify the data. The various machine learning models are proposed for the interstitial lung disease detection. The segmentation algorithms can be categorized into threshold and region-based segmentation. The feature algorithms are broadly classified into color and textural features algorithms. This work suggests DL model for the lung disease prediction. Python is executed for simulating the suggested model and results are analyzed concerning accuracy, precision, and recall.

articleTitle: Real Time Attendance Monitoring System Using Face Recognition
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: A real-time student attendance monitoring system using machine learning techniques is being developed to automate the manual attendance monitoring process in schools. The system will use image processing and computer vision algorithms to detect and recognize student's faces and compare them with a database of registered students. By providing real-time data and automating the monitoring process, the proposed system is expected to significantly reduce the workload for teachers and staff and improve the accuracy and consistency of attendance data. The process involves several steps, including the acquisition of images, improving their quality through pre-processing, identifying important features for recognizing students, and finally using machine learning techniques like MultiTask Cascaded Convolutional Neural Networks (MTCNNs) to accurately classify the students. Additionally, the system will provide comprehensive reporting to help identify patterns and trends in attendance data, which will provide valuable insights for school administrators.

articleTitle: Methods for Estimating SOC of LiBs in Electric Vehicles: A Review
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: The majority of electric vehicles, including cars, buses, motorcycles, and bicycles, use lithium-ion batteries. Every battery-powered device has to carry out the crucial task of estimating the battery's state of charge. One of the most vital battery states to monitor in order to enhance performance and lengthen battery life is the <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\text{SoC}$</tex>. In terms of electric vehicles (EVs), precise SOC calculation of lithium-ion batteries helps to guarantee battery safety and increase driving efficiency. <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\text{SoC}$</tex> cannot be directly measured by the battery management system. The two main SOC estimation types (direct and indirect approaches) are proposed in this review paper, along with other subcategories that list current <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\text{SoC}$</tex> estimation trends. The main <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\text{SoC}$</tex> estimate proposals that have come up in the literature in past few years are reviewed in this work. The designer can choose the most practical strategy with the aid of this review. This paper sets out the most widely used techniques for estimating the SOC of LiBs, along with the benefits and drawbacks of each technique. The future development direction of SOC estimation is then suggested on the grounds of evaluation of SOC estimation methodologies.

articleTitle: Studies on Attitude Determination and Control System for 1U Nanosatellite
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: Implementation of Attitude determination and control system for 1 u cube-sat in polar sun circular orbit is proposed. ADCS plays an important role in maintaining the orientation (stabilizing) of the satellite in the desired attitude. The Algorithms responsible for attitude determination such as IGRF, J2000, Sun sensor, Magnetometer, Gyroscope were simulated using Matlab. The Orbital parameters were calculated for an attitude of 505km with 98 degree inclination. Using the above simulation and outputs of different algorithm the control algorithm named BDOT algorithm was simulated. The simulation of algorithms were done on MATLAB 2022A and the results suggest that the 1 U Nano Satellite would Stabilize within 2000 sec in the orbit.

articleTitle: Optimising Waiting Times at a Major Orthopaedic Hospital Using Simulation – A Case Study
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: In this paper, queuing model of the outpatient department in an orthopaedic hospital is studied. The objective is to analyse the bottlenecks caused due to the high waiting time in different sections of the hospital. The sections that have a high patient inflow rate and relatively greater service time causes queue formation, and therefore an increase in system time. The paper focuses on two key parameters, the total time spent by a person in the system or the waiting time before receiving service. Data collected from the hospital's Out-Patient Department (OPD) is used to build a base model that simulates the flow of patients through the departments. The study explores cost-effective solutions to reduce patient waiting time in a queue system. It evaluates various scenarios to determine the optimal solution with minimum waiting time and provides insights for improving the system without altering the hospital layout significantly. On comparison of the current setup with the optimised models through simulation, modifications such as adding multipurpose servers in registration and billing counters, implementing separate counters in sections where patient traffic is more, and making amendments to prevent patient visits to one section repeatedly have been suggested. The system performance has seen considerable improvement upon implementing them.

articleTitle: Neuroplasticity Changes to Configure Human Talent
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: Neuroplasticity is the capability of the brain to adapt its structure and function to new environments. It is essential for learning, memory, and brain repair after brain damage. Neuroplasticity can also be utilized to assess human ability or potential for excellence in a particular discipline. One method is to assess the brain activity of people who excel at a given topic, such as chess, math, or music composition. Researchers can uncover the neural markers of experience and talent by comparing their brain patterns with those of average performers or beginners. Previously, researchers discovered that London taxi drivers have larger hippocampi, a part of the brain associated with spatial memory and movement, than control subjects. This was attributed to their extensive training and experience in navigating the complex city streets. Neuroplasticity can also be used to enhance human talent by providing optimal conditions for learning and performance. This may include electrical or magnetic pulse stimulation of the brain, the use of neurofeedback or biofeedback techniques, or the application of cognitive strategies such as purposeful practice, spaced repetition, and interleaving. These techniques try to change the brain's activity and connectivity in ways that aid in skill learning and retention. Transcranial direct current stimulation (tDCS), a non-invasive brain stimulation method that administers mild electrical currents to the scalp, has been shown in prior research to improve mathematical abilities in healthy people. Finally, neuroplasticity can be utilized to discover human talent by measuring brain activity in experts and learners, as well as to improve human talent by providing optimal learning and performance settings. Neuroplasticity provides a viable path for understanding and increasing human potential across a wide range of fields.

articleTitle: A Review on Topologies for Grid Integrated Electric Vehicle with Battery Storage
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: Renewable energy sources, in particular wind energy, are being more and more integrated into the network of charging places for electric vehicles. As a result, there have been significant worries over the power systems' ability to operate dependably and satisfactorily. Integrating energy storage devices for electric vehicles is one of the suggestions made to increase the performance and dependability of these systems. The newest developments, advantages, size considerations, efficiency, cost, and recycling of battery energy storage systems are all covered in depth in this paper. The benefits and disadvantages of the various battery energy storage technologies are thoroughly analyzed, explained, and contrasted. When it comes to grid applications, the economic advantages of battery sizing using probabilistic and optimization techniques offer a potential solution during the strategy by taking into account a variety of factors affecting the sizing of the battery, such as the deprivation rate, reliability, and battery location. The comparative analysis are carried out in the optimization technique to predict the best efficiency in battery energy storage system.

articleTitle: Cascaded Neural Network Controller for Speed Control in Idtc Based Switched Reluctance Motor
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: Switched Reluctance Motors (SRMs) use the indirect torque control (IDTC) control approach to manage the motor's output torque. By adjusting the stator current, the IDTC approach indirectly regulates the motor's torque. A position control stage and a current control stage make up the two steps of the ITC technology. During the position control phase, a position sensor or an observer is used to estimate the location of the motor's rotor. Using the positional data, a torque-speed characteristic of the SRM with the help of Cascaded ANN Controller. The present management stage receives the desired stator current after that. In IDTC, an initial current is produced based on the required torque after the current in each phase of the SRM has first been measured. Then, using a PI controller, the voltage in every stage is modified by contrasting the initial current with the actual current and using the difference as the basis for modification. The converter obtains the required voltage from the PI controller in order to generate the required current. The inverter converts the DC voltage into an AC voltage that has the right frequency as well as magnitude to deliver the required torque.

articleTitle: A Systematic Review and Analysis of Lung Disease Detection Techniques
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: Artificial Intelligence (AI) advancements have astonishingly taken place in the last decade, and it is seen their way into innumerable applications from driverless cars to medical diagnosis. AI is being highly used to identify lung diseases in the present years. Its main aim is to estimate human cognition in the analysis of complicated medical data attained from diagnostic tests for lung diseases. In this review paper, 20 research papers are studied based on different techniques of machine learning as well as deep learning employed for the detection of lung disease. In addition, research papers are reviewed on the basis of diverse kinds of lung diseases, namely tuberculosis, COVID-19, pneumonia, involving lung cancer by classifying the papers based on the methods, like Random forest, Deep CNN, voting classifier, etc. Then, gaps and issues in the research identified in conventional works are enlisted. This helps the researchers in finding a solution and progress their research. The literature review examines various factors when analyzing works, including the datasets used, metrics for evaluating performance, methods employed for detection/classification, and the performance achieved by those detection methods. By analyzing the existing literary works on lung disease detection, the review identifies research challenges that can guide researchers to enhance their work and suggests future directions for improvement.

articleTitle: Hybrid Electric Vehicle Charging Station Under Critical Voltage Conditions
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: The popularity of electric vehicles is quickly spreading throughout the globe. Over the years, their innovations have generally evolved. However, their charging system continues to be of interest because an air conditioning network recently met most of the requirements for charging electric vehicles. In any event, research over the course of the year has focused on how to use limitless energies in the charging station. The greater part of the examination studies center around the administration, ideal control, charging plans and charging procedures. There is no exploration done on a charging station that joins the framework incorporated half breed inexhaustible energy framework, for example, Wind and PV including a focal battery save money with a distributed energy exchanging model. The objective of this exploration is to support a highly organised schedule for charging electric vehicles at a charging station while ideally managing the power distribution of the network and wind and solar charging station, as well as the charging and discharging of the main battery bank (used for energy capacity). The suggested strategy will increase the pleasure of users of electric vehicles while providing affordable charging solutions, such as a distributed energy sharing model, that satisfy all of the requirements of the charging station.

articleTitle: Design of Electrical Bicycle using Matlab-Simulink
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: This paper provides a comprehensive study on the modeling and design of an electric bicycle employing MATLAB-Simulink. It investigates the functioning of the electric bicycle and its sensitivity to varying environmental conditions such as rider weight, wind speed, and gradient via simulations. The paper leverages dynamic equations to reflect an electric bicycle's operation in different scenarios, solved through the MATLAB-Simulink program. This approach aids in determining the required motor power output, under various operating circumstances. The authors emphasize the importance of understanding the operations of electric bicycles and their responses to different conditions, showcasing mathematical modeling as a crucial tool for designing efficient e-bicycle power systems. The study considers crucial design elements including efficiency, eco-friendliness, noise reduction, speed, charging time, and overheating prevention. References to cognate works on electric two-wheelers underpin the research. The findings contribute valuable insights for the design of electric bicycles, advocating for the promotion of environmentally friendly urban transportation. The paper concludes that this modeling approach offers promising potential for the future of urban mobility design, particularly for transitioning towards all-electric transportation.

articleTitle: Hybrid Feature Extraction Technique for Electrocardiograph Arrhythmia Signal Classification
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: This proposed work suggests, a helpful method for classifying arrhythmia beats from an ECG database. Three stages make up the recommended method namely the initial preprocessing phase, hybrid feature extraction stage and the feature classifier. At first, ECG beat signal is acquired from the physiobank ATM and are pre-processed in order to get them ready for feature extraction. A hybrid feature extractor has been employed for effective feature extraction. Two processes comprise the hybrid feature extraction process: (i) Haar wavelet-based feature extraction ii) feature extraction on the basis of tri-spectrum. Once the beat signal has been classified as normal or abnormal, the feature Feed Forward Neural Network (FFNN) classifier is employed. Studies on beat categorization are done using the MIT-BIH Arrhythmia ECG signal database. A classification accuracy of about 73 % is achieved using this beat classification method.

articleTitle: Techno-Economic Analysis of Electrically Propelled Marine Vessels
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: This paper addresses a comprehensive comparative study focusing on the superiority of electric propulsion systems over diesel and hybrid alternatives in Roll-on/Roll-off (RoRo) and container ships. The study includes the design and analysis of <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\text{RoRo}$</tex> and container ships incorporating diesel, hybrid, and electric propulsion systems. Key performance indicators such as emissions, initial cost, operational cost, maintenance cost, and fuel cost are examined to evaluate the performance of these systems. By conducting analyses across different cases within each propulsion system, the study provides a detailed assessment of electric vessels' technical and economic feasibility. Additionally, optimization technique are applied to enhance the reliability of the results. The findings are helpful in understanding the benefits of electric propulsion systems for RoRo and container ships, guiding decision-makers towards sustainable and economically advantageous choices in vessel design and operations.

articleTitle: A Survey on Design Concepts and Optimization in Dual Band Patch Antenna for 5G Applications
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: Mobile communication has become in demand as consumers of mobile devices multiply quickly. Mobile consumers want additional features on their phones, such as fast data speeds, effective communication, less traffic, the ease of using a variety of applications, etc. The requirements of mobile customers must be met, and network operators must achieve this with the aid of 5G technology. High bandwidth, low latency, improved quality of service, maximum capacity, and wide-band spectrum accessibility are all features of 5G technology. In order to offer a high frequency spectrum with a significant amount of bandwidth, 5G is operated in the millimeter wave band. This essay is based on research on the best antenna layout for mobile data transmission using 5G technology. To determine various design which is appropriate for 5G mobile communication, measurements of various antenna design characteristics are also investigated in this paper. This review article summarizes the many methods, designs, and development strategies employed by researchers in the multi-band antennas that make up 5G wireless networks and seeks to give a survey of the current research trends. The researchers' examination and analysis of current design approaches, processes, and obstacles is going to be aided by this research.

articleTitle: Effective Heart-Disease Prediction by Using Hybrid Machine Learning Technique
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: With the changing lifestyle habits, a significant proportion of the global population is becoming vulnerable to heart diseases, which have emerged as one of the leading causes of mortality. Healthcare professionals rely heavily on patient data to predict the likelihood of heart disease, as high mortality rates associated with coronary diseases necessitate early intervention. However, analyzing patient data manually is a time-consuming and error-prone process, which necessitates the use of automated prediction systems [1]. This study attempts to determine the best machine learning method for estimating the risk of developing heart disease, which can aid non-specialist doctors or medical technicians in accurately assessing disease risk. The study compares and contrasts six alternative machine learning algorithms: logistic regression, support vector machine, decision tree, k-nearest neighbour, Gaussian naive Bayes, and random forest classifier. Random Forest was found to have the highest prediction accuracy of 95% among all the algorithms evaluated [2].

articleTitle: Customer Feedback Analysis Based on Emotion Detection Using Machine Learning Techniques with Privacy Preservation
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: This study showcases a technique that employs machine learning algorithmic techniques and emotion recognition to analyze client feedback, thereby improving the overall customer experience. To comprehend the wants of customers as well as their opinions about the company's products is crucial for a corporation to understand the market. There is a growing need to accurately gather feedback from clients. To address the demand for precise feedback analysis, we decided to concentrate on this problem. While offering insightful data on their attitudes and feedback, the suggested strategy protects client privacy. Describing the difficulties in assessing consumer feedback from image data on their faces, the study explains the idea of privacy preservation in machine learning. While clients provide feedback, emotions are extracted from their photos using face detection techniques, and then machine learning algorithms are applied for emotion analysis. To protect privacy, the strategy employs data anonymization techniques such as differential privacy and k-anonymity. By offering justifications and results, the project demonstrates how the suggested strategy enhances customer experience while protecting privacy. The information generated from visuals and emotions is much more accurate and representative of the client's genuine opinions when compared to the more conventional techniques of gathering customer feedback. Companies seeking to enhance customer satisfaction while safeguarding their privacy could benefit greatly from the project's findings.

articleTitle: Enhanced Monarch Butterfly Optimization Algorithm with Rank-Based Selection and Random Jump Strategy for Constrained Engineering Problems
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: Nature-inspired algorithms have become increasingly prevalent in engineering and mathematical optimization due to their efficacy and adaptability. Among these algorithms, the Monarch Butterfly Optimization Algorithm (MBOA) is a population-based metaheuristic, characterized by its simple implementation and the utilization of the Migration Operator (MO) and Butterfly Adjusting Rate (BAR) to guide the search path of butterflies. However, the algorithm can suffer from susceptibility to local optima traps, early convergence, and inferior performance due to a lack of random factors. To address these challenges, we propose an Enhanced Monarch Butterfly Optimization Algorithm (E-MBOA) that incorporates Ranking-based Selection (RBS) and a Random Jumping strategy. The RBS prioritizes the search direction based on individuals' ranks in the population, enhancing the search process by encouraging the exploration of feasible areas with lower objective function values. By employing the Random Jumping strategy, the process can effectively investigate the search space and avoid local optima, thus mitigating early convergence issues. The proposed model is assessed on a variety of mechanical and engineering design problems. Results are contrasted to other optimization approaches published in the literature, demonstrating that the proposed model offers faster convergence to global optima and effectively avoids local optima traps. E-MBOA's performance validates its feasibility and effectiveness as a powerful tool for resolving complex engineering optimization problems.

articleTitle: No Bot Anticipates The Deep Captcha Presenting Disposed Illustrations With Applications to Captcha Generation
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: The Completely Automated Public Turing Test to Tell Computers and Humans Apart (CAPTCHA) is a security technique that has been widely used to combat spam, dangerous bot programmes, and automated registrations. An effective CAPTCHA usually presents tests that are easy for humans to accomplish but difficult for computers, with humans achieving over a 90% success rate and computers less than 1%. Thus, a good CAPTCHA is considered both robust and user- friendly. Our research introduces Deep CAPTCHA, an innovative CAPTCHA generation approach designed to deceive deep learning classification algorithms using specially crafted adversarial noise, include other machine learning technologies since hostile samples are portable. To maintain human readability, the noise intensity is kept low, while still defending against removal attacks. The proof-of-concept system developed in this study demonstrates improved usability and security compared to traditional CAPTCHAs. Initially, we will explore well-established CAPTCHA generation research before delving into deep learning and focusing on techniques for creating adversarial instances. By the end of the project, we will assess the resilience of different adversarial example types against preprocessing attacks. The implementation of a proof-of- concept system will also be included, and its evaluation will indicate that our proposed approach offers superior security and significant usability benefits when compared to existing CAPTCHAs.

articleTitle: Inbuilt Chat GPT Feature in Smartwatches
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: Smartwatches with built-in chat GPT (Generative Pretrained Transformer) technology have boosted people's capacity to communicate with each other and their devices. Users may talk with their smartwatches using chat GPT technology. It achieves this by being able to read natural language inputs and respond like a human. The in-built chat GPT technology is designed to expedite conversation and increase wearable use. Chat GPT technology allows smartwatches to learn from prior interactions and adapt to users' communication styles, preferences, and behaviors. Machine learning and artificial intelligence make this feasible. Smartwatches' integrated chat GPT technology facilitates communication and offers many other benefits. Voice commands allow users to set reminders and appointments, plan trips, check the weather, and control smart home devices. This feature's capacity to deliver tailored recommendations and suggestions based on user behaviors and preferences enhances the user experience. Built-in chat GPT technology in smartwatches has many advantages, but it also has several drawbacks. Ethical, security, and privacy problems are these obstacles. However, with proper deployment and regulation, incorporating chat GPT technology in smartwatches should outweigh the risks. This will enable natural and simple technology and communication.

articleTitle: Optimized Reformed Histogram Equalization and SE-CNN with Chan Vese Segmentation for an Automatic Prediction of Lung Cancer
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: Lung cancer is one of the deadliest illnesses and the leading cause of illness and death, when detected in its early stages. While many classical machines and deep learning automatic systems can identify lung cancer with effectiveness, they still have issues with recognition accuracy and take longer to analyze. The Squeeze and Excitation Convolutional Neural Network (SENET), a deep learning technique, is proposed in this research. To increase the clarity of an image, lung CT input pictures are pre-processed employing the Adaptive Bilateral Filter (ABF) and Reformed Histogram Equalization (RHE). Tuna-swam optimization is utilized to determine the tunable parameters of RHE approach. Chan Vese segmentation model is used for segment the object and background of pre-processed image. This segmented image is given to SENET classifier for lung cancer prediction. The suggested strategy achieves 98. 7% accuracy, 2.3% error, and 97.4% precision, based on experimental outcomes. As a result, the proposed framework successfully predicts lung cancer and raises the standard of living for patients.

Author Keywords: Squeeze and Excitation Convolutional Neural Network

articleTitle: Assessing Academic Performance Using Ensemble Machine Learning Models
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: Artificial Intelligence (AI) shall play a vital role in forecasting and predicting the academic performance of students. Societal factors such as family size, education and occupation of parents, and students' health, along with the details of their behavioral absenteeism are used as independent variables for the analysis. To perform this study, a standardized dataset is used with data instances of 1044 entries and a total of 33 unique variables constituting the feature matrix. Machine learning (ML) algorithms such as Support Vector Machine (SVM), Random Forest (RF), Multilayer Perceptron (MLP), LightGBM, and Ensemble Stacking (ES) are used to assess the specified dataset. Finally, an ES model is developed and used for assessment. Comparatively, the ES model outclassed other ML models with a test accuracy of 99.3%. Apart from accuracy, other parameters of metrics are used to evaluate the performance of the algorithms.

articleTitle: Type-2 Fuzzy Logic Algorithm Based High Gain Improved Luo Converter for EV Applications
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: The electrical grid's quality of power is compromised by the building of electric vehicle (EV) charging stations. This research suggests an electric vehicle period type 2 regulated high-quality charging system. For shunt conversion control, the fuzzy logic controller built on the immediately reactive power theory is suggested. The DC-link voltage measurement of the shunt converter's output and the entire harmonic distortion of the original present serve as the basis for assessment of type 1, interval type 2, and real programmed adaptive algorithm optimized fuzzy logic processors. These are also possible using the approach recommended by utilizing a high-end Power Quality bridgeless LUO conversion. The present Power Factor Correction (PFC) is constructed by coupling two separate, comparable half-cycle LUO converters with a conventional capacitor. Because typical PFC converter do not include input diode bridges, a converter offers a high density of power and low cost based EV charging technique with improved precision functioning in just one flipping cycle. The current from the input flows into a battery and the supply voltage is generated precisely on step, but the input power factor is high.

articleTitle: A Review on Machine Learning to Detect and Classify Paddy Leaf Disease
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: India's primary source of income is agriculture. Paddy is grown almost everywhere in the world but is most common in Asian nations where it serves as the main source of food to world's population. Several diseases attack it at various phases of its development. Fungi, nematodes, viruses, bacteria, nutritional deficits, temperature, and other environmental variables are the key biotic and abiotic elements that contribute to plant illnesses. Brown spot, bacterial blight and Leaf blast are all important paddy leaf diseases that destroy rice and drastically reduce yield. The saturation threshold is used to eliminate background from photographs, while the hue threshold is used to divide diseased regions. Bangladesh, one of the world's top ten producers and consumers, relies significantly on rice to maintain its economy and meet its food demands. To guarantee the healthy and appropriate growth of the paddy plants, it is critical to identify any illness early on and before the damaged plants receive the necessary treatment. Farmers and planting professionals have had to deal with a slew of persistent agricultural issues, such as different paddy illnesses, for decades. A fast, automated, less expensive, and accurate method of detecting Paddy illnesses is highly desired in the area of agricultural information since severe paddy leaf diseases might result in no crop harvest.

articleTitle: Forecasting Stock Prices with Stack Transformer
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: In the ever-changing modern capital markets, stock prices are known for their high volatility and unpredictability, influenced by various dynamic factors, including social, financial, and political aspects. Investing in the stock market can yield substantial rewards with minimal capital; however, inaccurate predictions can lead to significant financial losses for investors. This research utilizes the Transformer model, which is commonly employed in Natural Language Processing (NLP) and computer vision tasks, to forecast future stock values of specific equities traded on the public market. Unlike previous applications primarily focused on NLP and computer vision, this research introduces the novel use of the Transformer model in the domain of stock price forecasting. By incorporating time2vec encoding, the Transformer model effectively leverages historical daily and weekly data to make predictions about stock prices. The primary objective of this paper is to predict stock price movements using the Transformer-based model, and the experiments demonstrate promising outcomes for the majority of stocks, exhibiting a manageable root mean squared error.

articleTitle: A Review Study on the Impact of Electromagnetic Fields in the Development of the Brain
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: The potential downside of rapid technological advancement has increased exposure to radiofrequency from wireless transmitting equipment and technologies. Because the radiation is nonionizing, it can disrupt your DNA, and also impact the water molecules or sugar molecules in your body. Normal mobile phone signals and even your Wi-Fi signal are in the microwave range, which means they utilize the same frequency as your microwave to cook food. Since the mobile phone emits a very high amount of radiation it will cause your skin or body to heat up somewhat, So you may actually experience your phone being hot in your hand when you use it too much now. Most human beings claim to be sensitive to the electromagnetic radiation emitted by modern digital devices and mobile phones, they describe symptoms such as headaches, nausea, skin responses, burning eyes, and weariness, nevertheless, these are only impacts claimed on a daily basis. A few studies have shown considerably more disturbing outcomes, such as probable links between the side of the brain used while people are using their phones and the emergence of brain tumors. So an intense review is necessary to look into this problem to get aware and take prevention accordingly.

articleTitle: Fruits Freshness Recognition System by Manipulating Versatile Neural Networks
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: Fruits are the prerequisite authority of nutrition. Consuming fresh fruits on a daily basis is good for health. Fruits are the consequential provenance of income for farmers. Harvesting of fruits takes place after it acquires its matured state. The farmers has to separate the harvested fruit as fresh fruit or rotted or raw fruits before selling them. Predicting the fresh fruits for selling and purchasing for regular use by customers is still an intricate endeavor. The traditional methods of determining the ripeness and rottenness of fruits takes time. It requires a huge man power for detection. Sorting of fruits, peculiarly the ripened fruit first to sold them in market prior to the raw fruits is vital. As the maturated fruit are highly prone to decay than the others. Employing recent techniques in agriculture immensely assists farmers. In some instances, the fresh fruits and rottenness fruits looks similar in texture and color. Disparate fruits upon freshness is an exigent venture. The proposed work makes use of DenseNet architecture so as to concede and grade the freshness of fruits. The initiated work incorporates layers of CNN comprising convolutional layers, maximum pooling layers, flattening and fully interconnected neural nets incorporating numerous layers for detecting and sorting the fresh fruits. The proposed work gains an accuracy of 98 % in recognition of freshness of fruits.

articleTitle: Trust Based Nodes Detection and Classification by Residual Network with Xgboost in Siot
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: A recent trend in academic study is the Social Internet of Things (SIoT), which integrates social network theory into the various layers of the IoTs to open up novel avenues for the IoTs' future growth. Slot seems to be a subset of lots that utilizes intelligent equipment and humans as nodes, social networks as the organization type, the social connection between things, things and humans, and humans, and formats study models and techniques with social media network characteristics in order to realize the connection, service, and usage of the lots. In addition, Slot is a realization of the innovation, architectural style, and application of lots using social network research methodology, and it helps promote the incorporation between the real and the virtual cyberspace, contributes to the realization of the lots, broadens the study scope of social networking, and offers a new remedy for the particular problems of the lots. Researchers must, therefore, have a firm background in the SloT developments in machine learning. SIoT uses Machine Learning (ML) methods to determine the features of connected devices. This special issue solicits scientific research articles that provide a picture of the current state of SIoT research. In this research improve the features of SIoT by residual network mapping and learning by XGBOOST

articleTitle: Fog Computing with Optimized Block Chain Technique for IoT Based Data Security
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: The Internet of Things (IoT) for medical purposes offers a number of benefits, including the aptitude to follow the individual's physical state over a range of time intervals and transmitting data in real time. Using gadgets like glucose meters, heart monitoring implants, Electrocardiogram (ECG), blood pressure monitors, Electroencephalography (EEG) and Electromyography (EMG) wearable strategies, medical personnel can gather local patient wellness data and make choices based on it. The IoT devices' weak authentication and encryption procedures make them readily hackable and may expose users to a number of risks, some of which could be fatal. The Quality of Service (QoS) needs for healthcare IoT devices, such as dependability, authorization, identity and security, cannot be met by current algorithms using machine learning or blockchain approaches operating in the cloud computing environment. Henceforth the proposed work develops an advanced Fog computing (FC) to oppose advance cloud computing at an edge of networks together with Block chain topology. Fog computing has been emphasized as promising method for low-cost remote monitoring, limiting down on latency, and boosting efficiency, while blockchain has been touted for guaranteeing the security of private data, building a decentralized database, and improving data interoperability. The problem of healthcare IoT device recognition, permission and confirmation for scalability often broadcast of data in a distributed setting can be handled by merging FC with block chain. So, leveraging FC and blockchain, a creative solution to the aforementioned issue.

articleTitle: Handwritten Characters to Electronic Readable Text Using Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: Handwritten character recognition (HCR) is the process of locating characters in images, documents, and other sources, and converting them into formats that computers can process. A considerable obstacle still exists in the perfect detection of complexly developed combined handwritten contents. In order to improve HCR, convolutional neural networks (CNN) have recently made significant strides. They do this by learning discriminative properties from significant volumes of raw data. The goal of this project is to identify handwritten characters and provide identifiable Text using those characters. Image rectification, segmentation, and character recognition make up characters. The input characters are digitalized during image correction, making them available for additional processing. One of the burgeoning disciplines in computer vision is character recognition. Humans are the only species with the ability to recognise anything. Humans are capable of quickly identifying the hand transcribing. There are several patterns to look for in different languages. The text can be correctly identified by humans. The MNIST Dataset is used in this study. The Convolutional Neural Network and Support Vector Machine approach is employed in this case because it provides high accuracy and performs superior than most of the other algorithms.

articleTitle: Image Segmentation and Pre-Processing for Lung Cancer Detection in Humans Based on Deep-Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: When it comes to cancer and its linked disorders, lung cancer is consistently ranked among the top causes of mortality. The primary method for making the diagnosis is to do a scan analysis of the patient's lungs. It's possible that an MRI, CT scan, or X-ray will be analyzed in this scan analysis. Due to the wide variety of imaging techniques that can be used to a patient's lungs, one of the challenging jobs that must be completed is the automated classification of lung cancer. Methods involving machine learning, deep learning and image processing have demonstrated a significant amount of promise for the classification and identification of lung cancer. In this research, we demonstrate a successful strategy for detecting and classifying malignant and benign lung cancer-related CT scan pictures. This approach was developed as part of our research for this paper. The proposed method begins by classifying the photos after they have been processed with image processing techniques. After that, the supervised learning algorithms are utilized to further process the images. In this section, we have extracted statistical features as well as textural characteristics, and then we have fed several extracted features to multiple classifiers. We have utilized a total of seven distinct classifiers, which are referred to as the KNN classifier, SVM classifier, multinomial naive Bayes classifier, decision tree, SGD(stochastic gradient descent), MLP (multi-layer perceptron) and random forest. When training and testing these classifiers, we employed a dataset that included both benign and malignant lung cancer-related images. In the findings that were collected, it was discovered that the accuracy is highest which is approx. 88 percent(for MLP classifier), when compared to other classifiers.

articleTitle: Secure 4 Square An IoT Based Industrial Security System
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: The manufacturing sector accounts for a significant portion of global energy consumption. One of the growing demands in various sectors and for personal applications is automation. By substituting self-operating devices for human labour, it decreases human effort. One method for expanding the platform for automation is the internet, where new developments enable users to both watch and control the system using the internet facility. As more people use the Internet, it becomes more secure, and IoT makes it feasible to monitor real-time data. For the management and monitoring of environmental risk parameters in danger-prone regions, modern industries have recently increased their demand for sophisticated instrumentation. Maintaining an equilibrium between industry and industrial environments requires attention to human safety and property losses. A timely alert system is also anticipated to be in high demand in businesses situated in areas far from institutions like fire stations, police stations, and hospitals. The three main causes of accidents, according to a survey, are fire, sudden temperature increase, and gas leakage. The aforementioned reasons typically contribute to an industrial accident either separately or in combination with one another. In this project, a wireless multi-sensory monitoring system of the environment at dangerous sites is developed by fusing virtual monitoring technology with hazardous risk management. A large number of people are hired in industries to carry out a variety of tasks while numerous machines and hazardous gases are handled. It is crucial to focus on improving their safety in order to provide security to those working in the business. In the event of a gas leak, a sudden increase in temperature, or the detection of a fire, the proposed project is constructed in such a manner that. The system is capable of spotting fire outbreaks, gas leaks, and unauthorised entry by intruders and sending messages to the appropriate proprietors to notify them of the situation. By transmitting real-time data from the controller directly to the phone via an established wifi connection, the system also assists users in making important decisions from any place within a given radius.

articleTitle: Studies on the Functionality of On-Board Computer in 1U CubeSat
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: The paper studies the various functionality of the On-Board Computer (OBC) used in 1U CubeSat for Leo orbit. The OBC in CubeSat is responsible for controlling and managing all the subsystems of the Spacecraft. The functionality includes modes of operations of the satellite, socket programming that is used to communicate between subsystems, user datagram protocol as transportation layer protocol between different subsystems, and hardware to visualize the functional working of the satellite. The modes of operation is timer based and implemented using Java in Visual Studio (VS) code platform that acts as a real-time operating system (RTOS) of the satellite. The Nested socket programming between various subsystems was developed in Java finally the functionality of Lora was implemented through Arduino board. The packet transfer between each subsystem is analyzed using packet tracer software. The functionalities were successfully studied implemented and analyzed about the onboard computer

articleTitle: A Geospatially Analysed Method for Retrieval of Water Quality Parameters Through Machine Learning Techniques
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: The analysis of Water Quality for a specific region is very important for it's surrounding habitat, as water is considered to be the driving factor for survival of any organism on the planet. There are many causes which results in degradation of the water quality, which in turn causes several diseases to be spread across the environment. In this paper, we propose a methodology of extracting different water quality parameters with the help of geospatial tools combined with a structured machine learning algorithm to better visualize the potability of water bodies belonging to different Indian water bodies.

articleTitle: ASAP: Assistant System for Alzheimer's Patients
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: Alzheimer's patients who emphasize improving their quality of life and reducing the workload on carers. This paper proposes an Alzheimer's partner framework that utilizes confront discovery to recognize family individuals and remind patients of vital assignments through voice messages. The framework moreover incorporates live checking through message passing, where the content message is changed over to voice and patients get the message through an earpiece. The proposed framework is outlined to address the challenges confronted by Alzheimer's patients, such as memory misfortune, trouble in recognizing family individuals, and communication barriers. It almost has calm and direct patients as its focal point. The primary goal of the paper is to use the Haar cascade classifier to determine if the individual in front of you is a family member or not. The system's design, together with a web application is used for live message passing. To determine the viability and use of the system, a client survey is taken. These factors show how the suggested framework has a remarkable potential to improve the lives of Alzheimer's patients and their carers. The system's capacity to distinguish family individuals and remind patients of imperative assignments through voice messages, as well as its live checking capabilities through message passing, makes it an important apparatus for tending to the challenges of caring for Alzheimer's patients. Overall, the suggested collaborative framework appears to be a promising step towards improving the support and care of Alzheimer's patients and adds to the growing body of research on the use of innovation to address the problems associated with this infection.

articleTitle: Development and Evaluation of LSTM Based Framework for Safe Retinal Microsurgery Using Force Sensing Micro-Forceps
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: The enhancement of manipulation precision is a foremost advantage of robotics-assisted retinal microsurgery. The present robotic structure offers a passive support to the surgeons. An active framework for improving the operation safety through vigorously intervening to prevent the operation of excessive stresses to the sclera is proposed in this paper. The suggested framework includes a robotic system with force-sensitive micro forceps (FSMF), an RNN to identify the presence of undesirable instances, and an admittance controller (AC) unit to direct the robot apart from the undesirable events. An evaluation was performed on the suggested framework as well as the other two methods. According to experimental results, the suggested framework significantly lowers the number of undesirable events when contrasted to AF and RF. The suggested method can successfully anticipate occurrences of excessive force and improve user performance to prevent undesirable outcomes during robot-assisted microsurgical activities.

articleTitle: Medical Image Classification using CMT and FTGD Layer
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: Medical image classification is a critical task in the field of healthcare, as it enables the accurate diagnosis and treatment of several diseases. Here, we propose a novel approach for medical image classification by incorporating a Fully Trainable Gaussian Derivative Convolutional (FTGD) layer, on Convolutional Neural Networks Meets Vision Transformer (CMT) model. Our results illustrates the usefulness of the proposed approach for medical image classification and highlight the potential of combining CNNs with the ViT architecture and FTGD layer for improved performance in healthcare applications. We evaluate our proposed approach on a COVID-19 dataset and achieve an accuracy of 85%, outperforming existing methods and also reduces the number of parameters. The proposed method has the potential to assist healthcare professionals in accurately diagnosing and treating various diseases, including COVID-19.

articleTitle: Techniques for Torque Ripple Reduction in BLDC Motor for EV
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: Brushless DC Motor has wide-ranging applications in industries with high efficiency, low cost, high torque to mass ratio etc. Especially in Electric Vehicles (EV) it has gained its popularity where it mostly uses BLDC hub motor. But BLDC motor has got some drawbacks, especially during dynamic load conditions it experiences a slight vibration due to torque ripple. Torque ripple can be caused because of commutation torque ripple, mechanical defects, current ripples, imperfect EMF waveform, cogging torque ripple etc. This literally affects the smooth driving experience. This paper relies on the ways to mitigate the torque ripple which is the main incitement for less lifespan of BLDC motor than Induction Motor. It also focus on the mathematical modelling of Brushless DC motor and control techniques for torque ripple reduction. The advantage of this work is it uses simple and efficient technique to reduce the torque ripple.

articleTitle: Cytocol — Online Law System
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: The Indian Penal Code (IPC) is a complex legal document that contains vast amounts of information regarding criminal laws in India. However, locating specific information within the IPC can be challenging due to its complexity and volume. To address this issue, the Project Online Law System has been developed, which provides an extensive collection of laws categorized by keywords and a powerful search function. This paper explores the Online Law System as an essential tool for researchers, legal professionals, and the public, providing a comprehensive and user-friendly platform for accessing laws related to criminal activity in India. The study highlights the importance of the Online Law System in facilitating access to legal information and improving the efficiency of legal research.

articleTitle: A Review of IoT Based Smart Farming Using CNN for Improving Agriculture Management
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: Agriculture is the main occupation in our country. Many people depend on agriculture. There are many factors that reduce production. To keep track of the essential nutrients we can monitor soil parameters. The matters that arise with the amount of nutrients present in the soil have to be identified. Food safety can be achieved with computer vision. We can find the presence of bacteria and other disease occurring in plants by monitoring the leaves. A framework for crop monitoring using sensors, Arduino Uno and Wifi can be made together with leaf disease detection. Analysis can be done using K means classifier and SVM. Soil moisture sensor detects the presence of water content in soil. Camera or Drone can be used to take pictures of crops and can be stored in cloud servers. The improvement of machine learning and Internet Of Things (IoT) gives solution for problems which farmers are facing in their daily life. This work reviews published articles in smart farming and suggest methods to extract features to detect leaf diseases along with smart farming.

articleTitle: Innovation in Public Transportation and Improving Accessibility for the Blind
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: Public transportation is extremely vital for the community involvement of a large number of people with vision impairments because it is convenient way of getting around for engaging in their education, employment, healthcare, and many other outreach programs. These people need to gather data about their surroundings as well as visual information at depots and terminus, includes as timetables, routes, and so on, in order to take public transportation safely, successfully, and independently. Unfortunately, getting on or off the right bus is a struggle for many blind or visually impaired passengers. These circumstances frequently lead individuals to rely on others to empower them in tasks near their homes, choose simpler tasks, or simply stay at home. Hence, our efforts have focused on developing a system that uses technology to empower those with visual impairments, enabling them to recognize the public transit system on their own. This system describes a ZigBee technology bus monitoring system that aims to facilitate movement and transport for blind people. The proposed system has two detection subsystems, one for blind people and one for buses. The blind passenger module detection subsystem will quickly identify the bus segment and details about the bus route via a voice message through the speaker. Additionally, the bus subsystem will identify every existing blind person in the neighborhood of the station, alerting the driver of the bus to the presence of blind passengers with acknowledgement button. The user will decide which bus he has to get in and acknowledge through a button so that the bus driver will be notified through an LCD display and voice message in the bus. Additionally, it consists vibrator which vibrates whenever the bus comes near to the user it helps a lot even for the deaf and dumb. This system outcome is to devise a simple guidance approach for blind people.

articleTitle: Active Noise Control Using CR-CED Network for Real-Time Noisy Speech Formulated on Desktop GUI Application
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: Traditional methods for active noise control (ANC) primarily rely on adaptive signal processing using the least mean square algorithm (LMS). These methods are effective for linear systems but struggle when confronted with non-linear distortions. Another approach, known as the selective fixed-filter active noise control (SFANC) method, offers a faster response but may give significant steady-state errors because of difficulties in selecting filter. To overcome the limitations of traditional methods, a deep ANC approach is introduced and different models of deep neural network (DNN) are developed to get the better results. If the secondary path is linear, the distortion is reduced to a satisfactory level. However, it struggles to accurately detect the secondary path when non-linear distortions are present. To address this, non-linear models are employed in ANC to account for such aberrations. In order to tackle non-linear distortions effectively, a deep learning method is introduced, formulating ANC as a supervised learning problem. The introduced approach involves utilizing a 2D-convolutional neural network (2D-CNN) to train a dataset based on specific parameters and generate an anti-noise output. 2D-CNNs offer powerful capabilities for analysing audio signals by leveraging spatial patterns, frequency-time localization, robustness and hierarchical feature learning. Extensive training is utilized to improve precision and guarantee resilience against diverse types of noise. This proposed method is also formulated on Desktop Graphical User Interface (GUI) for real-time application and was found to cancel the noise present in noisy-speech. The model was trained compared with different architectures: Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM), 2D-CNN, Recurrent Neural Network (RNN). After evaluating the performance of these architectures, the best results were achieved with the 2D-CNN model. The evaluation metrics, including Short- Time Objective Intelligibility (STOI), Normalized Mean Square Error (NMSE) and Perceptual Evaluation of Speech Quality (PESQ) demonstrated accurate results when using the 2D-CNN architecture.

articleTitle: A Comprehensive Investigation on Cyclone Prediction Using Deep Learning Technique
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: Weather forecasters have long been concerned with cyclones, and over the recent century, scientists have conducted numerous research on axially symmetric formations, operational dynamics, and methodologies. Several scientists have proven that deep learning can offer a fresh approach to overcoming the limitations of TC prediction by employing a pure data-driven system or enhancing numerical methods with DL.
