This review introduces development based on DL for various techniques in genesis TC predictions, track forecasting models, intensity estimates, severe weather prediction associated with TCs (including such heavy storms and thunderstorms, and their disastrous effects), and severe storm prediction, in addition to enhancing numerical prediction performance, by summarising and analysing the difficulties of tropical cyclone forecasting methods in recent times and maximizing of techniques using DL in these attributes. The chance is that, as of now, neither the DL capability nor the vast amounts of multi-source data were effectively employed to enhance the precision of tropical cyclone prediction. The difficulty is due to the fact that cyclones vary from typical climatic changes and oceanic mechanisms in their use of complex and dynamic frameworks and are easily persuaded by a wide range of factors. Hence, it might be difficult to ensure the observable duration and reliability of cyclone forecasting.

articleTitle: FO-PID Controller for Stability Operation in MMC Based Offshore HVDC Wind Energy System
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: A High voltage direct current (HVDC) system, which is based on a voltage source converter (VSC), provides flexibility to include more renewable energy sources (RES) into the electrical grid and supports power flow reversal. Grids provide connections between traditional energy systems and other substantial offshore energy sources, such as wind energy conversion system (WECS). Due to its distinguishing characteristics, including flexibility and scalability, a modular multilevel converter (MMC) has occurred as method for a creation of the VSC system. The three most popular methods for creating comprehensive MMC VSC-HVDC models are compared in this article for the first time of quality and simulation speed for a number of common simulation instances. Also, a FO-PID controller, which raises the voltage computational effectiveness. The suggestions for which detailed controllers are most suited for which specific investigations are presented as the paper's concluding section.

articleTitle: Detection of Whiteflies in Plants using Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: Whiteflies, One of the devastating pests seen in high-yielding crops that cause mass damage to agriculture due to their transmitting capability through a broad range of scopes. These pest species cause insufficient agricultural production on a large scale yields, so recognizing these insects in a larger area field is difficult and time-consuming for human observation. To overcome such a situation, in this paper, we used an object detection model known as Yolov5 with a nano variant, which helps detect thousands of small whiteflies rapidly with fewer parameters and power efficiency. Besides conventional pre-processing techniques, tilling images at inference helped to detect tiny whiteflies effectively and classified the abundance level based on counts. The model is fine-tuned with the pre-trained weight, and the result is evaluated using the Cassava Whitefly Dataset. Using the proposed methodology, the model achieved an average precision of 0.95@0.5 threshold with 0.92 F1-score. The experimental result demonstrates that the single-stage detector performs finer than the two-stage detector on speed and accuracy using tilling. The result of the proposed system increases the F1-score and average precision by 22% and 20% from the Raw data.

articleTitle: MTPA Based Efficient PMSM Drive for Electric Car
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: In recent times, there has been a significant rise in the utilization of the transportation sector, leading to a corresponding increase in the emission of greenhouse gases. To address this concern, many countries are promoting the adoption of Electric Vehicles (EVs) as a solution. Permanent Magnet Synchronous Motor(PMSM) receives more attention as a result of its high efficiency. Despite the excellent efficiency of PMSM, there are several reasons might cause a decline in their overall efficiency. This study introduces an IPMSM drive with an efficient controller for electric car. The IPMSM drive with the new controller is designed and developed using MATLAB/SIMULINK software. With this new controller reduces the losses at different load conditions and thus the efficiency is improved.

articleTitle: Heart Failure Prediction Using Machine Learning Algorithms with Cross Validations
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: Heart failure is common problem among the people. Many people suffer from this problem. Bad eating habits, BMI level, obesity, in active daily life are the things which are responsible for heart failure. Many data sets about patients are available which stores information about heart of the human being. Machine Learning (ML) algorithms are applied for making prediction of various diseases in recent years. ML models are trained on data sets and then trained models are tested on the tested data sets. Cross validation is a new tool to improve ML. In this paper accuracy of five ML models is calculated with and without cross validation. From results it is observed that cross validation improves the accuracy of all five ML models. The Random Forest ML model is best for heart disease prediction with 92.86% accuracy.

articleTitle: Common Mode Voltage Elimination Scheme in Dual Inverter With Reduced Harmonic Distortion
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: Induction motor drive systems experience shaft voltages, bearing currents, ground leakage currents due to Common Mode Voltage (CMV) created by Pulse Width Modulation (PWM) inverters, which leads to an early motor failure. CMV reduction techniques are used by industries that rely on huge motors to keep their equipment from breaking down. The induction motor's heat production is primarily caused by the harmonics produced by the inverter. CMV is reduced in the proposed system and thereby eliminating overall CMV in dual inverter. In this paper, an LC filter and a fourth leg topology is used to accomplish Common Mode Voltage Elimination (CMVE) with reduction in Total Harmonic Distortion (THD). Contrary to a 2-level inverter, a dual inverter with a fourth leg can simultaneously attain zero CMV and the reference by synthesising the closest three vectors. The model is validated using simulation studies in MATLAB/SIMULINK. The proposed scheme significantly reduces the harmonics and improves the system.

articleTitle: An Approach to Mine Data for Predicting Forest Fires Using Support Vector Machines and Gini Index for Feature Selection
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: Increasing temperatures regularly cause dry vegetation in wooded regions to burn due to sun radiation, which in turn sparks forest fires. Predicting and mapping fire susceptibility in fire-prone forests worldwide is a critical research focus. This paper presents a data mining approach for forest fire prediction. The maps that arise from evaluating the Gini index's performance in identifying significant features serve as a basis for firefighting tactics and regulations that are more successful in promoting sustainable forest resource management. The proposed model utilizes Support Vector Machine for regression and achieves an improved accuracy of approximately 87% compared to previous research. This study emphasizes the importance of enhancing traditional algorithms by prioritizing key features to ensure consistent results and optimize predictive models.

articleTitle: Evaluation of Continuous Improvement of Competencies and Approaches to Employment Support
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: In an organization, An employee remains satisfied with what they showcase in every area of the work done. Likewise, this issue remains the same in every domain like professionals, academics, photographs, designs, developers, banking, health care apps, and many more. Behind every challenging task, hard work is the backbone. This hard work must be employed in society so that global marketing, finance, science, and industries can be improved. This begins with changes like mind renewal, competitive skill improvements, technical growth, etc. The website is the perfect place for all these platforms to be incorporated. Anyone can showcase the top and most recent pieces of work. It is also seen that few businesses are done from the internet and the admin can present a portfolio and get the work done. The dashboard is left to the admin, and employees and the admin has complete control to access the employee profile from time to time.

articleTitle: A Survey on Deep Learning Approach for Identity Recognition Using Finger Vein Biometrics
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: Finger-vein-based identity recognition is a biometric identification technique, that uses distinctive finger vein patterns to confirm people's identities. Deep learning (DL) networks have made significant progress recently, and they have a greater impact on improving the accuracy and dependability of those structures. The usage of convolutional neural networks (CNNs), recurrent neural networks (RNNs), and generative adversarial networks (GANs) is included in this review article's assessment of the most recent advancements in DL-based finger-vein recognition. The research compares the accuracy, and speed of multiple deep learning deep-learning finger-vein recognition. It also examines the challenges faced in developing a reliable and effective finger-vein recognition technique, such as variations in finger position, orientation, and lighting conditions. In addition, the article presents the possible uses of finger-vein recognition across diverse domains including access control, e-commerce, and medical diagnosis. This analysis offers perspectives on the latest methodologies utilized in finger-vein identification and underscores the possibility of additional exploration and advancement in this domain.

articleTitle: Understanding Cyber-Attacks and their Impact on Global Financial Landscape
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: The internet and networks have transformed the modern world in many positive ways, but they have also led to an increase in cybercrimes. Illegitimate sources use cyber-attacks to steal sensitive information or damage resources, including malware, phishing, password attacks, man-in-the-middle, SQL injection, watering hole attack, and denial-of-service attack. Cybersecurity provides protection against such attacks, and this paper examines the most common types of cyber-attacks, along with case studies of cyber-attacks in India. The paper also analyzes the financial impact of cyber-attacks on a global scale, with billions of dollars lost each year due to cybercrime. The study emphasizes the urgent need for robust cybersecurity measures to safeguard resources and prevent the loss of valuable information. The paper concludes by highlighting the importance of raising awareness about cyber-attacks and their impact, in order to develop effective strategies for preventing and responding to cyber-attacks.

articleTitle: Flood Prediction Using Logistic Regression
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: Flood Prediction is crucial in mitigating its impact on human life, property, and the environment. This paper proposes a machine learning approach using Logistic Regression for flood prediction, which involves the usage of rainfall data to determine the probability of flood occurrence. By analyzing the average rainfall and training the model with the vast dataset, our model can generate more accurate predictions on flood occurrence. Our mobile application provides an early warning system through the flood risk map that is accessible to users. Our dataset comprises 37 regions in Tamil Nadu, which are the meteorological stations and also the base stations of dams. The latter allows for notification in the event of flood and dam overflow respectively. Furthermore, our mobile app enables users to easily identify camps and shelters established during flood periods and even add information about them. In addition, our mobile app also provides users with the necessary helpline numbers to reach out for assistance during flood times.

articleTitle: Utilization of Deep Learning for the Diagnosis of Diseases in Apple Leaves
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: This study presents a novel approach to the classification and detection of sick sections in digital photographs of apple leaf surfaces. When it comes to agricultural image processing, the segmentation and classification of apple leaf diseases are both essential steps in the process of identifying regions of interest. Previous research in this area has encountered difficulties in terms of accuracy and speed in the detection of apple diseases, which has hampered the ability to ensure that apples are grown in a healthy environment. An ant colony optimizerand a stochastic gradient descent approach are both integrated into the CNN model as part of the new detection model that has been suggested and given the name OAG-CNN. The findings from the simulation reveal that 98.5%of accuracy is achieved by Optimized Ant Gradient Convolutional Neural consuming only 2 seconds The results demonstrate that our Optimized CNN offers higher performance as compared to the currently employed methods like VGG-Incep and multi-label Classifier techniques. and it also helps in detecting the disease in the very early stage. Overall, the article addresses the shortcomings of prior methods by presenting a novel method that can detect and categorize apple leaf illnesses successfully.

articleTitle: Pulse Generator for EDM Drill Machine
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: The current invention is a pulse generator for electro-erosion machining that can deliver controlled voltage pulses between an electrode tool and an electrode workpiece. These pulses have a sharp vertical leading edge over a broad frequency range and offer the highest energy efficiency. The pulse generator of the invention includes a DC power supply, an electromagnetic energy storage element, and a first circuit make and break element, such as a switch, connected between one of the DC power supply terminals and one of the terminals of the electromagnetic energy storage device. This device is connected across the electrode tool-workpiece machining gap. The first terminal of the electromagnetic storage element is connected to the other terminal of the power supply via a first unidirectional element.

articleTitle: IoT Based COVID-19 Patient Monitoring System: A Review
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: Amidst the proceeding with Coronavirus scourge, wellbeing observing frameworks that are fueled by the Web of Things (IoT) can possibly be of gigantic help to Coronavirus victims. Real-time health monitoring based on patient measured values of body temperature, pulse rate, and oxygen saturation is presented in this study as an Internet of Things-based system. An Internet of Things-based system that implements these most crucial measurements is presented in this study because they are essential for critical care. The temperature, pulse rate, and oxygen saturation level that have been recorded are all displayed on a liquid crystal display (LCD) in this device. It is simple and straight forward to sync the LCD with a mobile application, allowing for immediate access. A system based on Arduino Uno was used in the presentation's Internet of Things-based approach, which was tested and confirmed on five human test subjects. The fact that the data it gathered could be saved in a relatively short amount of time was one of the system‘s most encouraging findings. It was discovered that the system produced accurate results when its findings were compared to those of other devices already on the market. During the Coronavirus pandemic, advances in light of the Web of Things (IoT) could be useful in saving individuals' lives.

articleTitle: Privacy-Preserving Integration of Face Recognition System and ESD Tester Using Federated Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: Facial recognition technology has been widely used in various industries for identification and tracking purposes. However, the integration of facial recognition with Electrostatic Discharging testers is constrained by data security and privacy issues. To address these concerns, this investigation proposes a federated learning model approach for integrating facial recognition technology with ESD testers. The Integration of Facial recognition with ESD tester using federated learning model with Pre-FedAvg Algorithm preserves data privacy and security by using a distributed learning approach which maintains high accuracy and efficiency of the ESD testing systems. This research evaluates performance of the proposed approach metrics like Accuracy, Precision-recall, and F1 score. Results show that this approach outperforms conventional method while preserving data from various vulnerabilities. The electronic manufacturing industries, quality control departments, and safety monitoring sections are among the key areas of this strategy. It has the potential to revolutionize the way ESD testing is performed and enhances the safety and reliability of electronic devices and new dimensionality of features in factory processes like calculating over time of workers and making ESD proof.

articleTitle: Static Wireless Charging for Electric Vehicles
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: Electric vehicle (EV) charging is possible using contactless power transfer (CPT) technologies without any physical connectivity. Roadways can be equipped with these systems so that cars can be charged while they are moving. This research investigates the use of such on-road charging devices to EV batteries may be made smaller and their driving range can be increased. It is estimated how much of the road should be covered and how well the system can transfer power. A few design elements are explained, such as the length and distribution of the CPT segments over the route. Once the entire power demand for all utilizing vehicles is evaluated, the viability of immediately charging the electric vehicle from renewable energy sources is taken into account.

articleTitle: Hybrid Solar-Powered Street Lighting System with Battery Storage and Grid Integration
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: The conventional lighting systems that are present today result in the wastage of an ample amount of energy and money, as the lights will remain turned on most of the time even when it is not in use. Artificial lighting is a constant companion in street lighting systems, influencing visibility in parking spaces as well as roads and highways. In recent years, new technical solutions have extended traditional highway lighting systems to become ‘smart’. This project focuses on smart lit highway systems that can drastically decrease unwanted energy usage and associated expenses. The motion sensors and Infrared sensors used in the proposed system are mainly what turn on the streetlights in front of them when they locate people or cars approaching. The sensors are supplied power from a battery, powered by a solar Photovoltaic array and are also given backup power supply from the power grid. Only in rare circumstances where the battery is insufficiently charged to power the sensors is the backup power supply used. When the system detects the presence of a vehicle, it raises the light intensity from zero level to high level. The system would automatically turn off the lights during the absence of at least one vehicle in a particular area, eliminating power wastage. A prototype which demonstrates the working of the streetlights and associated sensors has been developed. The suggested concept can have multiple applications on both a high level and a low level.

articleTitle: Multi-Sensor Based Regenerative Charging for Electric Vehicles
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: Electric vehicles are becoming increasingly popular in the market due to the high cost of petrol and diesel, as well as their many advantages such as no pollution, no sound pollution, and no need for gears. However, one of the main challenges with electric vehicles is charging. To address this problem, the paper proposes a designed and developed multi-orientation control system that uses the principle of regeneration to automatically charge electric vehicles. The system includes sensors for torque and vehicle orientation, which are used to detect certain conditions such as low grading and high torque. During these conditions, the system is able to regenerate energy that can then be used to charge the vehicle during normal operation. The control system is based on micro-controllers, which allow for precise and efficient management of the charging process. Regeneration is easier for a Permanent Magnet DC Motor (PMDC), as compared to a BLDC. But considering factors like efficiency, power density and cost, PMDC is a less obvious choice. This makes BLDC motors a popular choice in EVs. Thus regenerative charging using BLDC motor is suggested.

articleTitle: Utilization of Adaptive Neuro Fuzzy Inference System Integrated Unified Power Quality Conditioner for Enhancement of Power Quality in Distribution System
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: The growing use of nonlinear electronic loads has created significant challenges for utilities and end-users alike when it comes to maintaining power quality. As a result, there is a growing focus on improving the quality of the electricity supply, with custom power devices being used to safeguard sensitive loads and enhance the quality and reliability of the power supply. One such custom power device is the Unified Power Quality Conditioner (UPQC), which has become widely used for mitigating power quality issues. ANFIS is a powerful tool for modelling and analysing complex systems, and its application to the UPQC is expected to yield valuable insights into the device's performance in mitigating power quality issues. In this paper, the UPQC is modelled and analysed using the Adaptive Neuro-Fuzzy Inference Method (ANFIS) to improve the power quality of a 16-bus distribution system. The consequence of this analysis will become a milestone for comparing different power quality improvement techniques and identifying the most effective strategies for enhancing power quality in distribution systems. All the performance analysis has been carried out on the MA TLAB/Simulink platform.

articleTitle: The Performance Analysis of Single Phase PWM Inverter with Various Delay Times
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: The performance of the pulse width modulation (PWM) inverter is affected by several factors, especially the delay time between switching power devices on the same arm. This is well-known as a delay time (DT) which is a fixed value in the PWM design. The delay time leads to deteriorate performance such as harmonics, output ripples, and so on. In this work, the performance of a single-phase PWM inverter is analysed for various delay durations using an average-based pulse compensation method with feedforward and feedback strategies. The feedforward compensation technique uses a model of the power devices to predict the delay time and to compensate it. The feedback compensation method uses a delay estimator to estimate the delay time and to compensate it. A single-phase PWM inverter with DT compensator model is developed and analysed using MATLAB/Simulink software. The performance parameters analyse include the output voltage waveform, Total Harmonic Distortion (THD), and efficiency. The results show as the delay increases, the THD of the output voltage grows, whereas the efficiency decreases.

articleTitle: Power Quality Enhancement in IOT Based Hybrid Renewable Energy Systems Using D-STATCOM
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: Now-a-days, society largely depends on sources of clean energy. Nevertheless, incorporating it into the power system is complicated and has technical difficulties. Voltage sag and swell are the main issues with power quality (PQ) that arise from the unpredictability of clean energy sources. In this paper, a D-STATCOM is employed to compensate PQ issues arising due to solar and wind farms. The main contribution of this work is that a photovoltaic (PV) and wind fed D-STATCOM is used to mitigate the issues of PQ, SUC voltage sag, swell, harmonics and flickers. In order to enhance functionality of wind system the squirrel cage induction generator (SCFG) is employed. To stabilize the output voltage of PV system, a Re-Lift Luo converter is introduced. Adaptive neuro-fuzzy interface system (ANFIS) based maximum power point tracking (MPPT) is intended to maximize the power from PV array and is used efficiently to maintain the system reliability. The PWM rectifier increases the current flow through PWM operation and regulates the dc link voltage at the converter side. Here, the recurrent neural network (RNN) is utilized to generate the reference current for hysteresis current controller (HCC), which minimizes the current distortions. The experimental prototype of this work has been realized employing a Node MCU Wi-Fi module and MATLAB simulation platform.

articleTitle: An Efficient Andean Condor Algorithm for Optimal Charging Stations for Electric Vehicle
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: In today's world, new energy science is gradually advancing, and a number of advances are taking place. Consequently, electric vehicles (EV) are being predictable by people around the world and are becoming increasingly popular in several countries. Electric vehicles are becoming increasingly popular, but their rapid growth has resulted in a number of problems, including a lack of charging stations, uneven distribution and high costs. In order to overcome such issues, this paper proposed a method for improving the charge scheduling of electric vehicles using ACA algorithm. In this way, decentralized chargers will be able to learn decentralized charger control strategies more effectively because they have access to a common replay of previous operations. The implementation of EV charging stations is examined in this paper due to the importance of charging station infrastructure. Its goal is to consider a variety of restrictions, such as, the charging station's power, typical amount of time needed for each recharge and daily travel times. Electric vehicle DG optimization is scheduled using the Andean Condor Algorithm (ACA) method as well as the Network Reconfiguration (NR) is carried out to minimize the power losses. By satisfying the grid's requirements for the charging schedule, this method minimize the active as well as reactive power losses in the distribution networks. The reliability of the charging system schedule is improved and overall power losses are entirely eliminated by the proposed technique. According to the MATLAB simulation results, ACA greatly reduces distribution system overall losses by placing charging units.

articleTitle: Electrocardiogram Based Authentication Scheme for Smart Home Security
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: Authentication plays a major role in the security of smart home devices. This has increased a lot of interest in the research community leading to numerous authentication scheme that have been proposed for the smart home environment to be secured for the users. In this paper, Electrocardiogram (ECG) based authentication which assists in enhancing the security of the smart home environment is deliberated. ECG had extreme specific individual characteristic qualities, and research has shown that these traits hold true during a person's lifespan, assuming no biological alterations have taken place. The computing model uses the ECG technique to generate a template from the collected ECG signals from various wearable sensors. The user characteristics, such as the QRS complex, P peak, T peak, etc., were then extracted from the template. After pre-processing the signal, a feature vector is created, and the computing model uses it to determine whether the person is who they claim to be.

articleTitle: Design and Development of an fNIRS System for Analysing Brain Prefrontal Cortex
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: This work highlights the recent interest in functional Near Infrared Spectroscopy (fNIRS), an optical technique used to assess brain hemodynamics in a non-invasive manner. The study investigated the utilization of the optical window range between 700–900 nm by NIR light to effectively penetrate tissue, reach the desired depth, and analyze the functional activity of the brain. An eight channel fNIRS device covering the prefrontal cortex was developed to measure the cerebral blood oxygenation during cognitive tasks. The prefrontal cortex (PFC) is a crucial area of interest due to its involvement in attention, working memory, decision-making, and problem-solving. Ten healthy volunteers were monitored using the fNIRS probe during a cognitive task to obtain signals. By utilizing modified Beer Lambert's law (mBLL), the variations in concentrations of oxy and deoxy hemoglobin were computed. The findings revealed a rise in the oxy hemoglobin concentrations and reduction in the deoxy hemoglobin concentrations in the PFC while playing a word game.

articleTitle: Enhancing Shopping Experience Through LoRa and RFID Technology
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: Shops and supermarkets are constantly developing new ideas to make purchasing products simpler and reduce line wait times. The design and implementation of an RFID-based system that makes it possible to quickly and precisely scan product prices in a supermarket are presented in this paper. The suggested system makes use of RFID technology to wirelessly transmit data to the counter using the Long Range (LoRa) communication protocol after automatically scanning the prices of products. The system comprises RFID readers, tags, a LoRa module, and a microcontroller. The microcontroller processes the data after the RFID reader has processed it and sent it to it, and then the data is transmitted to the counter via the LoRa module. The system has been tested in a real-world supermarket environment, and the results demonstrate its effectiveness in terms of accuracy and efficiency. The proposed system offers a promising solution to address the challenges of traditional barcode scanning and can potentially enhance the overall shopping experience for customers.

articleTitle: Analysis of Time-Lapse Camera Using IoT
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: Time-lapse photography is a widely used technique in various applications, such as film and video production, construction, and scientific research. However, traditional methods for creating time-lapse photography are limited and often require manual intervention, which can be time-consuming and error-prone. Additionally, current systems are not easily portable, and it's difficult to access the footage remotely. In this paper, we propose an IoT-enabled time-lapse camera that addresses these limitations by providing a solution that is easy to use, can be deployed in a variety of locations, and provides remote access to the footage. The camera is designed to capture high-quality images at set intervals and store them on a cloud platform for easy access. A desktop application is also developed to allow the user to remotely control and monitor the camera, set the camera's settings, and view the footage. Experiments were conducted to evaluate the performance of the proposed system. The results show that the proposed system significantly improves the efficiency of time-lapse photography and makes it more accessible to a wider range of users. The system is easy to use, has a low power consumption, and is highly scalable, making it suitable for various applications. The proposed IoT-enabled time-lapse camera provides a practical solution for creating time-lapse photography and has the potential to significantly impact the way time-lapse photography is done.

articleTitle: Secured Valise Tracking System
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: Missing bags, lost bags, and merchandise damage are the three most common issues in the airline industry globally. Valise (baggage) tracking device was designed to avoid luggage mistreatment or loss, which would stress out travelers. The proposed solution consists of an Arduino microcontroller that communicates with the bag through a Global Positioning System (GPS) and transmits data about its location to a Global System for Mobile (GSM) phones. The suggested approach includes security features in addition to these modules. In which the valise's zipper or opener is attached to a vibration sensor module, which detects any attempt to open or harm the valise. Our suggested model will enable passengers to travel smoothly and comfortably.

articleTitle: Wind Energy Production Prediction in Smart Industries
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: The generation of wind power is dependent on wind speed, which can be challenging to control and predict due to its variable nature. By analysing the link between wind speed and power output, regression models for wind power curve modelling can help anticipate and optimise wind power generation. For the purpose of forecasting wind power, the authors of this study experimented with a number of regression models, including KNeighborsRegressor, Decision TreeRegressor, and ExtraTreesRegressor. They discovered that wind speed significantly affected power output and that regression modelling was a useful strategy for forecasting and maximising wind power generation. Compared to other models, the ExtraTreesRegressor model performed better.

articleTitle: Solar Fed FLC Based Landsman Converter for EV Applications
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: Increased population and rapid depletion of fossil resources result in increasing energy consumption. These factors also make alternative energy sources necessary for conventional internal combustion engine-based cars, which increases pollution. Hence, the Electric Vehicles (EVs) are introduced. Currently, the Renewable Energy Sources (RES) based EVs are preferred worldwide to give better energy management. Solar Photovoltaic (PV) system is one of the significant RES, with zero emission results in reduced global warming. The PV system possess a limitation of irregular output power, so it is necessary to use power electronic converters for the enhancement of output voltage. Therefore, in this paper a DC-DC Landsman converter fed by PV system is proposed and it aids in improving output power of PV system. DC-link voltage maintenance at converter output is carried by Fuzzy Logic Controller (FLC), which is based on a closed loop technique. The output of the proposed method is simulated by the MATLAB. As a result, the suggested work provides improved energy management, lower THD and lower losses.

articleTitle: Experimental Comparison of Machine Learning Techniques for Heart Attacks Prediction
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: In the current era, the phrase we learnt at our childhood is coming true i.e. “Health is Wealth”. The daily life is changes and a numerous of disease are only because of life style. One of the major disease is heart attack. It is a very sudden to have a heart attack and the availability of the expert consultant is also be challenge, therefore it is better to have prediction of the future through available technology. This paper highlights the experimental study of this domain. Now days, the data is available but the correct information is bigger challenge. This challenge is accepted by the technology called machine learning. There are various techniques available for it. But, there is requirement to handle the issue of implementation through these smart techniques. This manuscript tried to contribute in this direction. The experimental analysis and study has been done to evaluate the machine learning model. In this work, 5 different models of machine learning are analyses through experimental results. This manuscript is explaining the model creating for analysis of Heart Attack. The increase of Heart Attack in the present situation. They are the major causes to get the respiratory failure in light of that cause predicting the coronary episode and examination the data. Using the straight regression, support vector machine, decision tree,logistic regression,random forest anticipating the Heart assault. Regression and classification may be used to examine the connection between variables and forecast the best-fitting line. And, with the help of clustering, it changes the data and divides it into structures to help comprehend the situation better.

articleTitle: Performance Investigation of Renewable Energy Sources Fed 31-Level MLI for Drive Applications
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: Due to its ease of maintenance, renewability, low noise level and accessibility, generation of electric power using Photovoltaic (PV) systems has recently become a viable alternative to conventional power generating systems. The output from the PV module is intermittent so that a converter is utilized in improving the supply voltage. In this paper, Flyback converter is employed with high voltage ratios due to its isolation benefit and better efficiency. PWM pulses for converter operation are created from a PWM generator that is powered by carrier signal waves received from Multi carrier PWM. The Multi carrier PWM technique is utilized to produce pulses to the 31-level Multi level inverter switches. The PWM pulses generated is utilized in the operation of Flyback converter aswellas 31 level multi-level inverter. By using applications of renewable energy, this paper suggests a 31-level multilevel inverter, which generates waveforms with the staircase's many output levels and smaller THD level. The DC voltage obtained is converted to AC and fed into the propulsion load. The simulation is executed with the aid of MATLAB software and the RES fed to 31-level inverter for the drive application is analyzed.

articleTitle: High Voltage Gain Multilevel Cascaded Boost Converter for PV Application
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: Low voltage will be the extent of the yield from unconventional sources like PV modules and isolated components. This needs to be expanded primarily for proper utilization or matrix significance, and these pressing tasks compel scientists to focus on sustainable power sources to generate electricity. Converters are now being developed at the initial stage to improve power change proficiency. This paper falls on execution appraisal of non-isolated converters. The execution was evaluated and used to forecast the converters with the suitable evaluation of power for high pick up PV Application in light of the yield result from the MATLAB - SIMULINK MODEL.

Author Keywords: quadratic boost (QB) with voltage multiplier cell

articleTitle: Design of Interleaved Cuk Converter with Fuzzy Based MPPT in Standalone PV Application
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: In recent days, the demand for energy is rapidly growing due to industrial revolution. The best option for supplying the rising need for energy is renewable energy. Because of its vast availability, environmental friendliness, and adaptability, solar energy is seen as the most promising energy source. However, there are a lot of benefits to solar energy. Due to variations in solar light, it has challenges in producing a high conversion ratio and steady supply of energy. The proposed strategy addresses the aforementioned issues. An Interleaved Cuk Converter with an intelligent maximum power point tracker and fuzzy logic is coupled to a photovoltaic (PV) solar module in the proposed system. An Interleaved Cuk Converter used in this approach improves the voltage with minimized switching stress and ripples. To track the peak power, fuzzy based Maximum Power Point Tracking (MPPT) is used which is highly efficient in tracking as well as it shows dynamic response in case of changing atmospheric conditions. The proposed method provides higher efficiency and better performance regarding tracking efficacy and response time. The efficiency of the system is validated through MATLAB simulation.

articleTitle: Portable Solar Power Generation Unit Using P&O Controlled Boost Converter
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: In distributed generation, the existing systems involve fixed roof top solar panels for commercial and residential buildings. During conditions of disasters or in primitive villages, a great way to use the solar energy for electricity is portable solar generator setup. It replaces the conventional types of generators like fuel type and wind mill type generators which are heavy, complex requiring run wires or drill holes in the roof. In addition it offers easy movement to a new recreational vehicle used in field trips, camps etc. Hence, a new economic based portable solar generator unit is designed and implemented for the need of community. A PV system generates intermittent power and is variable in nature. In order to effectively harvest greatest amount of power from a PV system, a Boost converter that is under the direction of the Perturb & Observe (P&O) algorithm is required. Proposed Portable Solar Power Generation Unit (PSPGU) is able to produce a power of 120W. In addition to it a 36Ah battery is implemented for backup power and for storing the excess power. To speed up charging and preserve batteries, a solar charge controller is employed. With the advent of an ideal energy scaling system and compact design, portable solar generators significantly lower installation costs. The solar generator's components may be easily purchased from local markets, thus lowering the development costs and making it suitable for commercialization.

articleTitle: High Gain Luo Converter for ANFIS-GWO optimized PV Based Grid Tied Dstatcom Module
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: Due to its utilization of renewable energy sources for the production of electricity, the solar Photovoltaic (PV) energy generation system has come under scrutiny as a major energy system by electric utilities all over the world. As these kinds of systems expand in the modern day, more study is required to advance modern technologies, such as extremely efficient batteries or solar panels. In this study, the PV system is now equipped with a Luo converter, which enhances the PV system's output voltage gain. The converter uses Pulse Width Modulation (PWM) controller to enhance device efficiency overall and track the maximum power point tracker (MPPT). Increase the accuracy of MPPT controller adopting Adaptive Neuro-Fuzzy (ANFIS), Gray Wolf Optimization (GWO). The input DC voltage is inverted using a three phase Voltage Source Inverter (VSI) and a three phase induction motor, and the resultant harmonics are reduced using an LC filter. MATLAB is used to execute the simulation, and a minimum Total Harmonic Distortion (THD) value of 1.24% was found.

articleTitle: Localization of Broken Instruments Inside the Root Canal Using Pulse-Echo Mode of Ultrasonic Signal
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: Localization of broken instruments inside the root canal (RC) during root canal Treatment (RCT) is one of the most challenging tasks for an endodontist surgeon. This is due to the lack of real time systems for localization of broken instruments. This paper suggests a method for the identification of the broken instrument inside the RC. In this paper a novel ultrasonics signal recording method for tooth with the CNN architecture of VGG16 as a feature extractor and SVM (support vector machine) for the localization of the broken instruments are used. With this paper, authors localize the broken instrument inside the canal at three positions, i.e., top, bottom, and middle. The accuracy of the system is achieved by 76% with proposed methodology.

articleTitle: A Literature Survey on Handwritten Character Recognition
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: Handwritten character Recognition has created a notable attention in the field of pattern recognition and in machine learning. Text Recognition and document Recognition have created a particular area where they are applied or taken in use several techniques have been proposed for the text recognition and document recognition in handwritten character recognition. There are some studies and papers that explain these methods for changing the text from a paper document in such a form that it is also being understood by machines easily. It seems to be nothing huge now but in future the character recognition systems going to play a huge crucial role in developing a complete paper free environment by making the things digital and online.This research paper targets to give a comprehensive research, reviews of the handwritten character recognition by highlighting the present advancements and issues in the fields.

articleTitle: Enhancing Power Factor Correction by ANN-Based Bridgeless Improved Landsman Converter
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: In recent times, there has been a surge in interest surrounding Electric Vehicles (EVs) due to their numerous advantages such as environmental friendliness and impressive battery storage capacity. EVs have brought about a revolutionary change in both transportation and power industries, offering the potential to positively impact and enhance both sectors through their incorporation. The integration of EVs with power grid necessitates the adoption of effective Power Factor Correction (PFC) techniques to address power quality challenges at supply end, which are inherent to this coupling. In this particular study, a superior bridgeless landsman converter is introduced to enhance power factor correction. By optimizing the conduction of current through minimal semiconductor components, the proposed system effectively regulates the link voltage, resulting in enhanced efficiency and minimized losses. To accomplish this, an Artificial Neural Network (ANN) based Proportional Integral (PI) controllers is utilised. This controller aids in predicting and categorizing responses based on their respective timeframes. A hysteresis controller is seamlessly integrated with a PWM generator, enabling accurate estimation of the converter's steady state switching frequency and delivering reliable outcomes. The outcomes obtained through this approach demonstrate that it effectively maintains a sustainable environment, offering improved efficiency and reduced harmonics.

articleTitle: An Effective Image Compression and Denoising of Image Using Deep Learning Technique
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: Deep Learning neural networks might be employed to handle a vast range of inverse issues that arise in computer generated imaging, according to recent machine learning exploration. The most popular approximations for resolving picture inverse issues right now are DL models. The great maturity of these algorithms learn the function from a dataset in an point-to-point manner in order to break the inverse issue. We examine the key recurring themes in this developing field and provide a taxonomy that will be used to group various issues and reconstruction approaches. By using the denoising and compression concepts, this study proposes an image solution to the picture inversion issue. A modified convolution neural network is used for denoising and compression.

articleTitle: Web Server Based Soft Starter for DC Shunt Motor
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: Automation has become a significant topic in the 21st century, thanks to the advancements in robotics, artificial intelligence, and machine learning. It offers the potential to reduce human effort and time, resulting in improved productivity and efficiency. In this paper, we present an innovative idea for creating a web server-based speed control system for DC shunt motors using the ESP32 microcontroller. The system enables users to regulate the speed of a DC shunt motor from any location. in the world using a web browser or a mobile app. By integrating a web server with an ESP32 microcontroller, the system provides a flexible and versatile solution for industrial automation, home automation, and DIY projects. To use the ESP32 to develop web server-based speed control of a DC shunt motor, a web page will be created and hosted on the microcontroller. Users will be able to create a changeable duty cycle pulse-width modulation signal for the DC motor using an HTML slider on the website. The SEMIKRON kit module will be used to interface with the motor and convert the PWM signal to a variable voltage that controls the motor speed. This setup provides an intuitive and user-friendly interface for remotely controlling the motor speed. The duty cycle value is set by adjusting the slider. The PWM signal produced by the ESP32 will be set based on the position of this slider. In essence, this variable duty cycle PWM will regulate the DC motor's speed. The webpage in the mobile or laptop and the Esp32 controller should be connected in the same Wi-Fi. Within the Wi-Fi range the motor speed was controlled. This method of web server-based speed control offers several advantages over traditional methods. It reduces the complexity of the system by eliminating the need for extensive wiring and hardware. The use of the ESP32 microcontroller and SEMIKRON kit module provides a portable and scalable solution that can be easily adapted to various industrial automation systems. The system also offers greater flexibility for remote operation and control. Operators can connect wireless network and use HTML slider on the web page to the DC shunt motor's speed should be adjusted and observed. This provides a simple and intuitive interface for controlling industrial motors, saving time and reducing human effort.

articleTitle: ZETA-KY Converter With Whale Optimization For Electric Vehicle Charging
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: In certain scenarios, such as high-voltage level charging of batteries and fuel cell electric automobiles, direct current to direct current (DC/DC) converters require a greater power. Therefore, it is crucial to conduct research on Zeta-KY conversions. There is an urgent need for novel power conversion technologies with a low price and outstanding dependability for the advanced demanding procedure for EVs since the electrical transistor converting serves as the primary interface among the power supply and the EV battery system. Power conversion architectures are rapidly evolving, which presents an important possibility for the vehicle charging process. However, at the DC-DC conversion's results, the DC-link electricity varies. A PI Controller based on the Whale Optimization (WOA) Algorithm is utilized to preserve a regular DC link voltage. After the VSI transforms the incoming DC voltage to AC voltage, the grid is then supplied with the DC-link output. The harmonies are reduced and the grid is synchronized using a PI Controller that utilizes DQ theory.

articleTitle: Smart Fleet: An Advanced Web-Based Solution for Fleet Management and Security
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: The standard of living has risen significantly by means of sophisticated technology, and people now totally depend on vehicles for both personal transportation and for the distribution of commodities. Resource management is extremely important, such as fuels, and currently, only trademarked vehicles, such as motorbikes and automobiles, have safety and advanced features, therefore we are creating a website to make them available to all types of fleet vehicles. Using cloud technologies such as thingspeak and it is an IoT-based fleet tracking system that can monitor fuel consumption and fuel theft detection using ultrasonic sensor. The theft detection feature will be implemented by RFID technology providing the authorized users with RFID tags that can only be accessed by them unauthorized movement of the vehicle will be detected and notification would be sent to the authorized organization and devices integrated with the smart fleet website. And GPS module is used to track the exact location of the fleet vehicles. The proposed IoT-based fleet tracking system will offer a comprehensive solution for efficient gasoline level monitoring, theft detection, and advanced fleet tracking using UBlox NEO-M8N GPS Module the sensors are integrated with ESP8266 this project will make a significant contribution to the IoT and fleet management domains, providing an innovative and efficient solution to one of the most critical challenges faced by fleet managers today.

articleTitle: Energy Management System Using Multi Agent Systems with IoT and Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: The topic of this study is a Smart Microgrid with Dynamic, Distributed Energy Management. At the moment, a SCADA system is used for energy management (Supervisory Control and Data Acquisition). A distributed energy system (DES) called a “multi-agent system” (MAS) is made up of several software agents that form a loosely connected network and cooperate to solve issues that are more complex than they can handle alone. By selecting the least expensive renewable resource that is readily available at the time, economic and environmental optimization is performed. As a result, dynamic energy management has been put into practice. The purpose of this research is to demonstrate how an energy management system based on MAS may be utilized to optimize a microgrid. Machine learning has been used to forecast load, increase power grid efficiency, and establish a stable operating environment.

articleTitle: An Analysis of Metaheuristics Techniques to Optimize Hyper-Parameters for Deep Learning Models
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: The combination of metaheuristic techniques and deep learning models has gained significant attention in recent years due to their potential to address complex optimization problems. In this paper, we have presented a comprehensive study of the role of metaheuristic techniques in enhancing the performance of deep learning models. We also discussed few metaheuristic algorithms, which includes firefly algorithms, particle swarm optimization, and ant colony optimization, along with CNN model of deep neural network. Furthermore, the literature work has been also presented where metaheuristic techniques have been successfully applied to improve the performance of deep learning models in various applications. The findings of this study demonstrate the potential of metaheuristic techniques in enhancing the performance of deep learning models and their significance in addressing complex optimization problems. Moreover, it also includes the challenges faced by the researchers which still persist.

articleTitle: Current Advancements in Radar Communication and its Future Research Directions
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: Radars are playing a vital role in the field of electronic warfare, ground observation, different military applications, speed recognition of an objects, air traffic management, etc. It is an inescapable part for Tele-Communications. All of these systems must be capable of carrying out various jobs and have significant power gains, adaptive beamforming, faster scanning rates, low detection probabilities, high dependability, and low maintenance costs. Many of the updated radar systems and methods are taking the place of the outdated ones. This examination will deliver a thorough idea of the developments in radars, and current trends. Current radar systems, such as sophisticated scanning methods, GPS-based landing systems, passive radars with multiliterate, 3D radars, Long and short-range Radars for Autonomous Vehicles, and satellite monitoring radars, are briefly discussed in this paper. The Radars being used in the advanced jet fighters also discussed. Certainly, all the secondary Radars would be replaced by Passive Radars and Satellites in near future. All the current research potential areas in modern Radar Communication are mentioned in this paper that would helpful for the early researchers in this vibrant field.

articleTitle: Model Predictive Control for Regulating the Inverter in a Standalone Mode
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: The integration of renewable energy sources (RES) into microgrid systems has received considerable interest because of its potential to improve the dependability and sustainability of power grids. To make the renewable energy penetrate the microgrid we use inverters to convert the DC to AC. Inverter based Microgrids can help penetrate the power from the renewable sources and which in turn also increasing the reliability of the grid connection regulate the AC bus voltage and frequency in the presence of the load variability inherent in microgrids, robust, rapid, and precise control system algorithms are required. In the recent times Model Predictive Control (MPC) has risen up as a phenomenal control approach for handling the power flow in microgrid systems. This paper presents a literature survey on recent developments in the MPC of inverters in microgrid systems. The survey discusses the challenges and opportunities of using MPC to regulate voltage and frequency, share power among inverters, and improve the power quality in microgrid systems. This review also highlights the importance of accurate modelling of system dynamics and uncertainties in RES and load demand for effective MPC control. Finally, the survey identifies the need for further research on the integration of MPC with energy management systems to optimize the operation of parallel inverters and energy storage systems in microgrids.

articleTitle: Union Parishad: A Rural Village Council Based Mobile Application For Village Peoples Local, Medical, IT, and Complaint Assistance Services
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: The union council plays an important role to improve the lifestyle of the rural people by providing local problem-solving facilities, medical services, IT services, local jurisdiction facilities, and different complaints-solving assistance facilities. The existing works on union council-based services rely on offline- based service delivery. The offline-based union council service delivery process is time and cost-consuming. To provide a beneficial solution, this paper contributes an online-based union council mobile application for rural village peoples' local problem-solving, medical facilities, local jurisdiction, IT services, and complain assistant facilities. The noteworthy features of the proposed application are community centre booking, birth certificate apply, government allowance, vaccination application, doctor appointment services, computer training, corruption re-porting, local jurisdiction help, and online seminar scheduling. The user review response analysis regarding the application features briefed that more than 75% of users are satisfied with the proposed application features and 80% of users are satisfied with the proposed applications supremacy over the existing problems.

articleTitle: Intelligent Controller Design for Fault Current Mitigation in Dstatcom Applications Using Three Phase NPC Inverter
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: Power quality occupies a variety of research efforts for engineers and scientists. To solve Power Quality issues, conventional compensation devices have failed to perform adequately. Power electronics based compensation devices have proven to be a more effective solution. DSTATCOMs are shunt connected custom power devices, which used to increase utility grid auxiliary service capability and improve the PQ problems, voltage and reactive power support. DSTATCOM is used to generate compensating currents which are combined with distorted current generated from nonlinear loads to remove harmonics from source currents. In this paper, the effect of reactive power consumption is eliminated by using DSTATCOM based on Neutral Point Clamped (NPC) inverters. In an NPC multilevel inverter, Level Shifted Pulse Width Modulation (LSPWM) and Phase Shifted PWM (PSPWM) approaches are used to effectively improve power stability. In order to appropriately maintain power stability and solve oscillation issues, the intelligent Artificial Neural Network (ANN) controller is executed. The performance of the system error is minimized by the fuzzy logic controller with an appropriate DC link control. Based on MATLAB simulation results, the fault current is mitigated by using NPC inverter.

articleTitle: Wavelet- Sub Pixel Based Single Image Super Resolution
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: Blind Image Super-Resolution (BISR) is a widely recognized image processing the approach. BISR, which seeks to super-resolving low-resolution images with undetermined deterioration, is gaining prominence due to its usefulness in stimulating real-world applications. In this research, we developed the Wavelet-Subpixel Residual Attention Network (WSRAN) for BISR, which significantly increases SR efficiency without sacrificing performance while enhancing generalized ability to real-world damaged pictures. The subpixel convolution layer converts LR feature maps into reconstructed outputs. We also employ the Residual Attention Block (RAB). Extensive trials indicate that when compared to SR approaches, our WSRAN requires fewer parameters and achieves statistically and subjectively competitive results. In the future, we want to find a means to increase the upscale factor beyond three.

articleTitle: Advancements in Brain Implants: Bio Sensors, IoT and Security Concerns
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: Brain implant technologies are swiftly growing into the most promising therapeutic solution globally, with the potential to treat neurological disorders such as Parkinson's disease, epilepsy, and brain injury. While this technology is still in its infancy, significant progress has already been made. This paper outlines our current knowledge and expected developments of these technologies in the future, including possible risks and ethical questions. Additionally, future research directions concerning things like the change in perspective, personal identity, IoT integration, and cyber security concerns are reviewed.

articleTitle: Offensive Language Detection in Social Media Using Ensemble Techniques
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: Hate speech and offensive content are deliberate attacks directed at a group or society based on their characteristics like religion, gender, or race, and pose a threat to society. The usage of Facebook and other social media platforms, WhatsApp, and Instagram led to an increase in this type of content. Detecting and preventing the spread of such content is crucial to avoid negative impacts on society. However, manually analyzing these vast and continuously rising texts is challenging as well as tedious. This work covers the usage of machine learning techniques to recognize offensive speech on social media. A comparative analysis of several popular algorithms, including Naive Bayes (NB), Support Vector Machines (SVM), Extreme Gradient Boosting (XGBoost), K Nearest Neighbor (KNN), Decision Tree, and Random Forest has been performed, and evaluate their performance using recall, precision, F1- score, and accuracy metrics. The experiments on a dataset of Twitter posts containing hate speech show that Random Forest is the most effective algorithm, achieving an accuracy of 97%. The effectiveness of the model has also been examined in relation to several feature extraction methodologies, such as bag-of-words and TF-IDF(term frequency-inverse document frequency). The obtained results show the effectiveness of Random Forest combined with TF-IDF as the best approach in detecting vile language in social media.

articleTitle: Internet of Things Based Real Time Energy Monitoring System
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: This proposed work involves developing a system to detect and prevent electricity theft in the power sector using smart meters, IoT, and Power BI. Smart meters wirelessly transmit data to IoT cloud platforms, which are processed in real-time using Power BI for energy consumption analysis and monitoring. CT coils and NODEMCU Wi-Fi microcontrollers detect and transmit real-time data to the cloud to identify instances of energy theft. The system alerts Electricity Board officials when theft is detected. The user-friendly system is scalable, flexible, and easy to install and maintain. It can contribute to sustainable development by reducing electricity theft, improving efficiency, and saving electricity, thus benefiting the economy. This project is a reliable and efficient solution to combat electricity theft and improve the power sector's performance.

articleTitle: Real Time Helmet and Mask Detection For Safety Critical Areas In The Workplace
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: The objective of the study is to detect the helmets and masks worn by workers, researchers, QA inspectors and any other individuals that work in a field/domain that requires a physical presence in potential safety critical areas and if it is found that the individuals are not wearing the proper protective gear, an alarm will be triggered. The paper provides a comprehensive examination of the field of intelligent access systems for safety critical areas. The purpose of this paper is to provide practitioners and researchers with a comprehensive understanding of the key challenges and opportunities associated with designing, implementing, and operating such similar systems. Five categories were identified for this examiner use case in the field of construction, demolition or environmentally hazardous workplaces: “head”, “helmet”, ‘'false mask”, “unmasked” and “masked”. A total of 1711 images of construction worker scenes were collected and enhanced to produce 4733 images. All images are annotated according to defined categories. Experiments split the training and validation datasets in a ratio of 9:1. This resulted in an average mean accuracy of 65.235% (graph).

articleTitle: Sliding-Mode for Torque and Flux Control of the Induction Motor
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: The drives are investigated with a Sliding Mode Direct Torque and Flux Controller. The proposed speed control method SMC is used to drive an induction motor drive since they have no regularity in uncertainties activation. SMC is the correct name for the form of control built on the fact that the controller's structure should be changed in connection with the system's changing condition so as to achieve the desired response action. While using the standard vector control technique, current controllers are usually applied while in the use of the sliding mode scheme uses torque, and stator flux controllers together with one another inside the stator flux reference frame. It plays the function of such proportional integral controller(PI), and not noticeable steady-state chattering.

articleTitle: Automatic Language Identification from Non-Uniform Region Using Bi-LSTM and CNN
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: Language Identification is the way to identify the language of a speech or text sample. It entails dissecting the traits of the text or speech and contrasting them with recognized patterns and models of various languages. Language identification is crucial for a variety of processes, including text-to-voice synthesis, natural language processing, and speech recognition. The basic goal of this project is to accurately identify the language from the speech sample. The three Indian languages of Malayalam, Assamese, and Hindi are represented by a language identification system that uses features from non-uniform speech regions to represent phonotactic differences. The BiLSTM and DCNN classification methods are used to identify the given speech with the relevant attributes. The suggested technique starts by extracting spectral information from the speech sample. In addition, we extract prosodic characteristics and spectral features and categorize them using BiLSTM and DCNN. The research, which focuses on northeastern languages, makes use of the recorded databases for three Indian languages. The bi-LSTM model has an accuracy score of 82 % higher than the DCNN model.

articleTitle: Analysis of Deepfake Detection Techniques
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: The proliferation of deepfakes, utilizing sophisticated machine learning algorithms to create falsified media content, is a growing concern for society. This study aims to delve deeper into the different methods used for detecting deepfakes, and assess their effectiveness in identifying manipulated content. Specifically, we are interested in exploring the factors that impact the accuracy of these detection methods, including the quality of source material and the complexity of the deepfake algorithm. By analyzing existing research and experimentation, this paper offers insights into the challenges and limitations of deepfake detection and highlights the need for continued innovation in this field. Ultimately, our research paper aims to contribute to ongoing efforts to combat the spread of deepfakes and promote the creation of trustworthy media content that accurately represents reality.

articleTitle: DFIG Based Wind Turbine Power Control System Using Cascaded ANN Controller
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: Among eco-friendly forms of renewable energy, wind energy is a considerable one. In comparison with other energy sources, wind energy generally has less impact towards environment. There is no emission released which are harmful to environment, also it does not require water for cooling. The use of wind turbines also reduces the amount of energy generated by fossil fuels, reducing air pollution and carbon dioxide emissions. In order to provide grid supply with improved efficiency, a doubly fed induction generator (DFIG) and a wind turbine are used in this study. The effective functioning of the DFIG is accomplished by dq theory based Cascaded ANN which provides the rotor and grid side control. In order to convert the AC supply to DC, PWM rectifier is deployed, from which the energy is stored in super capacitor in DC form. A PWM inverter is implemented in order to change the supply from DC to AC when needed and reduces the harmonic using LC filter. The proposed DFIG system with neural network based control supplies stabilized voltage to the <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\mathbf{3}\boldsymbol{\varphi}$</tex> grid for various applications. The proposed system is simulated using MATLAB and efficient responses are obtained.

articleTitle: Energy Management System using Cascaded Neural Network for a Hybrid Electric Vehicle
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: A Hybrid Electric Vehicle (HEV) and an evolution of Electric Vehicles (EV) have achieved engrossment in day to day life because of its advantage like structural flexibility, improvement towards air quality, noise free and comfort. The performance of Energy Management System (EMS) is hampered by complex configuration and behaviour of multi-source hybrid energy systems. The goal of EMS is to instantly regulate energy flows from converters to meet control objectives, regardless of architecture of powertrain. In this paper, a novel bidirectional isolated DC-DC converter together with cascaded Artificial Neural Network (ANN) controller is used to enhance system input voltage from the Diode Bridge Rectifier (DBR) with medium power applications. Furthermore, the adoption of cascaded ANN controller supports in regulating current and voltage individually. A MATLAB simulation followed by hardware analysis is performed to determine the steady state operation of converter. According to the simulation results, EMS with vehicle system designation greatly increase fuel economy.

articleTitle: Voice Assistant with Emotion Recognition
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: Voice assistants have become a essential part in our daily life, which helps to provide essential tasks in a hands free manner. Here the voice assistant helps the user with hands free experience that includes setting reminders, playing music, alarm, wishes etc. The voice assistant is powerful ones of cutting-edge speech recognition and natural language processing technique. The system will be intended to interpret and respond to a wide range of spoken instructions and enquiries in a natural and intuitive manner. Furthermore, the initiative intends to improve the user experience by giving tailored replies and suggestions depending on the user's preferences and history. For forecasting emotions, features such as emotion recognition, which detects a person's feelings through their face, are implemented. The goal of this project is to create a voice assistant that interacts with and shorten the burden of activities.

articleTitle: User Activity Recognition and Pattern Prediction Using Call Data Mining
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: The story of technology is certainly as old as humanity itself. With the advancement of time, human society has been instrumental in communication technology. Technology has worked in two ways, as a supporting tool for crime as well as a helping tool to identify and investigate the e at the same time. In the last decade, India has seen rapid growth in the field of mobile communication as it is continuously increasing at an exponential rate, the availability of cheap data and availability of economical rate of calling encourages users to make calls easily and this continuous calling within a certain group creates a network considering relationship a parameter. The use of existing models of rapid data mining on mobile phone call logs / call data records (CDR)establishes a new dimension in the field of a user's social behavior. Meanwhile, it makes a possible methodology of suspect detection based on certain attributes i.e., cell phone conversation ratio, calling pattern among users, terrain-basedfacts, etc. In this paper, key areas which have been covered are “Machine's perception towards prediction of complex social systems and strange behavior of cell phone user” based on data mining techniques applied on call details of cell phone users.

articleTitle: Performance Analysis on Wind Power Forecasting in Machine Learning and Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: Wind farms and electricity grids rely on precise forecasts of wind power. Estimates of wind power benefit from deep learning's large data sets, nonlinear mapping, and automated pattern discovery. Most multi-stage estimates of wind power do not correlate stages because in-situ observed wind data are both expensive and scarce. Predicting wind speeds using artificial neural networks facilitates the safe use of wind energy. Due to the frequent changes in wind speed data, these Artificial Neural Network (ANN) models must be retrained with a fresh dataset to guarantee accurate prediction. The proposed enhancement techniques and forecasting system are put to the test on five turbines in an Arctic wind farm with varying topographies.
