Deep learning and probabilistic predictions are introduced here. Before data augmentations, the proposed forecasting model improved benchmark Root Mean Square Error (RMSE) by 33.89%, 10.60%, 7.12%, and 4.27%. 40.63%, 17.67%, 11.74%, and 7.06% after augmentations Next, a deep learning algorithm predicts day-ahead energy generation from a Northern Norway wind power facility. Historical weather data plus Numerical weather predictions (NWPs) as exogenous factors boost forecast accuracy by 37%. Historical data enables the model to auto-correct NWP systematic biases. Finally, external influences like NWPs or weather decrease performance. Probabilistic forecasting, wind energy, deep learning, and ANN.

articleTitle: IOT Based Object Perception Algorithm for Urban Scrutiny System in Digital City
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: Recent population expansion has caused individuals to become less aware of the value of preserving a healthy environment. The world is growing more intelligent for safety purpose, perceptive with intelligent resource optimization solutions in order to rapidly change consumers life based on the need. This need resulted in choosing the creation of secure, smart cities that connect the virtual and physical worlds. These cities use IOT technology to deliver real-time services that adapt to changing circumstances. This system makes use of a variety of sensors to keep track of a city's infrastructure. Using wireless connection, an ATmega16 microcontroller is connected to the system's sensors. The controller gathers data from sensors, transmits using Wi-Fi module to be connected to the cloud, and displays it on a monitor.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of an Adder Circuit for Minimal Power and Less Delay Systems
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: This work represents full adder proposed using Pass Transistor Logic. A complete adder's performance is determined by its consumption of power and delay. Power consumption and delay are important design factors for contemporary digital circuits, and a lot of study has been devoted to optimizing these factors. A comprehensive adder circuit is implemented utilizing Pass Transistor logic. In this circuit, 10 transistors are utilized. The effectiveness of a complete adder system to operate under minimal power and delay conditions. has been enhanced in this paper, using Cadence Virtuoso Computer Aided Design (CAD) software on 90 nm process node. By examining the PDP, power usage, and delay the effectiveness of the suggested circuit design is evaluated.

articleTitle: Analysis of Switched Reluctance Motor Drives Using ANSYS Simplorer
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: Switching Reluctance motors are widely used in modern electric vehicle applications as well as many other industrial settings. In contrast to IMs and PMSMs, SRMs provide a number of crucial qualities for electric vehicle propulsion systems. Outstanding dependability, the capacity to withstand high working temperatures, a broad speed range, compatibility with gearless operation, and simplicity of manufacture are a few of these. SRMs are widely used in many different applications, which opens up possibilities for improving their driving system. Although managing the switching angles and current magnitude effectively is a challenging undertaking, it is possible to control an SRM. Switching reluctance motors are easier to make and repair than other motor types because of their simpler structure. Due to their low electrical and magnetic losses, SRMs are extremely efficient and can help increase the range of electric vehicles. The suggested study might look into how various converter topologies, like the usage of converters with many levels, soft-switching methods, or power factor correction, affect SRM performance. SRMs have a high torque density, which makes them perfect for applications which deal with space and weight are important considerations, like in robotics, aerospace, or electric cars. To improve the performance of the SRM, the suggested driver system may use cutting-edge control techniques such model predictive control, adaptive control, or neural networks. Electric cars needing fast acceleration and deceleration rates benefit from SRMs' ability to operate at high speeds. The simulation may also examine the effects of various operational parameters, including temperature, torque, speed, and efficiency, on SRM performance. The proposed effort intends to create an appropriate driver system for ANSYS Simplorer's comparative analysis of SRM. The simulation checked for four different converters.

articleTitle: Performance Comparison of Different Controllers for Permanent Magnet Synchronous Motor Drive System
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: A study on the performance of controllers is carried out for a PMSM Drive system used in Electric Vehicles. In recent times, PMSMs are considered as the most suitable AC machines for control applications because of their features like maximum torque or inertia ratio, top speed, peak efficiency, improved dynamic performance, smaller size, easy maintenance etc. With mentioned advantages, PMSM's are widely used for applications in the domain of robotics, transportation, aerospace, etc. A large number of control strategies are present to control the PM Synchronous Motors. In this article, Field Oriented Control technique is employed to control the speed and torque of an Interior PMSM. A Mathematical Model of IPMSM in rotary orthogonal reference (d,q) frame is presented in this paper. Using this model, PI Controllers are designed to control the speed and current of IPMSM. This work is implemented through simulation in PSIM software environment.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Multi Domain Monitoring Device to Improve Soil Health
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: Power of Hydrogen (pH) levels in Soil should be regularly monitored and regulated between 6.8 and 7.2, since they are crucial for soil fertility and plant growth. The system gathers information on soil temperature, water level, light intensity, pH level, and water turbidity, allowing farmers to maximise crop development and productivity while cutting costs. It uses an ATMEGA8 pH rod with TTL output and Turbidity sensors. This idea mainly focusses on multi domain use case for pH measurement and multiple methodology. The proposed work presented in this paper utilizes no code or a microcontroller to make it more accessible to farmers. The Overall cost is reduced by 96.5% with the Market Rates. The Smart Soil Health Kit could transform the way farmers think about soil health by giving them the power to make data-driven decisions and enhance their livelihoods.

articleTitle: Sliding Mode Controlled Sepic Converter for Variable Voltage Applications
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: It depicts a sliding mode control (SMC) for a single ended primary inductor converter (SEPIC). The objective is to obtain a stable output in a converter with varying loads and varying sources. The functionalities of a buck and a boost regulator are combined in this circuit. The input voltage of a buck converter surpasses the output voltage because it converts a high voltage to a lower value. The SEPIC converter can change the input voltage by altering the duty cycle. The SEPIC is a DC-DC converter with an output voltage that can be less, larger, or equal to the input voltage. The frequency response of the control transistor governs the SEPIC's output. A nonlinear system's dynamics are altered by the SMC. Variable structural control (VSC) is used in the SMC. In contrast to typical SMC methods, the suggested SMC approach employs a sliding surface function. The usage of a sliding surface function simplifies and reduces the cost of implementation. The input current reference is generated using a proportional integral (PI) regulator. This control method allows for rapid, permanent reactions. The goal is to achieve a consistent output from a converter with variable loads and sources. The simulation findings are presented and examined.

articleTitle: A novel Double Frequency Cascaded Boost Converter
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: This study focuses on enhancing the functionality, effectiveness, and voltage gain of a converter in a single circuit. A cascaded boost converter is used to increase a converter's voltage gain whereas a double frequency boost converter is used to increase a converter's performance and efficiency. No circuit has been created that will simultaneously improve all three of them. The concept of a double frequency cascaded boost converter has therefore been discussed. A double frequency boost converter is a type of converter that combines the functions of a cascaded boost converter with a double frequency boost converter. The simulation results of the double frequency cascaded boost converter implies that all the three that is efficiency, performance and voltage gain is highly improved. A double frequency cascaded boost converter consists of a high frequency switch and a low frequency switch. A high frequency switch is connected to a high frequency capacitor and the low frequency switch is connected to the low frequency capacitor. A filter capacitor in added in order to remove the harmonics.

articleTitle: Automation and Control Mechanism For Textile Dyeing Process Using PLC and IoT
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: Industrial automation is a developing technology that has a sustainable growth in the modern environment. The industrial automation has several benefits like the lesser involvement of employees in the industry operation, and maintains the process with accuracy and precision. The purpose of the industrial automation project equipped with PLC, minimizes the overall operational cost of the plant operation. Dyeing industry operates on different stages of tedious processes that certainly require factory automation for efficient plant operation. By implementing factory automation systems the one big problem statement of paying wages to the employees at the time of no order period is being eliminated. The PLC is a control unit where all the machinery from the dyeing industry is connected and monitored through IoT. This way of factory automation is implemented by developing a prototype model for automation and control mechanism for the textile dyeing process using PLC and IoT. Dyeing is a process, where the fabric is rolled up in the winch dyeing machine and the gradual transfer of dyes to the fabric under optimum temperature is performed. The major machineries involved in the dyeing process are the winch dyeing machine and the boiler. Winch dyeing machine have a rotating rod that spins when the motor is energized, the feed water and hot water is passed to the winch machine when the solenoid valve is actuated based on the preset value. The work in this paper deals with the process of automated the whole system using PLC. The level of the dyebath in the winch dyeing machine is actively monitored using the level sensor and the real time values are taken to the cloud. This automation benefits the dyeing Industry with precision, accuracy and real time monitoring of plant.

articleTitle: Detection of Sleep Apnea Based on Snore Signals Using Machine Learning Techniques
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: People's quality of life is significantly influenced by the quantity and quality of their sleep. Snoring bothers other individuals in the room as well as the snorer, who gets the worst quality sleep as a result. Among the most prominent sleep disorders, Sleep Apnea can have very serious side effects, from elevated blood pressure to heart failure, if it goes undetected. Many people are still unaware of this disease. A hardware part using raspberry pi and a microphone is used for collecting audio sounds at night from a subject. In order to identify snoring, two classifiers namely Long-short Term Memory(LSTM) and Gated Recurrent Unit(GRU) are proposed in this study. First, we gathered a dataset of sounds, both snoring and not from a website and a real-time dataset from hardware prepared for this project. The diverse properties of snoring are represented by the Mel-Frequency Cepstrum Coefficients (MFCC) which are retrieved as distinctive elements of snoring. The LSTM is made to be able to receive different audio cues and synthesize data to recognize snoring. When compared to single-feature network processing, using several feature coefficients can more precisely pinpoint the characteristics of snoring. GRU is capable of working with variable-length input sequences and can record the audio signal's time-varying patterns.

articleTitle: Smart Load Safety System
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: Nowadays, most of the electrical fires in houses occur because of various appliances used in households that are unattended and left plugged into the electric sockets while leaving the home and unwanted voltage conditions like sag, swell, and frequency interruption which might result in a reduction in the lifetime of the appliances and damage the sensitive elements in those appliances. This project aims to design a system that protects the consumer from such condition by cutting off the load from the main using an embedded system when either when you lock your door and leave your house or unwanted voltage conditions occurs and are indicated in an LCD display. To make consumers aware and to control such appliances, this paper introduces, the “SMART LOAD SAFETY SYSTEM”. In recent years there are many projects targeting to identification and mitigation of sag, swell, and frequency interruption on the utility end but our project is mainly focused on sag, and swell detection on the consumer end.

articleTitle: Physical Design Implementation And Measurement Of Timing Metrics Of 32-Bit LEON SPARC Processor Used In Space Applications
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: There are numerous sequential processes involved in the design sequence of VLSI ICs or processors. It begins with the high-level synthesis, the functional design, and moves on to the manufacturing stage, the fabrication process. The method of converting a circuit's description into its physical layout is called physical design. The location of the cells and the associated pathways connecting them are described. Finding a layout with a smaller footprint and less overall wire length is a key challenge in VLSI physical design. The circuit's performance is directly impacted by the physical architecture. Performance, area, dependability, power and yield are the impacts that physical design is concerned with. To make physical design less complex, it is divided into smaller parts. In the beginning the circuit is divided into macro cells. In floor planning, the cells are assigned to specific location and are effectively positioned. After the placement process, global routing is carried out. It is possible to identify the errant paths that exist between each module, determine the precise path of the disconnected wires that run throughout the macro cell's channels. The layout compression comes last. In order to decrease the overall area, the design is compressed in this area along all dimensions. The physical design of a 32-bit LEON SPARC processor is created in the proposed effort to take up the least amount of space and operate as efficiently as possible that is employed in Defense and Space applications.

articleTitle: Mixed Signal Design of Phase Frequency Detector with Charge Pump Using 130nm PDK
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: This paper focuses on the design of two blocks, that is, Phase Frequency Detector (PFD) and Charge Pump (CP) both of which serve as an integral part in a Phase Locked Loop. The PFD has been designed as a digital block capable of comparing the phase and frequency of two signals to yield an output equivalent to the phase/frequency difference between the two. Charge Pump is an analog circuit which serves the purpose of converting the output signals from PFD into an analog voltage. The charge pump circuit has been designed using the Google-SkyWater 130nm open-source process design kit (PFD) whereas the PFD is a completely digital block written using Verilog hardware description language (HDL). Both these blocks are then integrated together and simulated as a mixed signal circuit to see the charging and discharging cycles of charge pump circuit depending upon the PFD input signals. The entire design has been done on the open-source eSim tool developed by FOSSEE team of IIT Bombay. Furthermore, the SPICE simulation results are presented.

articleTitle: Implementation of Text-Based Sentiment Analysis Using LSTM Model
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: Sentiment analysis(SA) falls under the applications of NLP or Natural language processing and comes under the category of classification of text. In particular, is a text mining technique that automates the process of evaluating text to ascertain the sentiment represented by using natural language processing (NLP). sentiment analysis actually involves classifying the text into various emotions such as positive, negative or unbiased. sentiment analysis or opinion mining became crucial and also important from the past decades. In this paper we came to know there are many ways to perform sentiment analysis, we took some popular and simple ways to predict and made efforts to find the model which is giving highest accuracy. So therefore, we took a dataset that contains columns such as text id, review. We cleaned the data and choose the data we required and then started building project.

articleTitle: Glaucoma Detection Using CNN Ensemble Classifier and OTSU Threshold Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: Glaucoma is an eye disorder that damages the optic nerve (or retina), impairs vision, and finally renders a person blind. In the field of medicine, glaucoma early diagnosis has taken on significant importance. This work develops, trains, and tests a diagnostic tool for glaucoma identification based on imagery of the eye fundus. Segmentation and feature extraction techniques are used to detect glaucoma using retinal images, while other techniques focus on convolutional neural network (CNN) training by brute force. The Glaucoma Fundus Image Recuperation (GFIR) technique was developed with the aim of classifying the patient's fundus pictures using the OTSU algorithm in order to identify glaucoma sickness. The success of the GFIR technique is assessed using the glaucoma database from Kaggle in terms of sensitivity rate, specificity rate, ranking efficiency, and feature selection time. A VCG-16 based Feature Clustering technique is developed in order to accomplish exact vessel segment location in fundus images and to boost performance rate with human graded orientation standard. The Convolutional Neural Network Ensemble Classifier (CNN-ENSEMBLE) framework has been developed to help identify glaucoma problems early, and the system's accuracy was 98%.

articleTitle: Optimized Convolutional Neural Network for Deregulated Congestion Management
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: Congestion in power systems primarily caused by deregulation of the power system and rising electricity consumption. Grid congestion occurrences are possible due to increased levels of distributed energy resources (DER) penetration and result in serious harm to power networks, including potential blackouts. Thus, one of the main objectives for assuring network dependability and security is the development of creative operation planning methodologies and control tools for grid congestion management. In order to reduce congestion and support Independent System Operators (ISOs), this work presents a Congestion Management (CM) technique utilizing Convolution Neural Network (CNN). Using a generation rescheduling-based strategy, the primary goal of CM is to ease transmission line congestion while addressing all limitations with least amount of congestion expense. The control of congestion in public transmission and distribution systems continues to be a difficult problem. Traditionally, load shedding and generator rescheduling have been employed to accomplish this. The suggested work uses Improved Artificial Bee Colony Algorithm (IABCA)-optimized CNN, which helps to deliver considerable results for congestion management with lower error. The suggested approach improves a number of current optimization techniques in terms of congestion cost and losses by producing more accurate prediction outputs. For the IEEE 30 Bus system, simulation outcomes based on IABCA are presented using MATLAB simulation software.

articleTitle: Machine Learning Technique to Analyze the Health Condition of Athletes and Predict their Performance
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: In the past few years, the application of machine learning techniques in the field of sports science has gained considerable attention. The ability to analyse vast amounts of data and extract meaningful insights has opened up new opportunities for understanding the health conditions of athletes and predicting their performance. In this paper, we explore the use of machine learning techniques for analysing the health conditions of athletes and predicting their performance. Here, we use the athletes performance dataset to predict the performance class of athletes. The data is preprocessed and transformed into features that are relevant to the health and performance of athletes. The model is trained on the dataset of previous performance records and health data of athletes to make predictions for new athletes. In this proposed framework, we apply various machine learning algorithms such as random forest, logistic regression, gradient boosting, decision tree classifier and K-neighbors classifier, to the data set. We examine the advantages and limitations of each technique and provide examples of how they can be used to analyse athlete health and performance. Also, we compare the accuracy of each classifier and select the one that has the highest accuracy on the test set. In the experimental results, random forest classifier outperformed other algorithms in predicting the performance class. The outcome demonstrate the efficacy of the proposed technique for predicting the performance of athletes with high accuracy, which can be used to support coaches and trainers in optimising training plans and preventing injuries.

articleTitle: Hybrid Energy Source Based Landsman Converter for AC/DC Microgrid
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: The main objective of this study is to compare the SEPIC converter, which has a poor dynamic output voltage and more ripple content, with the proposed LANDSMAN converter, which has a better dynamic output voltage and less ripple content. The latter system has multiple reverse conversions in a single ac or dc grid. Furthermore, these two converters operations are compared for a resistive load by using MATLAB/Simulink and result is presented and also the operation of LANDSMAN converter with and without PI controller is simulated using MATLAB/Simulink. The proposed system has the potential to be implemented in various micro-grid applications, including rural electrification, remote area power supply, and emergency backup power systems. The hardware implementation of the Landsman converter using a hybrid energy source for AC/DC grid has been carried out.

articleTitle: ANN Controller for Mitigation of Power Quality Issues Using Single Phase Unified Power Flow Controller
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: This research proposes a nonlinear control method for single-phase Unified Power Flow Controller (UPFC) to improve Power Quality (PQ) issues in single-phase power grid. The main objective of this work is to maintain the appropriate level of load voltage minimal distortion and the control aims include the following: (i) compensation for current harmonics and reactive power; (ii) compensation for voltage disturbances (harmonics and swell, sags and flickers of voltage); and (iii) regulate the voltage on the DC bus. For the purpose to reduce harmonics in power systems and generate reference current for AC supply, the Decoupled Double Synchronous Reference Frame (DDSRF) theory has been presented. The influence of harmonics is then lessened by injecting this harmonic into power systems. Artificial Neural Network (ANN) with Hysteresis Current Controller (HCC) is used to create hysteresis Current regulation, which lowers Total Harmonic Distortion (THD) and increases output voltage. Through several simulation outcomes, the suggested system's effectiveness is examined. Hardware results are also confirmed with simulation outcomes using Matlab/Simulink.

articleTitle: Web3 Based Funding Platform
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: The emergence of Web3 technologies has led to the development of decentralized funding platforms, which allow individuals and organizations to raise funds without the need for intermediaries such as banks and venture capitalists. The underlying technology powering these platforms is blockchain, known for its ability to offer a reliable and transparent method of recording transactions and overseeing financial operations. This research paper aims to explore the Web3 funding platform landscape, its benefits and challenges, and the potential impact it could have on traditional funding models. The paper also examines the key features and functionalities of these platforms, including smart contracts, tokenization, and decentralized governance. It also presents the design and development of a platform for investors to invest in startups using cryptocurrencies. The platform is designed to address the challenges faced by startups in accessing funding, while providing investors with new investment opportunities in the fast-growing world of cryptocurrencies. Through a review of relevant literature and case studies, this research paper provides insights into the current state of Web3 funding platforms, their adoption and growth trajectory, and the regulatory environment that surrounds them. Overall, the platform offers a new investment opportunity for investors, while also providing startups with access to much-needed funding. The platform has the potential to disrupt traditional funding models and provide a more efficient and transparent way for startups to access funding.

articleTitle: Machine Learning Model for Face Spoof Detection with Textural Feature Extraction
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: Face spoof detection is a scheme for detecting the spoofed faces. Various techniques have been designed for the face spoof detection, based on features, machine learning (ML) and deep learning (DL) in the past few years, and has drawn great interest in a variety of domains that are most accessible and leads to maintain abundant information in day-to-day life. Face spoof detection techniques which are based on Artificial Intelligence (AI) contain several stages such as pre-process the data, extract the features and classify the faces. The earlier method makes the deployment of K-Nearest Neighbor with Grey Level Co-occurrence Matrix to detect the face spoofing, but at lower accuracy. Moreover, <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\text{DWT}-\text{LBP}-\text{DCT}+\text{SVM}$</tex> algorithm is also implemented to detect the face-spoofing. However, the accuracy of these algorithms is found lower. This work projects a hybrid technique in which RF, K-Nearest Neighbor (KNN) and Support Vector Machine algorithms are put together. The simulation results exhibited the supremacy of the projected technique as compared to other methods concerning accuracy.

articleTitle: Deep Learning Based Driver Drowsiness Monitoring and Alert System
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: Road traffic accidents destroyed the lives of over 1.35 million people every year worldwide. When compared to an attentive driver, a distracted driver has significantly longer reaction times. This fact contributes to the risk of such drivers becoming involved in an accident. Driver monitoring system is found to lower the risk of accidents caused by tired, sleepy or distracted drivers. To notify drivers and reduce the large incidence of collisions, numerous detecting systems have been created. But most of them depend on specialised hardware that is integrated inside the car. Accordingly, this research aims at designing of a novel effective Human Machine Interface (HMI) for driver monitoring system using deep learning. This technology works by monitoring the driver's eye movement and notifying the driver by triggering the buzzer when he/she is fatigued. In addition, the system also has an option for reducing the gear motor speed automatically when drowsiness is detected. The deep learning algorithm employed in this work is Convolutional Neural Network (CNN), which is utilized for alert generation, image classification, feature extraction and detection. The system continually detects the driver's eyelid movements and if drowsiness is identified, the gadget informs him with a buzzer sound alarm. The suggested method is found to be stable and reliable for face and eye tracking.

articleTitle: Processing of ECG Signal Using Optimized Feature Selection for the Prediction of Irregular Heart Beat
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: The categorization of Electro Cardio Gram (ECG) trials into significant arrhythmia programs to identify abnormal heartbeats is presented in this study as an effective hybridized method. The most frequently used and recognized detection technology to display heart fitness is the physiological detection utilizing ECG data. Arrhythmia beat categorization also plays a significant part in ECG analysis that is intended to clarify cardiac well-being position when investigating heartbeat. Artificial Neural Networks (ANN) is deployed for the segmentation of input ECG images. The proposed work uses Fourier transform to remove the intrinsic sound of ECG signals during the preprocessing step in order to properly categorize ECG samples into main arrhythmia classifications. Chicken Swarm Optimization (CSO) is employed for the effective feature selection which is followed by CNN based classification. This demonstrates how the suggested ECG classification model is successful in correctly classifying ECG signals for abnormality detection along with IoT based

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of a Water Component Tester for Determining Water Content in Fuels
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: The Amalgamation of water in fuels is a process of introducing water into a fuel system. These are done by the petroleum corporation in order to save cost, resources, and emissions from the combustion. But the downside of this is that introducing water in fuels will cause wear and tear to the mobile parts of the engine like the crankshaft, pistons, etc. To prevent this amalgamation a component has been developed as per the customer's requirement but a test rig is to be set up to test the component so that it does not malfunction in real-time. So, a test rig is built in order to simulate the same environment and test the component.

articleTitle: Comparison of Cost Forecasting Algorithms for Industrial Loads
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: Providing consumers with information on electrical power usage combined with forecasts for power consumption, energy prices, and predicted electricity costs makes the data more useful. It will help the locals change their ways of utilizing energy, which will be beneficial for the corporations that produce electricity as well as for the distribution system and the electricity grid. The cost of electrical energy usage is forecasted in this paper using machine learning methods. This study analyses the performance of two machine learning algorithms: Auto Regressive Integrated Moving Average (ARIMA) and Seasonal Auto Regressive Integrated Moving Average (SARIMA). To determine which machine learning method is more accurate and efficient, the actual cost and predicted cost values of each algorithm are compared. The study also analyses the difference in error parameters of the individual algorithms. It is found that ARIMA outperforms SARIMA in terms of effectiveness.

articleTitle: PV Fed High Frequency Inverter with Constant DC-Link Voltage for Load Application
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: In order to reduce leakage currents and streamline authority, power factor correction (PFC) converters are typically operated at low frequencies, which calls for large inductors. A separated, non-resonant, single-stage DC-DC converter with variable frequency control is the suggested system's main component. This system has the potential to guarantee a steady dc-link voltage regardless of power flow is one of its major aspects, which raises the performance of the model. Photovoltaic (PV) modules power supply is balanced by the voltage equalizer, which also stops bypass diodes from bypassing any shaded components in a string. As a result, tight output regulation in low output voltage applications only requires a small output capacitance. The power dissipation caused by swapping at zero voltage and current are reduced by the proposed system. These benefits are confirmed by a prototype that maintains ZVS throughout electricity and voltage for efficiency and good power factors. By utilizing increased leakage currents, this transformer profit from significantly lower passive circuit components for energy conversion and EMI filtration. MATLAB modelling is used to complete this project.

articleTitle: Automatic Announcement System
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: Automatic announcement systems have become popular in various industries, including agriculture, transportation, education, and healthcare. These systems rely on a combination of sensors, microcontrollers, speakers, LCD displays, networks, and cloud services to collect and store data, ensuring that announcements are clear, reliable, consistent, and flexible. By automating announcements, many of the issues faced by humans can be avoided, providing numerous benefits. In this article, we will explore the different fields where automatic announcement systems are commonly implemented, with a particular focus on how they can be utilised in the healthcare sector.

articleTitle: Probabilistic Neural Network Based Reference Current Generation for MLI Based SAPF in Harmonics Reduction
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: Due to a sensitive irregular load integration, the demand for better Power Quality (PQ) in distributed power systems has increased. To enhance the system stability by reducing the harmonics, Active Power Filters is widely utilized. A usage of Shunt Active Power Filter (SAPF), which removes load current harmonics and supplies load reactive power to provide harmonic free source currents with a power component, is suggested in this paper. AC source output is fed into Decoupled Double Synchronous Reference Frame (DDSRF) which generates sinusoidal harmonics in opposition to the load harmonic. The influence of harmonics is then lowered by injecting this harmonic into the power systems. Probabilistic Neural Network (PNN) classifier generates a harmonics free reference current signal. The actual and reference voltage inputs are given to Proportional Integral (PI) controller which minimizes signal error and an output is fed into PWM generator to produce gate pulse for the operation of 5-level Cascaded Multilevel inverter. The currents from AC source and opposite current obtained from the MLI is injected into PCC and fed into nonlinear load. The proposed paper is executed in MATLAB simulation software and corresponding results are obtained particularly.

articleTitle: Prognosis of Polycystic Ovary Syndrome (PCOS) by its Symptoms and Rotterdam Criteria
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: Polycystic Ovary Syndrome (PCOS) is a disease which cause the hormonal disorder in women which in result enlarged ovary with small cysts appearing on its outer edges. This paper attentions on the prognosis of PCOS by classifying its symptoms based on its Rotterdam criteria with respect to the symptoms. To diagnose PCOS, patients need to undergo various unnecessary tests and questionary which not only consume time and cost but has psychological effect on female patients. Women diagnosed with PCOS may face an elevated likelihood of developing type 2 diabetes, cardiovascular issues, hypertension, and endometrial cancer. The exact reason behind the cause of PCOS is not known yet. There are three most widely used Rotterdam criteria for diagnosing PCOS and two out of three criteria must be positive for diagnosis of PCOS. The three criteria are - Oligomenorrhea that means irregular menstrual cycle or Amenorrhea that is absence of menstrual cycle for long period of time, Hyperandrogenism that is clinical or biochemical signs of androgen in the body, polycystic varies in the ultrasound. For this various machine learning algorithms are used for classification and prediction. The dataset is subjected to various classification techniques such as gradient boosting classification, logistic regression, and hybrid approaches like the combination of random forest and logistic regression. From result analysis it is found that the most optimal method among various machine learning algorithms, Random Forest Classifier gives best accuracy for prediction of PCOS. The ensemble methods in machine learning gives the best performance and accuracy in decisions as it combines the insights of multiple learning models in machine learning. There are a lot of features that are obtained from clinical and biological tests, among all the 8 most promising features are selected.

articleTitle: Siamese Hybrid RNN Model for Speech Enhancement: A Novel Approach for Noise Reduction in Speech Signals
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: Efforts to mitigate degradation of speech information and introduction of distortions in speech processing algorithms for smart ha(hearing aid) present a significant challenge. While deep learning-based speech enhancement methods have shown effectiveness, achieving real-time processing remains elusive, particularly for smartphone-centered hearing aid systems. For the purpose of limitation, we suggested a supervised SE approach derived from a Siamese hybrid recurrent neural network (Siamese hybrid RNN) structure. We frame the problem as an approach to enhance speech intelligibility while dealing with limited resources, with a focus on enhancing speech intelligibility in situations with poor SNR scenarios. Described method combines strengths of Siamese architecture and hybrid RNN models to tackle more noise suppression. With the aim of assessing the efficacy of the proposed approach technique, we finalized performance evaluations. Our findings undeniably illustrate the superiority of this approach in enhancing speech intelligibility compared to existing methods. Signal-to-noise ratio has improved by 22%.
